note.zh: 合成或调理肥牛卷可能加了大豆蛋白，买原切的，看配料表。
note.en: Reformed beef rolls can contain soy protein; choose plain sliced beef and check the label.

note.zh: 紫菜里常混有小虾蟹，包装多会标注。
note.en: Laver often holds tiny shrimp or crab; packs usually say so.

note.zh: 燕麦常混有麦类；忌麸质请选认证无麸质燕麦。
note.en: Oats are often mixed with wheat or barley; with a gluten allergy, choose certified gluten-free oats.

note.zh: 有的用黄油，有的用植物起酥油，看配料表。
note.en: Some are made with butter, some with vegetable shortening; check the label.

note.zh: 速冻的芝麻馅有的加了花生、黄油或小麦淀粉，过敏的话看包装。
note.en: Some frozen sesame fillings add peanuts, butter or wheat starch — with an allergy, check the pack.

note.zh: 大多数荞麦面掺了小麦粉；忌麸质请选百分百荞麦做的。
note.en: Most soba is made with some wheat flour; with a gluten allergy, choose 100% buckwheat soba.

note.zh: 二八酱是两成芝麻、八成花生。
note.en: Some blends (二八酱) are mostly peanut.

note.zh: 酒酿含少量酒精，煮过也还剩一点；有的酒曲用了麦类，忌麸质要看配料。
note.en: Jiuniang holds a little alcohol, some even after cooking; some starters use wheat — with a gluten allergy, check the label.

note.zh: 花生油含花生过敏原；忌花生请换用其他油。
note.en: Peanut oil counts as peanut; use another oil if you avoid peanuts.

note.zh: 汤块和浓汤宝常含小麦、牛奶或大豆，买前看配料。
note.en: Stock cubes often hold wheat, milk or soy; check the label.

note.zh: 速溶高汤粉常含乳糖、大豆或小麦，买前看配料。
note.en: Instant dashi often holds lactose, soy or wheat; check the label.

note.zh: 多数面汁用了鲣鱼和酱油，过敏的话看配料。
note.en: Most mentsuyu is made with bonito and soy sauce — with an allergy, check the label.

summary.zh: 最家常的下饭菜：鸡蛋嫩滑，番茄炒出酸甜的汁。
summary.en: The everyday classic — soft eggs in a sweet-sour tomato sauce, made for rice.

steps.zh: 番茄洗净切小块；鸡蛋打散，加一小撮盐。
steps.en: Wash the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅烧热，倒入较多的油，下蛋液，稍凝固就炒散，盛出备用。
steps.en: Heat the wok, add a generous splash of oil and pour in the eggs; as soon as they set, break them up and set aside.

steps.zh: 锅里留少许油，下番茄中火翻炒，炒出汁水；喜欢酸甜可以加少许糖。
steps.en: Keep a little oil in the wok and stir-fry the tomatoes over medium heat until juicy; add a little sugar if you like it sweet and sour.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻匀，加盐调味，撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss, season with salt and finish with spring onion.

summary.zh: 鸡丁滑嫩，糊辣荔枝味，花生香脆，四川家常名菜。
summary.en: Tender diced chicken in a sweet, tangy, gently numbing sauce with crunchy peanuts.

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切 1.5 厘米小丁，加一小撮盐、1 茶匙生抽、料酒和 1 茶匙淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Dice the chicken into 1.5 cm cubes and mix with a pinch of salt, 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and 1 tsp cornflour; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 调碗汁：剩下的生抽、醋、糖、1 茶匙淀粉和 2 汤匙水搅匀。干辣椒剪段去籽，葱切段，姜蒜切片。
steps.en: Stir the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar, sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 2 tbsp water. Snip the chillies and shake out the seeds; cut the spring onion into short lengths and slice the ginger and garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火下花椒和干辣椒炒香，辣椒变成深红色就好，别炒糊。
steps.en: Warm the oil in the wok over low heat and fry the peppercorns and chillies until fragrant and dark red, without letting them burn.

steps.zh: 转大火下鸡丁炒散，变白后加姜、蒜和葱段炒香。
steps.en: Turn the heat to high, add the chicken and stir-fry until it turns white; add the ginger, garlic and spring onion.

steps.zh: 倒入碗汁炒到浓稠发亮，关火拌入花生即可。
steps.en: Pour in the sauce and toss until thick and glossy; turn off the heat and stir in the peanuts.

summary.zh: 没有鱼的鱼香味：咸甜酸辣兼备，肉丝滑嫩，配菜爽脆。
summary.en: The classic "fish-fragrant" sauce with no fish — salty, sweet, sour and a little hot — over silky pork.

steps.zh: 木耳提前 30 分钟用冷水泡发，切丝。肉丝加一小撮盐、1 茶匙生抽、料酒和 1 茶匙淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Soak the wood ear in cold water for 30 minutes, then shred it. Mix the pork with a pinch of salt, 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and 1 tsp cornflour; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 胡萝卜、青椒切丝，葱姜蒜切末。糖、醋、剩下的生抽、1 茶匙淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成鱼香汁。
steps.en: Cut the carrot and pepper into strips and mince the spring onion, ginger and garlic. Stir the sugar, vinegar, the rest of the soy sauce, 1 tsp cornflour and 3 tbsp water into a sauce.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，大火下肉丝迅速划散，变色就盛出。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over high heat, add the pork and separate the strips quickly; take them out as soon as they change colour.

steps.zh: 留底油转小火，下豆瓣酱炒出红油，再加姜蒜末炒香。
steps.en: Lower the heat, fry the chilli bean paste in the remaining oil until the oil turns red, then add the ginger and garlic.

steps.zh: 放木耳、胡萝卜和青椒大火翻炒 1 分钟，倒回肉丝，淋入鱼香汁炒匀，撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Add the wood ear, carrot and pepper and stir-fry over high heat for a minute; return the pork, pour in the sauce, toss and finish with spring onion.

summary.zh: 十分钟的快手菜：肉丝嫩，青椒脆，咸香下饭。
summary.en: A ten-minute stir-fry of tender pork and crisp green pepper.

steps.zh: 肉丝加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒、淀粉和 1 茶匙油抓匀，腌 10 分钟。青椒去籽切丝，蒜切片。
steps.en: Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, the cornflour and 1 tsp oil; leave for 10 minutes. Seed the peppers and cut them into strips; slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，下肉丝炒散到变色，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok with the oil and stir-fry the pork until it changes colour; take it out.

steps.zh: 锅中补少许油，下蒜片和青椒丝大火炒 1 分钟到断生，撒少许盐。
steps.en: Add a little more oil and stir-fry the garlic and pepper over high heat for a minute, until just tender; season with a little salt.

steps.zh: 倒回肉丝，加剩下的生抽翻匀即可；想颜色深一点可以加几滴老抽。
steps.en: Return the pork with the rest of the soy sauce and toss; a few drops of dark soy sauce deepen the colour.

summary.zh: 大火爆炒，牛肉嫩滑，葱香浓郁。
summary.en: Thin slices of beef seared fast over high heat with plenty of spring onion.

steps.zh: 牛肉片加生抽、料酒、糖、白胡椒、淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓匀，再拌入 1 茶匙油，腌 15 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the beef with the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, white pepper, cornflour and 1 tbsp water, then stir in 1 tsp oil; leave for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 葱斜切成段，葱白和葱绿分开放。
steps.en: Cut the spring onions diagonally into lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart.

steps.zh: 锅烧到冒烟再放油，下牛肉大火快炒到七八成熟，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, add the oil and sear the beef over high heat until nearly done; take it out.

steps.zh: 余油下葱白爆香，倒回牛肉和葱绿，加蚝油大火翻炒 30 秒，滴几滴香油出锅。
steps.en: Fry the white parts of the spring onion in the remaining oil, return the beef with the green parts and the oyster sauce, toss over high heat for 30 seconds and finish with a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 麻、辣、烫、香、嫩：豆腐裹着红亮的肉末酱汁，最下饭。
summary.en: Silky tofu in a glossy, numbing-hot sauce of chilli bean paste and minced pork.

steps.zh: 豆腐切 2 厘米方块，放进加了少许盐的开水里煮 1 分钟，捞出沥干，这样不容易碎。
steps.en: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and simmer them for a minute in salted boiling water, then drain; this keeps them from breaking.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，下肉末炒散炒干，加豆瓣酱和豆豉，小火炒出红油，再加姜蒜末和辣椒粉炒香。
steps.en: Fry the mince in the oil until dry and crumbly; add the chilli bean paste and black beans and fry gently until the oil turns red, then the ginger, garlic and chilli flakes.

steps.zh: 加 150 毫升水和生抽烧开，轻轻放入豆腐，中小火煮 3–4 分钟入味，用锅铲推动锅底，别翻炒。
steps.en: Add 150 ml water and the soy sauce, bring to the boil and slide in the tofu; simmer for 3–4 minutes, nudging the bottom of the pan rather than stirring.

steps.zh: 淀粉加 2 汤匙水调匀，分两三次淋入，轻推到汤汁浓稠包住豆腐。
steps.en: Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water and add it in two or three goes, nudging until the sauce thickens around the tofu.

steps.zh: 出锅撒花椒粉和葱花。
steps.en: Finish with the ground Sichuan pepper and spring onion.

name.en: Steamed fish with ginger & spring onion

summary.zh: 最能吃出鱼鲜的做法：大火快蒸，淋豉油，浇热油。
summary.en: The way to taste a fresh fish — steamed fast, dressed with soy sauce and sizzling oil.

note.en: about 600 g; sea bass or snapper
or seasoned soy sauce for fish

steps.zh: 鱼处理干净擦干，两面各划几刀，抹上料酒；鱼肚里和盘底垫几片姜和葱段。
steps.en: Pat the cleaned fish dry, score both sides and rub with the Shaoxing wine; tuck slices of ginger and spring onion inside and under it.

steps.zh: 水烧开后放鱼，大火蒸 8–10 分钟（约 600 克的鱼），筷子能轻松插进最厚处就好。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water on high for 8–10 minutes for a 600 g fish, until a chopstick slides easily into the thickest part.

steps.zh: 倒掉盘里的腥水，拣去姜葱，铺上新切的葱丝和姜丝，喜欢的话加香菜。
steps.en: Pour off the liquid, discard the cooked ginger and spring onion and top with fresh shreds of both, and coriander if you like.

steps.zh: 生抽加糖和 2 汤匙热水调匀，淋在鱼的周围。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce with the sugar and 2 tbsp hot water and pour it around the fish.

steps.zh: 油烧到冒烟，浇在葱姜丝上即可。
steps.en: Heat the oil until it smokes and pour it over the shreds so they sizzle.

summary.zh: 虾头里的虾油是灵魂，汁浓红亮，咸甜鲜香。
summary.en: Shell-on prawns braised in their own rich red oil with a sweet-savoury glaze.

steps.zh: 大虾剪去虾须和虾枪，从背部剪开，挑出虾线，洗净沥干。
steps.en: Trim the feelers and spikes, cut along the back to pull out the vein, rinse and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下姜片和葱段炒香，放虾两面煎到变红，用锅铲压虾头挤出虾油。
steps.en: Fry the ginger and spring onion in the oil over medium heat, add the prawns and cook until red on both sides, pressing the heads to release their oil.

steps.zh: 加料酒、生抽、糖（和番茄酱）、3 汤匙水，盖上盖小火焖 3–4 分钟。
steps.en: Add the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, sugar (and ketchup) with 3 tbsp water; cover and braise gently for 3–4 minutes.

steps.zh: 开盖大火收汁，汤汁红亮浓稠时加盐调味出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat until the sauce is thick and glossy; season with salt.

summary.zh: 孩子最爱：可乐代替糖，收出甜咸红亮的酱汁。
summary.en: A family favourite — cola stands in for sugar and cooks down to a sticky, glossy glaze.

steps.zh: 鸡翅两面各划两刀，冷水下锅，加两片姜和料酒煮开，撇去浮沫后捞出，洗净沥干。
steps.en: Score each wing twice on both sides. Put them in cold water with two slices of ginger and the Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil, skim, then rinse and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放少许油，鸡翅皮朝下，中火煎到两面金黄。
steps.en: Fry the wings skin side down in a little oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.

steps.zh: 加剩下的姜片、葱段、生抽和老抽，倒入可乐没过鸡翅，烧开后转小火盖盖煮 15 分钟。
steps.en: Add the rest of the ginger, the spring onion, soy sauce and dark soy, pour in cola to cover, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 开盖大火收汁，不停翻动，汤汁浓稠挂在鸡翅上即可；最后尝一下再决定加不加盐。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat, turning the wings, until the glaze clings to them; taste before adding any salt.

summary.zh: 记住"1 料酒、2 生抽、3 糖、4 醋"，酸甜红亮，冷吃热吃都好。
summary.en: Remember 1-2-3-4 — wine, soy, sugar, vinegar — for glossy ribs that are good hot or cold.

steps.zh: 排骨冷水下锅，加姜片和一点料酒煮开，撇去浮沫，捞出洗净沥干。
steps.en: Put the ribs in cold water with the ginger and a splash of Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil, skim, then rinse and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，下排骨中火煎到表面微黄。
steps.en: Brown the ribs in the oil over medium heat.

steps.zh: 按"1 料酒、2 生抽、3 糖、4 醋"（汤匙）加入调料和老抽，加水刚好没过排骨。
steps.en: Add the seasonings in the 1-2-3-4 ratio in tablespoons — wine, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar — plus the dark soy, and water just to cover.

steps.zh: 烧开后转小火，盖盖炖 35–40 分钟，到排骨软烂。
steps.en: Bring to the boil, then simmer covered for 35–40 minutes until tender.

steps.zh: 开盖大火收汁，汤汁浓稠发亮时撒芝麻出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat until thick and glossy; scatter with sesame seeds.

summary.zh: 糖色炒出红亮，小火慢炖到肥而不腻、入口即化。
summary.en: Pork belly glazed with caramelised rock sugar and braised slowly until it melts.

steps.zh: 五花肉冷水下锅，加 1 汤匙料酒和两片姜煮开，撇去浮沫，捞出洗净沥干。
steps.en: Put the pork in cold water with 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine and two slices of ginger, bring to the boil, skim, then rinse and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火放冰糖慢慢炒化，炒到枣红色、冒小泡，这就是糖色，别炒过头发苦。
steps.en: Melt the rock sugar in the oil over low heat and keep stirring until it turns a deep red-brown and bubbles; stop before it burns and turns bitter.

steps.zh: 立刻倒入五花肉翻炒上色，加姜片、葱段、八角、桂皮和香叶炒香。
steps.en: Tip in the pork at once and toss to coat, then add the ginger, spring onion, star anise, cinnamon and bay leaves.

steps.zh: 加剩下的料酒、生抽和老抽，倒入热水没过肉，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 60 分钟。
steps.en: Add the rest of the wine, the soy sauce and dark soy, pour in hot water to cover, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 60 minutes.

steps.zh: 开盖大火收汁，汤汁浓稠、包住肉块即可，最后尝一下再加盐。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat until the sauce coats the pork; taste before adding salt.

summary.zh: 牛腩炖到软烂，土豆吸饱汤汁，周末慢炖的一锅。
summary.en: Brisket simmered until tender, with potatoes that soak up the rich broth — a weekend pot.

steps.zh: 牛肉冷水下锅，加 1 汤匙料酒和两片姜煮开，撇去浮沫，捞出洗净。
steps.en: Put the beef in cold water with 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine and two slices of ginger, bring to the boil, skim, then rinse.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，下姜片、葱段和八角炒香，加牛肉翻炒，再加剩下的料酒、生抽、老抽和冰糖炒匀上色。
steps.en: Fry the ginger, spring onion and star anise in the oil, add the beef and toss, then add the rest of the wine, the soy sauce, dark soy and rock sugar.

steps.zh: 倒入热水没过牛肉 3 厘米，加香叶，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 60–80 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透。
steps.en: Pour in hot water to 3 cm above the beef, add the bay leaves, bring to the boil and simmer covered for 60–80 minutes, until a chopstick goes through easily.

steps.zh: 土豆、胡萝卜和洋葱切滚刀块放入，再炖 20–25 分钟到土豆变软。
steps.en: Add the potatoes, carrot and onion in chunks and simmer another 20–25 minutes, until the potatoes are soft.

steps.zh: 开盖收汁到喜欢的浓稠度，加盐调味即可。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce to the thickness you like; season with salt.

summary.zh: 先焯后炒，翠绿脆嫩，蒜香十足，只用一点油。
summary.en: Blanched, then tossed with garlic in very little oil — bright green and crisp.

steps.zh: 西兰花切小朵，用淡盐水泡 10 分钟后冲洗干净；蒜切末。
steps.en: Cut the broccoli into small florets, soak in lightly salted water for 10 minutes and rinse; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 水烧开，加一小撮盐和几滴油，放西兰花焯 1 分钟，捞出沥干。
steps.en: Blanch the florets for a minute in boiling water with a pinch of salt and a few drops of oil; drain well.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火炒香蒜末，别炒焦。
steps.en: Fry the garlic gently in the oil until fragrant, without browning it.

steps.zh: 下西兰花大火翻炒 30 秒，加盐调味，喜欢可以加一点蚝油。
steps.en: Add the broccoli, toss over high heat for 30 seconds and season with salt, or a little oyster sauce.

summary.zh: 洗去淀粉的土豆丝大火快炒，酸辣爽脆。
summary.en: Fine potato shreds, rinsed of starch and stir-fried fast — crunchy, tangy and a little hot.

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切细丝，泡在清水里洗两遍，洗掉表面的淀粉，沥干，这样炒出来才脆。
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into fine shreds and rinse twice in cold water to wash off the starch; drain well so they stay crisp.

steps.zh: 干辣椒剪段，蒜切片。
steps.en: Snip the dried chillies into pieces and slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，小火下花椒炸香后捞出，再放辣椒段和蒜片炒香。
steps.en: Heat the oil, fry the Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant and lift them out, then fry the chillies and garlic.

steps.zh: 转大火下土豆丝快速翻炒 1–2 分钟，沿锅边淋入醋，加盐和少许糖翻匀，断生即出锅，撒葱花。
steps.en: Add the potato over high heat and toss for 1–2 minutes; splash the vinegar down the side of the wok, season with salt and a little sugar and take it off while still crisp. Scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 用手撕的包菜更入味，大火炒到边缘微焦，香辣带醋香。
summary.en: Cabbage torn by hand and seared until charred at the edges, with chilli and a dash of vinegar.

steps.zh: 包菜用手撕成小块，粗梗用刀背拍一下，洗净后沥干；蒜切片，干辣椒剪段。
steps.en: Tear the cabbage into small pieces, bruise the thick ribs with the back of a knife, rinse and drain well; slice the garlic and snip the chillies.

steps.zh: 锅烧到很热再放油，下花椒、干辣椒和蒜片炒香。
steps.en: Get the wok very hot, add the oil and fry the peppercorns, chillies and garlic until fragrant.

steps.zh: 下包菜大火快炒，炒到边缘微焦、叶子变软。
steps.en: Add the cabbage and stir-fry over high heat until the edges char and the leaves soften.

steps.zh: 沿锅边淋入醋和生抽，加糖和盐翻匀出锅。
steps.en: Splash the vinegar and soy sauce down the side of the wok, add the sugar and salt, toss and serve.

name.en: Blanched choy sum with soy dressing

summary.zh: 广东人的家常青菜：焯得翠绿，淋豉油，浇一勺热油。
summary.en: The Cantonese everyday greens — blanched bright green, dressed with soy sauce and a spoon of hot oil.

steps.zh: 菜心洗净，粗的梗从中间剖开；蒜切末。
steps.en: Wash the choy sum and split any thick stems; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 生抽、糖和 2 汤匙水调成汁。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 一大锅水烧开，加一小撮盐和几滴油，放菜心焯 1–2 分钟到翠绿变软，捞出摆盘。
steps.en: Blanch the greens for 1–2 minutes in a large pot of boiling water with a pinch of salt and a few drops of oil, until bright and just tender; lay them on a plate.

steps.zh: 蒜末铺在菜心上，淋上调好的汁，把油烧热浇在蒜末上即可。
steps.en: Top with the garlic, pour over the dressing and finish with the oil, heated until hot, over the garlic.

summary.zh: 三分钟上桌：生菜一烫即起，浇上蒜香蚝油汁。
summary.en: On the table in three minutes — lettuce dipped in boiling water and glazed with garlicky oyster sauce.

steps.zh: 生菜一片片掰开洗净，蒜切末。
steps.en: Separate the lettuce leaves and wash them; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 蚝油、生抽、糖、淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成汁。
steps.en: Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, cornflour and 3 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 水烧开加几滴油，生菜焯 10–20 秒变软就捞出，沥干摆盘。
steps.en: Dip the lettuce into boiling water with a few drops of oil for 10–20 seconds, just until it wilts; drain and lay on a plate.

steps.zh: 锅里放油炒香蒜末，倒入调好的汁煮到浓稠，浇在生菜上。
steps.en: Fry the garlic in the oil, pour in the sauce, let it bubble until thick and spoon it over the lettuce.

summary.zh: 四季豆煸到起皱焦香，配肉末和干辣椒，越嚼越香。
summary.en: Green beans fried until blistered and wrinkled, tossed with chilli, Sichuan pepper and a little pork.

steps.zh: 四季豆撕去老筋，掰成 5–6 厘米段，洗净后一定要擦干。
steps.en: String the beans, snap them into 5–6 cm lengths, wash and dry them thoroughly.

steps.zh: 锅里放 3 汤匙油，中火下四季豆慢慢煸 6–8 分钟，到表皮起皱、微微焦黄，盛出。四季豆一定要彻底熟透才能吃。
steps.en: Fry the beans in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, until blistered, wrinkled and lightly browned; take them out. Green beans must be cooked right through before eating.

steps.zh: 锅里留少许油，下肉末炒干炒香，加花椒、干辣椒段、姜蒜末和榨菜末炒香。
steps.en: In the remaining oil, fry the mince until dry and fragrant, then the peppercorns, chillies, garlic, ginger and zha cai.

steps.zh: 倒回四季豆，加生抽、糖和盐大火翻炒均匀即可。
steps.en: Return the beans with the soy sauce, sugar and salt and toss over high heat.

summary.zh: 东北名菜：土豆、茄子、青椒，煎香后裹上咸鲜酱汁。
summary.en: A north-eastern classic — potato, eggplant and green pepper, fried golden and glazed in a savoury sauce.

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切滚刀块，茄子切滚刀块，青椒掰成小块；蒜切末。
steps.en: Cut the peeled potato and the eggplant into wedge-shaped chunks, tear the pepper into pieces and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 生抽、蚝油、糖、淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成碗汁。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, cornflour and 3 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅里放 3 汤匙油，中火把土豆块煎到金黄熟透，盛出；加剩下的油把茄子煎到软塌，盛出。
steps.en: Fry the potato in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through; take it out. Fry the eggplant in the rest of the oil until soft; take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里留少许油炒香蒜末，倒回土豆、茄子和青椒，淋入碗汁大火翻匀，汤汁浓稠即可。
steps.en: Fry the garlic in the oil left in the wok, return the potato and eggplant with the pepper, pour in the sauce and toss over high heat until it thickens.

summary.zh: 一拍一拌就上桌的凉菜，蒜香醋香，清爽解腻。
summary.en: Smashed, salted and dressed with garlic and vinegar — the crunchy cold dish that cuts through rich food.

steps.zh: 黄瓜洗净，用刀背拍裂，再切成小段，加 ½ 茶匙盐拌匀，腌 10 分钟后倒掉渗出的水。
steps.en: Smash the cucumbers with the flat of a knife, cut them into short pieces, toss with ½ tsp salt and leave for 10 minutes; pour off the water.

steps.zh: 蒜拍碎切末。
steps.en: Crush and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 蒜末、醋、生抽、糖和香油调成汁，喜欢辣的再加辣椒油。
steps.en: Mix the garlic with the vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil, plus chilli oil if you like heat.

steps.zh: 汁倒在黄瓜上拌匀，撒香菜即可，现拌现吃最脆。
steps.en: Toss the cucumber in the dressing and scatter with coriander; it is crunchiest eaten straight away.

summary.zh: 鸡蛋嫩，韭菜香，大火快炒不出水。
summary.en: Soft eggs and fragrant garlic chives, stir-fried fast so the chives stay bright.

steps.zh: 韭菜择洗干净，沥干后切 3 厘米段；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Wash and drain the chives and cut them into 3 cm lengths; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1½ 汤匙油，倒入蛋液炒到刚凝固，盛出。
steps.en: Scramble the eggs in 1½ tbsp oil until just set; take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，大火下韭菜翻炒 30 秒到稍软，加盐。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the chives over high heat for 30 seconds, until barely soft; season with salt.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻匀，立刻出锅，韭菜炒久了会出水变老。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss and serve at once; chives cooked too long go watery and tough.

summary.zh: 十五分钟的家常汤：番茄酸甜，蛋花轻盈。
summary.en: A fifteen-minute soup of sweet-sour tomato and silky ribbons of egg.

steps.zh: 番茄切小块，想去皮可以先用开水烫一下；鸡蛋打散；淀粉加 2 汤匙水调匀。
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into small pieces (scald them first if you want them peeled); beat the eggs; mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅里放少许油，下番茄炒出汁，加 600 毫升水烧开，煮 3 分钟。
steps.en: Fry the tomatoes in the oil until juicy, add 600 ml water, bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.zh: 淋入水淀粉搅匀，让汤稍微变稠。
steps.en: Stir in the cornflour mixture to thicken the soup slightly.

steps.zh: 转小火，蛋液顺着筷子细细淋入，等几秒再轻轻推开，就是漂亮的蛋花。
steps.en: Turn the heat down and pour the egg in a thin stream along a chopstick; wait a few seconds, then stir gently so it forms ribbons.

steps.zh: 加盐和白胡椒调味，撒葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Season with salt and white pepper and finish with spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 十分钟就好的鲜汤，紫菜一泡就软，加点虾皮更鲜。
summary.en: A ten-minute broth of laver and egg; a few dried shrimp make it sing.

steps.zh: 紫菜撕成小片；鸡蛋打散。
steps.en: Tear the laver into small pieces and beat the eggs.

steps.zh: 600 毫升水烧开，喜欢的话加虾皮一起煮 1 分钟提鲜。
steps.en: Bring 600 ml water to the boil, with the dried shrimp for a minute if you have them.

steps.zh: 放入紫菜，再次烧开后转小火，蛋液细细淋入，等几秒再轻推成蛋花。
steps.en: Add the laver, bring back to the boil, then lower the heat and pour in the egg in a thin stream; wait a few seconds before stirring gently.

steps.zh: 加盐（和生抽）调味，滴香油，撒葱花和白胡椒粉。
steps.en: Season with salt (and soy sauce), and finish with sesame oil, spring onion and white pepper.

summary.zh: 小火慢炖的清汤，玉米清甜，排骨软嫩。
summary.en: A clear, slow-simmered soup — sweet corn and tender pork ribs.

steps.zh: 排骨冷水下锅，加一片姜和料酒煮开，撇去浮沫，捞出洗净。
steps.en: Put the ribs in cold water with a slice of ginger and the Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil, skim, then rinse.

steps.zh: 玉米切段，胡萝卜切滚刀块。
steps.en: Cut the corn into rounds and the carrot into chunks.

steps.zh: 排骨和剩下的姜片放进汤锅，加约 2 升清水，大火烧开后转小火炖 50 分钟。
steps.en: Put the ribs and the rest of the ginger in a pot with about 2 litres of water, bring to the boil and simmer for 50 minutes.

steps.zh: 加入玉米和胡萝卜，再炖 25 分钟。
steps.en: Add the corn and carrot and simmer another 25 minutes.

steps.zh: 出锅前再加盐调味，太早放盐肉会发紧；撒葱花。
steps.en: Salt only at the end — salting early toughens the meat — and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 南瓜和洋葱煮软打成浓汤，香甜顺滑。
summary.en: Pumpkin and onion simmered soft and blended until velvety.

steps.zh: 南瓜切块，洋葱切丁。
steps.en: Cut the pumpkin into chunks and dice the onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放黄油，小火把洋葱炒软，约 5 分钟，再加南瓜翻炒 2 分钟。
steps.en: Soften the onion in the butter over low heat for about 5 minutes, then add the pumpkin and stir for 2 minutes.

steps.zh: 倒入高汤或水没过南瓜，烧开后小火煮 20 分钟，到南瓜软烂。
steps.en: Pour in stock or water to cover, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes, until the pumpkin is very soft.

steps.zh: 稍凉后用搅拌机打成细滑的汤，倒回锅里加热。
steps.en: Let it cool a little, blend until smooth and reheat in the pot.

steps.zh: 加盐和黑胡椒调味，喜欢浓郁可以拌入淡奶油。
steps.en: Season with salt and pepper, and stir in the cream for a richer soup.

summary.zh: 电饭煲煮饭的要点：淘米别太用力，水量看米的新旧。
summary.en: Rice-cooker rice done right — rinse gently and adjust the water to the rice.

steps.zh: 大米用清水轻轻淘洗两三遍，到水不太浑。
steps.en: Rinse the rice gently two or three times, until the water is fairly clear.

steps.zh: 按 1 杯米配约 1.2 杯水放进电饭煲；新米水少放一点，糙米要多放。
steps.en: Add about 1.2 cups of water per cup of rice — a little less for new-crop rice, more for brown rice.

steps.zh: 按下煮饭键，跳到保温后再焖 10 分钟，用饭勺翻松即可。
steps.en: Cook, then leave it on keep-warm for 10 minutes before fluffing with the paddle.

summary.zh: 上海味道：小葱慢慢熬出焦香葱油，拌上酱汁就是一碗好面。
summary.en: Shanghai-style — spring onions fried slowly into a fragrant oil, then tossed through noodles with soy.

steps.zh: 小葱洗净擦干，切成 5 厘米段，葱白和葱绿分开。
steps.en: Wash and dry the spring onions and cut them into 5 cm lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart.

steps.zh: 锅里放 4 汤匙油，小火先放葱白，再放葱绿，慢慢熬 8–10 分钟，到葱段焦黄干脆；火大了会发苦。
steps.en: Put the whites into 4 tbsp oil over low heat, then the greens, and fry slowly for 8–10 minutes until dark golden and crisp; too much heat makes them bitter.

steps.zh: 捞出葱段，趁油热倒入生抽、老抽和糖，小火煮到冒泡出香味就关火，这就是葱油汁。
steps.en: Lift out the onions, add the soy sauce, dark soy and sugar to the hot oil and let it bubble until fragrant; that is the scallion oil sauce.

steps.zh: 面条按包装说明煮熟，沥干，拌入 2–3 汤匙葱油汁，放上炸好的葱段。
steps.en: Cook the noodles as the packet says, drain and toss with 2–3 tbsp of the sauce; top with the fried onions.

summary.zh: 粉糯的土豆煮软压泥，拌黄油和热牛奶，绵密顺滑。
summary.en: Floury potatoes boiled soft and mashed with butter and warm milk.

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切块，冷水下锅，加一小撮盐，煮 15–20 分钟到筷子能轻松插透。
steps.en: Peel and cut the potatoes, put them in cold salted water and boil for 15–20 minutes, until a chopstick slides in easily.

steps.zh: 倒掉水，土豆留在锅里小火烘 1 分钟，让多余的水分蒸发。
steps.en: Drain, then leave them in the pot over low heat for a minute to steam dry.

steps.zh: 加黄油，用压泥器或叉子压成泥，分次加入温牛奶，拌到顺滑。
steps.en: Mash with the butter, then beat in the warm milk a little at a time until smooth.

steps.zh: 加盐和黑胡椒调味。
steps.en: Season with salt and pepper.

summary.zh: 抹上蒜香黄油烤到金黄酥脆，配汤和意面都合适。
summary.en: Bread spread with garlic butter and baked until golden — good with soup or pasta.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C.

steps.zh: 软化的黄油加蒜末、切碎的欧芹和一小撮盐拌匀。
steps.en: Mix the soft butter with the minced garlic, chopped parsley and a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 面包切厚片，抹上蒜香黄油，铺在烤盘上。
steps.en: Spread the garlic butter on thick slices of bread and lay them on a tray.

steps.zh: 烤 8–10 分钟到边缘金黄酥脆，趁热吃。
steps.en: Bake for 8–10 minutes until golden and crisp at the edges; eat hot.

summary.zh: 隔夜米饭最好炒，粒粒分明裹着蛋香，一个人也能吃得好。
summary.en: Day-old rice fried with egg until every grain is separate — a good meal even for one.

note.zh: 煮好的米饭，最好是隔夜饭

steps.zh: 隔夜米饭用手抓散；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散；葱切葱花。
steps.en: Break up the cold rice with your hands, beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就用铲子划散成小块。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok, pour in the egg and break it into small curds as soon as it begins to set.

steps.zh: 马上倒入米饭，大火翻炒 3–4 分钟，把饭粒炒散、炒热，炒到粒粒分明。
steps.en: Add the rice straight away and stir-fry over high heat for 3–4 minutes, until hot and every grain is separate.

steps.zh: 加盐，喜欢的话加少许生抽和白胡椒，撒入葱花炒匀出锅。
steps.en: Season with salt, and a little soy sauce and white pepper if you like; toss in the spring onion and serve.

summary.zh: 番茄炒出汁做汤底，鸡蛋嫩，面条软滑，暖胃又快手。
summary.en: Noodles in a quick broth of fried tomato, with soft scrambled egg — warming and fast.

steps.zh: 番茄切小块，鸡蛋打散，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into small pieces, beat the eggs and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，倒入蛋液炒成大块，盛出。
steps.en: Scramble the eggs in the oil into large soft pieces; take them out.

steps.zh: 锅里补少许油，下番茄中火炒软出汁，加少许糖。
steps.en: Add a little more oil and cook the tomatoes over medium heat until soft and juicy, with a pinch of sugar.

steps.zh: 加 600 毫升水烧开，放面条按包装时间煮熟。
steps.en: Add 600 ml water, bring to the boil and cook the noodles in it for the time on the packet.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋，加盐和生抽调味，撒葱花。
steps.en: Return the eggs, season with salt and soy sauce and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 老北京味道：肉末黄酱慢慢炸香，拌面配黄瓜丝。
summary.en: The Beijing classic — pork and soybean paste fried slowly into a rich sauce, with cucumber over noodles.

steps.zh: 黄豆酱和甜面酱加 4 汤匙水调开；葱姜切末；黄瓜切细丝。
steps.en: Thin the soybean paste and sweet bean sauce with 4 tbsp water; mince the spring onion and ginger; cut the cucumber into fine strips.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，下肉末炒散，炒到出油、微微焦香，加料酒和葱姜末。
steps.en: Fry the mince in the oil until it releases its fat and browns a little; add the Shaoxing wine, spring onion and ginger.

steps.zh: 转小火倒入调好的酱，不停翻炒 8–10 分钟，到酱汁浓稠、油和酱分开，小心溅油；可以加少许糖。
steps.en: Lower the heat, add the paste and keep stirring for 8–10 minutes, until thick and the oil separates (it spits); add a little sugar if you like.

steps.zh: 面条煮熟，过一下凉水（喜欢吃热的就不过），沥干盛碗。
steps.en: Cook the noodles and rinse them in cold water, or not if you want them hot; drain into bowls.

steps.zh: 浇上炸酱，码上黄瓜丝（和焯过的豆芽），拌匀吃。
steps.en: Top with the sauce, the cucumber (and blanched bean sprouts) and toss before eating.

summary.zh: 蔬菜丁和牛肉末加番茄慢炖成浓郁肉酱，大人孩子都爱。
summary.en: Beef mince and soft vegetables simmered slowly with tomatoes into a rich sauce everyone likes.

steps.zh: 洋葱、胡萝卜和芹菜切小丁，蒜切末。
steps.en: Finely dice the onion, carrot and celery and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放橄榄油，中小火把洋葱、胡萝卜和芹菜炒软，约 8 分钟，再加蒜末炒香。
steps.en: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the olive oil over medium-low heat for about 8 minutes, then add the garlic.

steps.zh: 转大火下牛肉末炒散到变色，加番茄膏炒 1 分钟。
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add the mince and break it up until browned; stir in the tomato paste for a minute.

steps.zh: 倒入番茄罐头，用勺子压碎，加香草和香叶，小火盖盖慢炖 25–30 分钟，偶尔搅拌，加盐和黑胡椒调味。
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, crushing them with a spoon, plus the herbs and bay leaf; cover and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes, stirring now and then. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 意面放进加了盐的开水里，按包装时间煮熟，捞出拌入肉酱，撒帕玛森芝士。
steps.en: Boil the spaghetti in salted water for the time on the packet, drain, toss with the sauce and grate over the parmesan.

summary.zh: 羊肉末蔬菜酱汁上盖一层土豆泥，烤到金黄；用牛肉末就是农舍派。
summary.en: Lamb mince and vegetables in gravy under a crust of mashed potato, baked golden; with beef it's cottage pie.

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切块，煮 15–20 分钟到软，沥干后加黄油和温牛奶压成泥，加盐调味。
steps.en: Boil the peeled, cut potatoes for 15–20 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the butter and warm milk; season with salt.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。洋葱和胡萝卜切小丁，蒜切末。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dice the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放油炒软洋葱和胡萝卜，下羊肉末大火炒到变色出油，倒掉多余的油。
steps.en: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil, add the lamb and brown it over high heat; pour off the excess fat.

steps.zh: 加蒜末、番茄膏和面粉炒 1 分钟，倒入高汤、伍斯特酱和香草，小火煮 10–15 分钟到浓稠，拌入豌豆，加盐和黑胡椒。
steps.en: Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and flour for a minute, add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and herbs and simmer for 10–15 minutes until thick; stir in the peas and season.

steps.zh: 肉馅倒进烤盘铺平，盖上土豆泥，用叉子划出纹路，烤 20–25 分钟到表面金黄。
steps.en: Spread the filling in a baking dish, cover with the mash, rough it up with a fork and bake for 20–25 minutes until golden.

summary.zh: 鱼皮煎到金黄酥脆，鱼肉还嫩，挤上柠檬汁就好。
summary.en: Crisp golden skin and tender flesh, finished with a squeeze of lemon.

note.zh: 带皮鱼排，每块约 150 克

steps.zh: 三文鱼用厨房纸擦干，两面撒盐和黑胡椒，放 5 分钟。
steps.en: Pat the salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper and leave for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 平底锅中火烧热放油，鱼皮朝下放入，用铲子轻压 10 秒，防止卷曲。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and lay the fillets in skin side down, pressing them flat for 10 seconds so they don't curl.

steps.zh: 煎 4–5 分钟到鱼皮金黄酥脆、鱼肉大约三分之二变色，翻面再煎 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Cook for 4–5 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the flesh has turned opaque two-thirds of the way up; turn and cook 1–2 minutes more.

steps.zh: 喜欢的话最后加黄油和拍扁的蒜，舀起融化的黄油淋在鱼上。
steps.en: If you like, add the butter and a crushed garlic clove at the end and spoon the melted butter over the fish.

steps.zh: 挤上柠檬汁即可。
steps.en: Squeeze over the lemon and serve.

summary.zh: 大火煎出焦香外壳，黄油、蒜和香草淋上去，静置后再切。
summary.en: A hard sear for a crust, basted with butter, garlic and herbs, then rested before slicing.

note.zh: 约 2.5 厘米厚，每块约 200 克
note.en: about 2.5 cm thick and 200 g each

steps.zh: 有时间的话，牛排提前 30 分钟从冰箱取出回温。用厨房纸擦干，两面撒盐和黑胡椒。
steps.en: If there is time, take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes ahead. Pat them dry and season both sides well.

steps.zh: 厚底平底锅大火烧到冒烟，放油，下牛排每面煎 2–3 分钟，约 2.5 厘米厚时是三分到五分熟。
steps.en: Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the oil and sear the steaks for 2–3 minutes a side — medium-rare to medium for 2.5 cm.

steps.zh: 转中火，加黄油、拍扁的蒜和香草，倾斜锅子，舀起黄油反复淋在牛排上 1 分钟。
steps.en: Lower the heat to medium, add the butter, crushed garlic and herbs, tilt the pan and spoon the butter over the steaks for a minute.

steps.zh: 取出静置 5 分钟再切，让肉汁回流。
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes before slicing so the juices settle.

summary.zh: 一个烤盘搞定一餐：鸡腿肉和蔬菜一起进烤箱，几乎不用管。
summary.en: Dinner on one tray — chicken and vegetables roast together while you do something else.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 210°C。土豆切 2 厘米块，彩椒和洋葱切大块，胡萝卜切条，蒜拍扁。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cut the potatoes into 2 cm chunks, the capsicum and onion into large pieces and the carrot into sticks; crush the garlic.

steps.zh: 蔬菜放进烤盘，加 1 汤匙橄榄油、盐、黑胡椒和一半香草拌匀，铺平。
steps.en: Toss the vegetables on a tray with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper and half the herbs; spread them out.

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉用剩下的橄榄油、红椒粉、香草、盐和黑胡椒抹匀，皮朝上放在蔬菜上。
steps.en: Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, the paprika, herbs, salt and pepper and lay it skin side up on the vegetables.

steps.zh: 烤 30–35 分钟，中途把蔬菜翻一次，到鸡皮金黄、鸡肉熟透，最厚处切开没有粉色。
steps.en: Roast for 30–35 minutes, turning the vegetables once, until the skin is golden and the thickest piece shows no pink.

steps.zh: 挤一点柠檬汁更清爽。
steps.en: A squeeze of lemon brightens it.

summary.zh: 当季蔬菜切块进烤箱，边缘微焦，甜味都烤出来了。
summary.en: Whatever vegetables are in season, roasted until caramelised at the edges.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 210°C。所有蔬菜切成差不多大小的块，2–3 厘米。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cut all the vegetables into similar 2–3 cm pieces.

steps.zh: 蔬菜放进烤盘，加橄榄油、盐、黑胡椒和香草拌匀，铺成一层；叠得太厚会出水，烤不上色。
steps.en: Toss them on a tray with the olive oil, salt, pepper and herbs and spread in a single layer; crowded vegetables steam instead of browning.

steps.zh: 烤 25–30 分钟，中途翻一次，到边缘微焦、南瓜软糯。
steps.en: Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until the edges char and the pumpkin is soft.

summary.zh: 爽脆的生菜拌浓郁的凯撒酱，配烤面包丁和帕玛森芝士。
summary.en: Crisp lettuce in a rich, garlicky dressing with crunchy croutons and parmesan.

steps.zh: 面包切 2 厘米小方块，拌少许橄榄油，放进 180°C 的烤箱烤 8–10 分钟，或在平底锅里煎到金黄酥脆。
steps.en: Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes, toss with a little olive oil and bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes, or fry in a pan, until golden and crisp.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋放进开水煮 1 分钟后捞出，取蛋黄放进碗里，这样比用生蛋黄更安心。
steps.en: Lower the egg into boiling water for one minute, then put the yolk in a bowl; this is safer than a raw yolk.

steps.zh: 蛋黄加蒜泥、压碎的鳀鱼、柠檬汁和伍斯特酱搅匀，慢慢加入剩下的橄榄油，边加边搅成浓稠的酱，拌入一半磨碎的帕玛森，加黑胡椒和少许盐。
steps.en: Whisk the yolk with the crushed garlic, mashed anchovies, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce, then whisk in the rest of the olive oil slowly until thick; stir in half the grated parmesan and season with pepper and a little salt.

steps.zh: 生菜洗净擦干，撕成大片，和酱汁拌匀。
steps.en: Wash and dry the lettuce, tear it into large pieces and toss with the dressing.

steps.zh: 撒上面包丁和剩下的帕玛森，喜欢的话加煎脆的培根碎。
steps.en: Top with the croutons, the rest of the parmesan and crisp bacon if you like.

summary.zh: 广式早餐经典：米粒煮开花，皮蛋入味，肉丝嫩滑。
summary.en: The Cantonese breakfast classic — rice simmered until it blooms, with century egg and tender pork.

steps.zh: 大米洗净，拌几滴油和一小撮盐，放 30 分钟，这样更容易煮出米油；也可以前一晚泡好。
steps.en: Rinse the rice and mix it with a few drops of oil and a pinch of salt; leave for 30 minutes (or overnight) so it breaks down into a creamy congee.

steps.zh: 瘦肉切丝，加少许盐和淀粉抓匀腌 15 分钟；皮蛋剥壳切小块；姜切丝。
steps.en: Mix the pork with a little salt and the cornflour and leave for 15 minutes; peel and chop the century eggs; shred the ginger.

steps.zh: 1.5 升水烧开，倒入大米和一半皮蛋，再开后转小火，半开着盖煮 40 分钟，常搅动防粘底。
steps.en: Bring 1.5 litres of water to the boil, add the rice and half the egg, then simmer with the lid ajar for 40 minutes, stirring often so it doesn't stick.

steps.zh: 粥变稠后放肉丝、姜丝和剩下的皮蛋，搅散，煮 5 分钟到肉熟。
steps.en: When thick, stir in the pork, ginger and the rest of the egg and cook for 5 minutes until the pork is done.

steps.zh: 加盐和白胡椒调味，撒葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Season with salt and white pepper and finish with spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 面糊加蛋和葱花，平底锅摊成薄饼，十几分钟的早餐。
summary.en: A thin batter of flour, egg and spring onion, swirled into pancakes in a frying pan.

steps.zh: 面粉加鸡蛋、约 200 毫升水和少许盐，搅成能流动、没有颗粒的面糊，拌入葱花。
steps.en: Whisk the flour, eggs, about 200 ml water and a little salt into a smooth, pourable batter; stir in the spring onion.

steps.zh: 平底锅刷一层薄油，中小火，舀一勺面糊，转动锅子摊成薄饼。
steps.en: Brush a frying pan with oil over medium-low heat, add a ladle of batter and swirl it into a thin pancake.

steps.zh: 表面凝固后翻面，再煎 1 分钟到两面微黄。
steps.en: When the top has set, turn it and cook another minute until lightly golden.

steps.zh: 做完全部面糊，可以卷上喜欢的酱或蔬菜。
steps.en: Repeat with the rest of the batter; roll the pancakes around a sauce or vegetables you like.

summary.zh: 嫩滑如布丁，关键是水量和过筛，早餐配菜都合适。
summary.en: As smooth as a pudding — the secret is the right amount of water and a sieve. Breakfast or a side.

note.zh: 温水，约为蛋液的 1.5 倍

steps.zh: 鸡蛋打散，加盐，再加约 1.5 倍蛋液量的温水（约 270 毫升）搅匀。
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the salt and stir in about one and a half times their volume of warm water, about 270 ml.

steps.zh: 蛋液过筛到碗里，撇去表面的气泡，盖上盘子或扎了小孔的保鲜膜。
steps.en: Strain into a bowl, skim off the bubbles and cover with a plate or pierced cling film.

steps.zh: 水开后放入，中小火蒸 10–12 分钟，到中间凝固、轻晃不流动。
steps.en: Steam over simmering water for 10–12 minutes, until the centre is set and wobbles but doesn't flow.

steps.zh: 淋上生抽和几滴香油，撒葱花。
steps.en: Drizzle with soy sauce and a few drops of sesame oil and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 小火慢推的嫩炒蛋，放在烤脆的吐司上。
summary.en: Soft scrambled eggs, cooked slowly over low heat, on crisp toast.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋加牛奶和一小撮盐打散。面包放进烤面包机或平底锅烤脆。
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt. Toast the bread.

steps.zh: 平底锅小火放黄油，融化后倒入蛋液。
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pan over low heat and pour in the eggs.

steps.zh: 用铲子从边缘往中间慢慢推，推成柔软的大块，还有点湿润就关火，余温会继续加热。
steps.en: Push the eggs slowly from the edges to the middle into soft folds; take them off the heat while still a little wet, as they keep cooking.

steps.zh: 炒蛋放在吐司上，撒黑胡椒。
steps.en: Pile onto the toast and grind over some pepper.

summary.zh: 周末早餐：面糊别搅过头，煎出来又厚又松软。
summary.en: A weekend breakfast — don't overmix the batter and they come out thick and fluffy.

steps.zh: 面粉、泡打粉、糖和一小撮盐在大碗里混合。
steps.en: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and a pinch of salt in a large bowl.

steps.zh: 另一个碗把鸡蛋、牛奶和融化的黄油搅匀，倒进面粉里，搅到刚好没有干粉，有小疙瘩没关系，别过度搅拌。
steps.en: Whisk the egg, milk and melted butter in another bowl, pour into the flour and stir just until no dry flour remains; a few lumps are fine.

steps.zh: 平底锅中小火，抹一点点黄油，舀一勺面糊，等表面冒出很多小泡、边缘凝固时翻面。
steps.en: Grease a pan lightly over medium-low heat, add a ladle of batter and turn when bubbles cover the top and the edges look set.

steps.zh: 再煎 1 分钟到两面金黄，淋枫糖浆吃。
steps.en: Cook another minute until golden on both sides; serve with maple syrup.

summary.zh: 前一晚花五分钟拌好，早上直接吃，全谷物早餐。
summary.en: Five minutes the night before, breakfast ready in the morning — whole grains with no cooking.

steps.zh: 燕麦和牛奶（可以再加酸奶）放进有盖的罐子或碗里拌匀，喜欢甜的加一点蜂蜜。
steps.en: Stir the oats and milk (and yoghurt) together in a jar or a bowl with a lid; add a little honey if you like it sweet.

steps.zh: 盖好放冰箱冷藏一夜，至少 6 小时，燕麦会吸饱牛奶变软。
steps.en: Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 6 hours, while the oats soak up the milk.

steps.zh: 早上拌一拌，放上香蕉片或其他水果，冷着吃或用微波炉加热都可以。
steps.en: In the morning, stir and top with sliced banana or other fruit; eat cold or warm it in the microwave.

how.zh: 前一晚装好放冰箱，早上拌一拌就能吃，冷藏最多放 2 天。
how.en: Made the night before and kept in the fridge, it is ready to stir and eat in the morning; it keeps up to 2 days.

summary.zh: 五花肉先煮后炒，煸到微微卷起，裹上浓浓的豆瓣酱香，配蒜苗最下饭。
summary.en: Pork belly boiled, sliced thin and fried until the edges curl, then tossed with chilli bean paste and garlic shoots.

steps.zh: 五花肉整块冷水下锅，加姜片、葱段和料酒，烧开后撇去浮沫，转中小火煮 20 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透、不冒血水。
steps.en: Put the pork belly in a pot of cold water with the ginger, spring onion and Shaoxing wine. Bring to the boil, skim, then simmer for 20 minutes, until a chopstick goes in easily and no pink juices run out.

steps.zh: 捞出放凉（泡一下冷水会更快），切成约 2 毫米厚的薄片。蒜苗斜切成段，蒜苗白和蒜苗叶分开放；豆豉切碎。
steps.en: Lift out the pork and let it cool (a dip in cold water speeds this up), then slice it about 2 mm thick. Cut the garlic shoots diagonally into lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart, and chop the black beans.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下肉片慢慢煸 3–4 分钟，到肥肉出油、肉片微微卷起成“灯盏窝”。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the pork over medium heat for 3–4 minutes, until the fat renders and the slices curl into little cups.

steps.zh: 把肉片推到锅边，转小火下豆瓣酱和豆豉，用锅里的油炒出红油，再加甜面酱，和肉片一起翻炒均匀。
steps.en: Push the pork to one side, lower the heat and fry the chilli bean paste and black beans in the fat until it turns red; add the sweet bean sauce and toss everything together.

steps.zh: 转大火，先下蒜苗白炒半分钟，再下蒜苗叶和糖，翻炒到蒜苗断生即可。
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add the white parts of the garlic shoots for 30 seconds, then the greens and the sugar, and toss until the shoots are just tender.

summary.zh: 青椒干煸到起皱焦香，再和嫩肉片同炒，咸香带辣，特别下饭。
summary.en: Green chillies dry-fried until blistered and smoky, then tossed with tender pork — salty, hot and made for rice.

note.en: thinly sliced; its fat adds flavour
small hot ones; for extra heat

steps.zh: 猪肉片加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒和淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。青椒斜切成段（菜椒就切粗条），蒜切片，小米辣切圈。
steps.en: Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and the cornflour and leave for 10 minutes. Cut the peppers diagonally into short lengths (capsicum into thick strips), and slice the garlic and the small chillies.

steps.zh: 锅烧热不放油，中火下青椒干煸 2–3 分钟，撒一小撮盐，用锅铲压一压，煸到表皮起皱、带点焦斑，盛出。
steps.en: Dry-fry the peppers in the hot wok, with no oil, over medium heat for 2–3 minutes with a pinch of salt, pressing them with the spatula until wrinkled and spotted brown; take them out.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，有五花肉的话先下锅煸出油，再下猪肉片大火炒散，炒到完全变色、熟透。
steps.en: Heat the oil and fry the pork belly first, if using, until it renders some fat; add the lean pork and stir-fry over high heat until it has changed colour all over and is cooked through.

steps.zh: 下蒜片、豆豉和小米辣炒香，倒回青椒，加剩下的生抽大火翻炒 1 分钟，尝一下咸淡再加盐出锅。
steps.en: Add the garlic, black beans and small chillies and fry until fragrant, then return the peppers with the rest of the soy sauce and toss over high heat for a minute; taste, add salt and serve.

summary.zh: 肉片上浆后在红亮的麻辣汤里一烫就熟，滑嫩鲜香，最后浇一勺热油，香气扑鼻。
summary.en: Silky pork slices poached in a fiery red broth and finished with a sizzle of hot oil over chilli and Sichuan pepper.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋取蛋清。肉片加一小撮盐、料酒、蛋清和淀粉抓匀上浆，腌 10 分钟。豆芽洗净沥干；蒜、姜切末，葱切葱花，干辣椒剪成段。
steps.en: Separate the egg and keep the white. Mix the pork with a pinch of salt, the Shaoxing wine, the egg white and the cornflour until coated, and leave for 10 minutes. Rinse and drain the bean sprouts; mince the garlic and ginger, chop the spring onion and snip the chillies into pieces.

steps.zh: 干锅小火焙干辣椒和花椒 2–3 分钟，到辣椒变成深红色、酥脆，盛出剁碎。
steps.en: Toast the chillies and Sichuan peppercorns in the dry wok over low heat for 2–3 minutes, until the chillies are dark red and crisp; tip them out and chop finely.

steps.zh: 锅里放 2 汤匙油，小火下豆瓣酱炒出红油，加一半蒜末和全部姜末炒香，倒入 400 毫升水和生抽烧开。
steps.en: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil over low heat and fry the chilli bean paste until the oil turns red; add half the garlic and all the ginger, then pour in 400 ml water and the soy sauce and bring to the boil.

steps.zh: 先下豆芽煮 1 分钟，捞出铺在深碗底。转小火，肉片一片片放进汤里，轻轻拨散，煮 2–3 分钟到全部变白、熟透，连汤倒在豆芽上。
steps.en: Cook the bean sprouts in the broth for a minute and lift them into a deep bowl. Lower the heat, slip in the pork a slice at a time, nudge the slices apart and simmer for 2–3 minutes until white and cooked through; pour the pork and broth over the sprouts.

steps.zh: 撒上剩下的蒜末、剁碎的辣椒花椒和辣椒粉。剩下的 2 汤匙油烧到冒烟，小心地浇在上面激出香味，撒葱花即可。
steps.en: Scatter over the rest of the garlic, the chopped chilli and peppercorns and the chilli flakes. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil until it smokes, pour it carefully over the top so it sizzles and finish with the spring onion.

name.en: Shredded pork in sweet bean sauce

summary.zh: 老北京家常菜：肉丝裹满浓郁的甜面酱，铺在清爽的葱丝上，酱香咸甜。
summary.en: A Beijing home classic — tender pork strips glazed in rich sweet bean sauce on a nest of crisp spring onion.

note.zh: 取葱白切细丝；大葱最好
note.en: white parts finely shredded; thick ones are best

steps.zh: 肉丝加生抽、料酒、淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓到吸收，再拌入 1 茶匙油，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the pork with the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornflour and 1 tbsp water until absorbed, then stir in 1 tsp of the oil; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 葱白切成细丝，用冷水泡 5 分钟去掉冲辣味，沥干铺在盘底。甜面酱、糖和 1 汤匙水调匀。
steps.en: Cut the spring onion whites into fine shreds, soak them in cold water for 5 minutes to soften their bite, then drain and spread them on a serving plate. Stir the sweet bean sauce with the sugar and 1 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中大火下肉丝快速划散，炒到变色、熟透，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the rest of the oil in the wok over medium-high heat, add the pork and separate the strips quickly; stir-fry until it has changed colour and is cooked through, then take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里留少许油，转小火倒入酱汁，不停翻炒约 1 分钟，到冒小泡、酱香出来，小心别炒糊。
steps.en: Lower the heat and fry the sauce in the oil left in the wok for about a minute, stirring all the time, until it bubbles and smells rich; take care it doesn't catch.

steps.zh: 倒回肉丝，转大火翻炒，让每根肉丝都裹上酱汁，盛在葱丝上，吃的时候拌匀。
steps.en: Return the pork and toss over high heat until every strip is coated, then pile it on the spring onion and mix at the table.

name.en: Moo shu pork (pork, egg & wood ear)

summary.zh: 肉片、鸡蛋和木耳一锅快炒，再加几片脆黄瓜，鲜香爽口又下饭。
summary.en: Pork, soft scrambled egg and crunchy wood ear tossed with crisp cucumber in a quick, savoury stir-fry.

steps.zh: 木耳用温水泡 15 分钟，现泡现用，洗净后撕成小朵。肉片加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒和淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。黄瓜斜切片，葱切段，姜切末。
steps.en: Soak the wood ear in warm water for 15 minutes and use it straight away, rinsed and torn into small pieces. Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and the cornflour and leave for 10 minutes. Slice the cucumber on the diagonal, cut the spring onion into short lengths and mince the ginger.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。锅里放 1 汤匙油，中火倒入蛋液，稍凝固就推成大块，还有点嫩时盛出。
steps.en: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil over medium heat, pour in the eggs and push them into large, soft curds; take them out while still a little soft.

steps.zh: 锅里加剩下的油，大火下肉片炒散，炒到完全变色、熟透，再下葱段和姜末炒香。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the pork over high heat until it has changed colour all over and is cooked through; add the spring onion and ginger.

steps.zh: 下木耳翻炒 1 分钟（会溅油，小心），再加黄瓜片和剩下的生抽炒匀。
steps.en: Add the wood ear and stir-fry for a minute (it may spit), then the cucumber and the rest of the soy sauce.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋，加盐调味，大火翻炒 30 秒就出锅，让黄瓜保持脆爽。
steps.en: Return the eggs, season with salt and toss over high heat for 30 seconds, so the cucumber stays crisp.

summary.zh: 鸡块和土豆一起烧透，土豆软糯入味，浓浓的汤汁拌饭特别香。
summary.en: Chicken and potatoes braised together until the potatoes turn soft and soak up the savoury sauce.

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切 3 厘米块。土豆去皮切滚刀块，泡在清水里防止变色。姜切片，蒜拍扁，葱切段。
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 3 cm chunks. Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and keep them in cold water so they don't brown; slice the ginger, crush the garlic and cut the spring onion into lengths.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中大火下鸡块煎 3–4 分钟到表面微黄，再加姜片、蒜、葱段和八角炒香。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium-high heat and fry the chicken for 3–4 minutes until lightly golden, then add the ginger, garlic, spring onion and star anise.

steps.zh: 沿锅边淋入料酒，加生抽、老抽和糖翻炒上色，再放入沥干的土豆块翻匀。
steps.en: Splash the Shaoxing wine around the side of the wok, add the soy sauce, dark soy and sugar and toss until the chicken is coloured, then add the drained potatoes.

steps.zh: 倒入热水，刚好没过食材，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 20–25 分钟，到筷子能轻松戳透土豆、鸡肉熟透。
steps.en: Pour in the hot water, just to cover, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes, until a chopstick slides easily into the potatoes and the chicken is cooked through.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁，轻轻翻动，别把土豆弄碎；汤汁变浓后尝一下，再加盐调味。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat, turning gently so the potatoes don't break up; once the sauce has thickened, taste and season with salt.

summary.zh: 香油、酱油、米酒三样调料，加上大把姜蒜和九层塔，把鸡块焖得汁浓油亮、喷香入味。
summary.en: Chicken braised in sesame oil, soy sauce and rice wine with plenty of ginger, garlic and Thai basil until sticky and glossy.

note.en: dark sesame oil if you can

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切 3 厘米块，用厨房纸吸干水分。姜切厚片，蒜剥成整瓣，九层塔摘下叶子，辣椒斜切片。
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 3 cm pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Thickly slice the ginger, peel the garlic and leave the cloves whole, pick the basil leaves and slice the chilli.

steps.zh: 锅里倒入香油（留 1 茶匙最后用），小火下姜片慢慢煸 3–4 分钟到边缘卷起，再加蒜瓣煸到金黄。香油怕高温，火别开大。
steps.en: Warm the sesame oil in the wok over low heat, keeping back 1 tsp for the end, and fry the ginger for 3–4 minutes until the edges curl; add the garlic and fry until golden. Keep the heat moderate, as sesame oil scorches easily.

steps.zh: 转中火下鸡块，煎炒 4–5 分钟到表面金黄，加冰糖炒到融化，再倒入生抽和料酒翻匀。
steps.en: Turn the heat to medium, add the chicken and fry for 4–5 minutes until golden; add the rock sugar and stir until it melts, then pour in the soy sauce and Shaoxing wine.

steps.zh: 烧开后盖盖，小火焖 10–12 分钟，中途翻动一两次，到鸡肉熟透。
steps.en: Bring to the boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the chicken is cooked through.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁，到汤汁浓稠、裹住鸡块，下辣椒和九层塔翻几下，叶子一软就关火，淋上留下的香油出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and boil hard until the sauce is thick and sticky, then toss in the chilli and basil; turn off the heat as soon as the leaves wilt and drizzle over the reserved sesame oil.

name.en: White-cut chicken with ginger & spring onion dip

summary.zh: 整鸡小火慢慢浸熟，皮爽肉嫩，蘸上热油激香的姜葱蓉，吃的就是原汁原味。
summary.en: A whole chicken poached gently until silky and juicy, served with a sizzling ginger and spring onion oil.

note.en: a few slices for the pot; the rest minced
two for the pot; the rest finely chopped

steps.zh: 鸡剪掉鸡屁股和多余的肥油，洗净。一大锅水加几片姜和两根葱烧开，水量要能完全没过整只鸡。
steps.en: Trim off the chicken's tail and any loose fat and rinse it. Bring a pot of water big enough to cover the bird to the boil with a few slices of ginger and two of the spring onions.

steps.zh: 把木勺柄伸进鸡腔提起鸡，浸入开水 10 秒后提出来，倒掉腔里的水，重复三次让里外受热均匀，再把整只鸡放进锅里。
steps.en: Push the handle of a wooden spoon into the cavity and use it to lower the chicken into the boiling water for 10 seconds; lift it out, let the water drain from the cavity and repeat twice more so it heats evenly, then lower it in completely.

steps.zh: 水再次微微冒泡时转最小火，盖上锅盖，保持水面不翻滚，浸煮约 30 分钟（1.3 千克的鸡，更大的多煮几分钟）。用筷子扎大腿最厚处，流出的汁清澈、没有粉色才算熟透；用温度计的话要达到 75°C。
steps.en: When the water barely bubbles again, turn the heat to its lowest, cover and keep it below a simmer; poach for about 30 minutes for a 1.3 kg bird, a few minutes more for a bigger one. It is done when a skewer in the thickest part of the thigh brings out clear juices with no pink, or a thermometer there reads 75°C.

steps.zh: 鸡捞出后马上放进一大盆冰水里泡 10 分钟，让鸡皮收紧变爽，捞出沥干。
steps.en: Lift the chicken straight into a large bowl of iced water for 10 minutes to firm up the skin, then drain.

steps.zh: 泡鸡的时候做蘸料：剩下的姜剁成细蓉，剩下的葱切细末，放进耐热碗里加盐；油烧到冒烟，小心地浇在姜葱上激出香味，拌匀，喜欢的话再加生抽。
steps.en: While it chills, make the dip. Mince the rest of the ginger and spring onions very finely and put them in a heatproof bowl with the salt; heat the oil until it smokes, pour it carefully over so it sizzles and stir, adding the soy sauce if you like.

steps.zh: 鸡斩件装盘（没有大刀的话，就先拆下鸡腿和鸡翅，鸡胸切片），蘸姜葱油吃。
steps.en: Chop the chicken into pieces through the bone, or joint it and slice the breast if you don't have a cleaver, and serve with the dip.

summary.zh: 羊肉片大火爆炒，裹满孜然和辣椒粉，一口下去全是烤串的香味。
summary.en: Thin slices of lamb seared hard and tossed with toasted cumin and chilli — all the flavour of a street skewer.

note.en: leg; thinly sliced across the grain

steps.zh: 羊肉片加生抽、料酒、淀粉和 1 茶匙油抓匀，腌 10 分钟。洋葱切粗丝，葱切段（葱白和葱绿分开），蒜切片，香菜切段。
steps.en: Mix the lamb with the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornflour and 1 tsp of the oil and leave for 10 minutes. Slice the onion thickly, cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the whites and greens apart, slice the garlic and chop the coriander.

steps.zh: 锅烧到冒烟再放油，下羊肉片摊开，大火煎炒 1–2 分钟，到变色、边缘微焦，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, add the oil and spread out the lamb; sear over high heat for 1–2 minutes until browned at the edges, then take it out.

steps.zh: 用锅里的余油大火炒洋葱、蒜片和葱白 1 分钟，到洋葱稍微变软。
steps.en: Stir-fry the onion, garlic and spring onion whites in the oil left in the wok over high heat for a minute, until the onion just softens.

steps.zh: 倒回羊肉，撒入孜然和辣椒粉，加盐大火快速翻炒 1 分钟，炒出孜然香味，别炒糊。
steps.en: Return the lamb, scatter over the cumin and chilli flakes, season with salt and toss over high heat for a minute, until the cumin smells toasty; don't let it burn.

steps.zh: 关火拌入葱绿和香菜，撒上芝麻出锅。
steps.en: Off the heat, toss in the spring onion greens and coriander and scatter with sesame seeds.

summary.zh: 嫩滑的牛柳配上洋葱和彩椒，裹满浓浓的黑椒汁，椒香十足。
summary.en: Tender strips of beef with onion and capsicum in a glossy sauce full of cracked black pepper.

note.en: cut across the grain into thick strips

steps.zh: 牛肉逆纹切成手指粗的条，加一半生抽、1 茶匙淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓到吸收，再拌入 1 茶匙油，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Cut the beef across the grain into finger-thick strips and mix with half the soy sauce, 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tbsp water until absorbed, then stir in 1 tsp of the oil; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 洋葱和彩椒切粗条，蒜切末。蚝油、剩下的生抽、老抽、糖、1 茶匙淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成碗汁。
steps.en: Cut the onion and capsicum into thick strips and mince the garlic. Stir the oyster sauce, the rest of the soy sauce, the dark soy, sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 3 tbsp water into a sauce.

steps.zh: 锅烧到冒烟再放油，下牛柳摊开，大火煎 30 秒再翻炒，炒到七八成熟就盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, add the oil and spread out the beef; sear over high heat for 30 seconds, then stir-fry until nearly cooked and take it out.

steps.zh: 余油转小火，下蒜末和黑胡椒炒出香味，再转大火下洋葱和彩椒炒 1–2 分钟，到洋葱微软、彩椒还脆。
steps.en: Lower the heat and fry the garlic and black pepper in the oil left in the wok until fragrant, then turn up the heat and stir-fry the onion and capsicum for 1–2 minutes, until the onion softens but the capsicum is still crisp.

steps.zh: 倒回牛柳，淋入碗汁，大火翻炒到汤汁浓稠发亮、裹住牛柳即可。
steps.en: Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss over high heat until it is thick and glossy and coats the beef.

summary.zh: 牛肉片滑嫩，西兰花翠绿爽脆，裹上一层亮亮的蚝油汁。
summary.en: Tender slices of beef and bright, crisp broccoli tossed in a glossy oyster sauce.

steps.zh: 牛肉片加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒、糖、1 茶匙淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓匀，再拌入 1 茶匙油，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the beef with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, the sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tbsp water, then stir in 1 tsp oil; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 西兰花切小朵，姜蒜切片；蚝油、剩下的生抽、1 茶匙淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成碗汁。
steps.en: Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the ginger and garlic. Stir the oyster sauce with the rest of the soy sauce, 1 tsp cornflour and 3 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 水烧开，加一小撮盐和几滴油，下西兰花焯 1 分钟，捞出沥干。
steps.en: Blanch the broccoli for a minute in boiling water with a pinch of salt and a few drops of oil; drain well.

steps.zh: 锅烧到冒烟，放入剩下的油，下牛肉片摊开，大火煎炒到刚刚变色就盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, add the rest of the oil and spread out the beef; sear over high heat until it just changes colour, then take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里留底油，下姜蒜炒香，放西兰花大火翻炒 1 分钟，倒回牛肉，淋入碗汁翻炒到浓稠发亮；尝一下再加盐，滴几滴香油出锅。
steps.en: Fry the ginger and garlic in the oil left in the wok, add the broccoli and toss over high heat for a minute; return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss until thick and glossy. Taste, add salt if needed and finish with a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 番茄炒成浓汁，牛腩小火慢炖到软烂，酸甜浓郁，汤汁浇在米饭上特别香。
summary.en: Brisket simmered slowly in a thick, tangy tomato sauce until meltingly tender — made for spooning over rice.

steps.zh: 牛腩冷水下锅，加 2 片姜、1 根葱（和 1 汤匙料酒）煮开，撇去浮沫再煮 2 分钟，捞出用热水冲洗干净。
steps.en: Put the brisket in a pot of cold water with 2 slices of the ginger and 1 spring onion (and 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine), bring to the boil and skim, boil 2 minutes more, then rinse the beef in hot water.

steps.zh: 番茄顶部划十字，放进开水烫 1 分钟后去皮，一半切小丁、一半切块；洋葱切块。
steps.en: Score a cross in the top of each tomato, dip them in boiling water for a minute and peel; finely dice half and cut the rest into chunks. Cut the onion into pieces.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下剩下的姜片和洋葱炒软，加番茄丁和番茄膏炒 5–6 分钟，用铲子压成浓稠的番茄汁。
steps.en: Warm the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and soften the rest of the ginger and the onion; add the diced tomato and the tomato paste and cook for 5–6 minutes, pressing with the spatula, until it breaks down into a thick sauce.

steps.zh: 放入牛腩翻匀，加剩下的料酒、冰糖、八角和香叶，倒入热水没过牛肉 2–3 厘米，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 70–80 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透。
steps.en: Add the beef and stir to coat, then the rest of the wine, the rock sugar, star anise and bay leaves; pour in hot water to 2–3 cm above the meat, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 70–80 minutes, until a chopstick slides through easily.

steps.zh: 放入番茄块再炖 10 分钟，开盖中火收汁到浓稠，加盐调味，把剩下的葱切成葱花撒上即可。
steps.en: Add the tomato chunks and simmer for 10 minutes more, then uncover and reduce over medium heat until thick; season with salt and scatter with the other spring onion, chopped.

summary.zh: 整条鱼先煎到两面金黄，再用酱汁焖到入味，咸鲜微甜，汤汁红亮。
summary.en: A whole fish fried golden, then braised until the glossy, sweet-savoury soy sauce soaks in.

note.zh: 约 600 克，鲈鱼、草鱼或鲷鱼
note.en: about 600 g, such as sea bass, carp or snapper

steps.zh: 鱼处理干净，用厨房纸擦干，两面各斜划 3–4 刀，抹上 1 汤匙料酒腌 10 分钟。姜切片，蒜拍扁，葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开放。
steps.en: Pat the cleaned fish dry with kitchen paper, cut 3–4 diagonal slashes on each side and rub with 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine; leave for 10 minutes. Slice the ginger, crush the garlic and cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart.

steps.zh: 下锅前再把鱼擦干，喜欢的话薄薄拍一层淀粉，更不容易粘锅。锅烧热，用一片姜擦一遍锅底，放油烧热后放入鱼，中火煎 3–4 分钟，底面金黄定型前别动它，再小心翻面煎 3 分钟。
steps.en: Dry the fish again and, if you like, dust it lightly with cornflour so it is less likely to stick. Heat the wok, rub it with a slice of ginger, add the oil and, once hot, lay in the fish; fry over medium heat for 3–4 minutes without moving it, until golden and set, then turn it carefully and fry the other side for 3 minutes.

steps.zh: 鱼推到一边，下姜片、蒜和葱白炒香，沿锅边淋入剩下的料酒和醋，再加生抽、老抽和糖。
steps.en: Push the fish to one side and fry the ginger, garlic and white spring onion until fragrant; pour the rest of the wine and the vinegar down the side of the wok, then add the soy sauce, dark soy and sugar.

steps.zh: 倒入热水到鱼身一半高，烧开后转中小火盖盖焖 8–10 分钟，中途舀汤汁淋在鱼身上；鱼肉最厚处能用筷子轻松插透就熟了。
steps.en: Add hot water to come halfway up the fish, bring to the boil, then cover and braise over medium-low heat for 8–10 minutes, spooning the sauce over now and then; it is done when a chopstick slides easily into the thickest part.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁到浓稠，尝一下再决定要不要加盐，撒上葱绿出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over high heat until the sauce is thick; taste before adding any salt and scatter with the green spring onion.

summary.zh: 鱼片嫩滑，酸菜汤酸香浓郁，最后浇一勺热油，激出蒜香和辣香。
summary.en: Silky fish slices in a sour, savoury pickle broth, finished with a sizzle of hot oil over garlic and chilli.

note.zh: 巴沙鱼柳或其他白肉鱼柳
note.en: basa or another firm white fish

steps.zh: 鱼柳斜刀片成约 5 毫米厚的片，用厨房纸吸干，加一小撮盐、白胡椒、料酒和蛋清抓到微微发黏，再拌入淀粉，腌 15 分钟。
steps.en: Slice the fillets on the diagonal about 5 mm thick and pat dry, then mix with a pinch of salt, the white pepper, the Shaoxing wine and the egg white until slightly sticky; stir in the cornflour and leave for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 酸菜切段，用清水冲洗两遍挤干，太咸可以多泡几分钟。姜和 2 瓣蒜切片，剩下的蒜切末，干辣椒剪段，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Cut the pickled greens into short pieces, rinse twice and squeeze dry; soak them a few minutes longer if very salty. Slice the ginger and 2 cloves of garlic, mince the rest of the garlic, snip the chillies into short lengths and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油，中火炒香姜片和蒜片，下酸菜大火翻炒 2–3 分钟，炒出酸香味。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the ginger and sliced garlic until fragrant; add the pickled greens and stir-fry over high heat for 2–3 minutes, until they smell sour and savoury.

steps.zh: 倒入开水大火煮 5 分钟，把酸菜捞出铺在大碗底。转小火让汤保持微开，鱼片一片片放进去，轻轻推散，煮 1–2 分钟到鱼肉变白、刚刚熟透，连汤倒在酸菜上。酸菜本身很咸，先尝再加盐。
steps.en: Pour in the boiling water and boil hard for 5 minutes, then lift the greens into a large bowl. Lower the heat so the soup just bubbles, slip in the fish slices one at a time, nudge them apart and cook for 1–2 minutes, until white and just cooked through; pour the fish and soup over the greens. The pickles are salty, so taste before adding salt.

steps.zh: 鱼片上铺蒜末、干辣椒段和花椒，把剩下的油烧到冒烟，浇在上面激出香味，撒葱花即可。
steps.en: Scatter the minced garlic, chillies and Sichuan peppercorns over the fish, heat the rest of the oil until it smokes and pour it over so they sizzle; finish with the spring onion.

summary.zh: 开背大虾铺在粉丝上，浇满金黄蒜蓉大火快蒸，粉丝吸饱了鲜甜的虾汁。
summary.en: Butterflied prawns steamed fast on vermicelli under a golden garlic sauce, so the noodles soak up every drop of juice.

note.en: or seasoned soy sauce for fish

steps.zh: 粉丝用温水泡 10–15 分钟到变软，剪成长段，沥干后铺在盘底。
steps.en: Soak the vermicelli in warm water for 10–15 minutes until soft, snip into long lengths, drain and spread over a heatproof plate.

steps.zh: 大虾剪去虾须和虾枪，从背部剪开（别剪断），挑出虾线，洗净擦干，用刀背轻轻拍平，开口朝上摆在粉丝上。
steps.en: Trim the prawns' feelers and spikes, cut along the back without cutting right through and pull out the vein; rinse, pat dry, press each one flat with the side of a knife and arrange cut side up on the vermicelli.

steps.zh: 蒜切成细末，一半放进碗里；另一半和油一起下锅，小火炒到浅金黄，连油倒进生蒜末里，加生抽、糖和 2 汤匙水拌匀。
steps.en: Mince the garlic finely and put half in a bowl. Fry the other half in the oil over low heat until pale gold, then pour it, oil and all, over the raw garlic and stir in the soy sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 把蒜酱均匀舀在虾和粉丝上。水烧开后放入，大火蒸 5–6 分钟，虾身变红、虾肉刚好不透明就关火，别蒸过头。
steps.en: Spoon the garlic sauce evenly over the prawns and vermicelli. Steam over boiling water on high for 5–6 minutes, just until the prawns turn pink and the flesh is opaque; don't overcook them.

steps.zh: 出锅撒葱花，趁热吃。
steps.en: Scatter with the spring onion and serve hot.

summary.zh: 虾仁上浆后快炒，晶莹弹牙，只用盐调味，吃的就是虾的鲜甜。
summary.en: Velveted prawns stir-fried in moments until plump and springy, seasoned simply so their sweetness comes through.

steps.zh: 虾仁如果有虾线就挑掉，加一小撮盐抓一抓，用清水冲洗干净，再用厨房纸彻底吸干水分，这样炒出来更爽脆。
steps.en: Devein the prawns if needed, rub them with a pinch of salt and rinse well, then pat them thoroughly dry with kitchen paper so they cook up springy.

steps.zh: 虾仁加一小撮盐、白胡椒、料酒和蛋清（不放也行）抓匀，再拌入淀粉，腌 5 分钟。姜切丝，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Mix the prawns with a pinch of salt, the white pepper, the Shaoxing wine and the egg white (they work without it), then stir in the cornflour and leave for 5 minutes. Shred the ginger and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，油温四五成热（筷子插进去周围冒小泡）时下虾仁，中火快速划散，炒 1–2 分钟到变红卷起、刚好不透明，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok until moderately hot, when small bubbles form around a chopstick; add the prawns and stir briskly over medium heat for 1–2 minutes, until pink, curled and just opaque, then take them out.

steps.zh: 锅里留底油，下姜丝和豌豆炒 1 分钟，倒回虾仁，加盐大火翻匀 20 秒，撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Fry the ginger and peas in the oil left in the wok for a minute, return the prawns, season with salt and toss over high heat for 20 seconds; finish with the spring onion.

summary.zh: 豆腐先煎到两面金黄，再用豆瓣酱烧到入味，咸鲜微辣，配米饭正好。
summary.en: Tofu pan-fried until golden, then simmered with green pepper in a savoury, gently spicy chilli bean sauce.

note.en: or a bunch of garlic shoots

steps.zh: 木耳用温水泡 10 分钟，撕成小朵。豆腐切成 1 厘米厚的三角片或长方片，用厨房纸吸干；青椒去籽切块，姜蒜切片，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Soak the wood ear in warm water for 10 minutes and tear it into small pieces. Cut the tofu into 1 cm thick triangles or rectangles and pat dry; seed the pepper and cut it into pieces, slice the ginger and garlic and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油，中火把豆腐两面煎到金黄，每面约 3 分钟，盛出。
steps.en: Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat until golden, about 3 minutes a side; take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里放剩下的油，有肉片就先下肉片炒到变色，再转小火加豆瓣酱炒出红油，放姜蒜炒香。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and, if using pork, stir-fry it until it changes colour; turn the heat down, add the chilli bean paste and fry until the oil turns red, then add the ginger and garlic.

steps.zh: 放入豆腐和木耳，加生抽、糖和 100 毫升水，中火烧 3–4 分钟让豆腐入味，再下青椒翻炒 1 分钟。
steps.en: Add the tofu and wood ear with the soy sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer over medium heat for 3–4 minutes so the tofu takes up the flavour; add the pepper and cook for a minute more.

steps.zh: 淀粉加 2 汤匙水调匀，淋入锅中轻轻翻匀，汤汁浓稠发亮后撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Stir the cornflour into 2 tbsp water, pour it in and fold gently until the sauce is thick and glossy; scatter with the spring onion.

summary.zh: 肥瘦相间的大肉丸先煎后炖，松软多汁，裹着红亮浓郁的酱汁。
summary.en: Big, tender pork meatballs fried golden, then braised slowly in a rich, glossy soy sauce.

steps.zh: 取 3 片姜和 2 根葱切碎，用 50 毫升水泡 10 分钟，抓几下后滤出葱姜水；剩下的葱切段，和剩下的姜片一起留着炖的时候用。
steps.en: Chop 3 slices of the ginger and 2 of the spring onions and soak them in 50 ml of the water for 10 minutes; squeeze and strain off the liquid. Cut the remaining spring onion into lengths and keep it with the rest of the ginger for the braise.

steps.zh: 肉末加 1 汤匙生抽、1 汤匙料酒、盐、白胡椒和鸡蛋，朝一个方向搅拌；葱姜水分三次加入，每次搅到吸收，直到肉馅起胶发黏，最后拌入淀粉。
steps.en: Mix the mince with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine, the salt, white pepper and egg, stirring in one direction; add the ginger-and-spring-onion water in three goes, stirring until each is absorbed and the mixture turns sticky and elastic, then mix in the cornflour.

steps.zh: 手上抹点水，把肉馅分成 8 份，团成大圆球，在两手之间来回轻摔几下让它更紧实。锅里放油，中火把肉丸煎到四面金黄定型后盛出，中间没熟没关系。
steps.en: With wet hands, divide the mixture into 8 and shape into large balls, tossing each gently from hand to hand to firm it up. Fry them in the oil over medium heat, turning carefully, until golden and set all over, then take them out; they finish cooking in the braise.

steps.zh: 倒出多余的油，留一点炒香姜片和葱段，放回肉丸，加剩下的生抽和料酒、老抽和冰糖，倒入剩下的水（约 450 毫升）到肉丸三分之二高。烧开后转小火盖盖炖 30 分钟，中途轻轻翻面一次。
steps.en: Pour off all but a little of the oil and fry the reserved ginger and spring onion; return the meatballs with the rest of the soy sauce and wine, the dark soy and the rock sugar, and pour in the rest of the water (about 450 ml) to come two-thirds of the way up. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, turning them once.

steps.zh: 切开一个看看，中心不再是粉色就熟了，盛出肉丸。喜欢的话把青菜放进汤汁里烫 1–2 分钟，捞出垫在盘底。最后大火把汤汁收浓，浇在肉丸上即可。
steps.en: Cut one open to check there is no pink in the centre, then lift the meatballs out. If using bok choy, cook it in the sauce for 1–2 minutes and lay it on the plate. Boil the sauce hard until thick and pour it over the meatballs.

name.en: Steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce

summary.zh: 小块排骨裹上蒜蓉和豆豉，蒸得嫩滑多汁，豉香浓郁，是广式茶楼的味道。
summary.en: Bite-sized ribs steamed tender with garlic and savoury fermented black beans, as served at dim sum.

steps.zh: 排骨用清水泡 10 分钟去血水，冲洗干净，用厨房纸吸干。同时把豆豉稍微冲洗一下切碎，蒜切末。
steps.en: Soak the ribs in cold water for 10 minutes to draw out the blood, rinse and pat dry with kitchen paper. Meanwhile, rinse the black beans briefly and chop them, and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 排骨加豆豉、蒜末、生抽、料酒、糖和盐抓匀，再拌入淀粉，最后淋油拌匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the ribs with the black beans, garlic, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar and salt, then with the cornflour, and finally with the oil; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 排骨平铺在盘里，别堆得太厚。水烧开后放入，大火蒸 18–20 分钟，筷子能轻松戳透、骨头边没有血色就熟了。
steps.en: Spread the ribs out on a heatproof plate in a single layer. Steam over boiling water on high for 18–20 minutes, until a chopstick goes in easily and there is no pink near the bone.

steps.zh: 出锅撒葱花，盘底的豉汁拌饭也很香。
steps.en: Scatter with the spring onion and serve; the black bean juices on the plate are good spooned over rice.

name.en: Pork, Chinese cabbage & glass noodle stew

summary.zh: 东北家常炖菜：五花肉煸出油香，白菜炖得软甜，粉条吸饱了汤汁。
summary.en: A hearty north-eastern stew of pork belly, soft sweet cabbage and slippery noodles that soak up the broth.

steps.zh: 粉条用热水泡 20 分钟到变软，剪成长段。白菜帮切片、菜叶撕成大块，分开放；五花肉切薄片，姜切片，葱切段。
steps.en: Soak the noodles in hot water for 20 minutes until pliable and cut them into long lengths. Slice the cabbage stems and tear the leaves into large pieces, keeping them apart; slice the pork belly thinly, slice the ginger and cut the spring onions into lengths.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下五花肉煸炒到出油、表面微黄，加姜片、葱段和八角炒香，沿锅边淋入料酒，再加生抽和老抽炒匀上色。
steps.en: Fry the pork in the oil over medium heat until the fat runs and it starts to brown; add the ginger, spring onion and star anise, splash the Shaoxing wine around the side of the wok, then stir in the soy sauce and dark soy.

steps.zh: 下白菜帮大火翻炒 2 分钟到变软，倒入热水，烧开后转中小火盖盖炖 8 分钟。
steps.en: Add the cabbage stems and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes until they soften; pour in the hot water, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入粉条和白菜叶，再炖 8–10 分钟，中途翻动几次防止粘锅，到粉条变透明、软滑。
steps.en: Add the noodles and the cabbage leaves and simmer for 8–10 minutes more, stirring now and then so nothing sticks, until the noodles are clear and soft.

steps.zh: 尝一下，加盐调味即可。粉条会一直吸汤，出锅时汤汁留多一点。
steps.en: Taste and season with salt. The noodles keep soaking up liquid, so leave the stew a little saucier than you think.

summary.zh: 茄子煎到软糯，吸饱咸甜酸辣的鱼香汁，蒜香扑鼻，特别下饭。
summary.en: Eggplant fried until meltingly soft and soaked in a garlicky sweet, sour and gently hot sauce — made for rice.

steps.zh: 茄子洗净，切成手指粗、约 8 厘米长的条，撒 ½ 茶匙盐拌匀，腌 10 分钟后挤去渗出的水。葱姜蒜切末，葱白和葱绿分开放。
steps.en: Cut the eggplants into finger-thick batons about 8 cm long, toss with ½ tsp salt and leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water. Mince the garlic, ginger and spring onion, keeping the white and green parts apart.

steps.zh: 生抽、醋、糖、淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成鱼香汁。
steps.en: Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornflour and 3 tbsp water into a sauce.

steps.zh: 锅里放 3 汤匙油，中大火下茄条煎 5–6 分钟，不时翻动，煎到软塌、表面微黄，盛出。
steps.en: Fry the eggplant in 3 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes, turning now and then, until soft and lightly golden; take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里补 1 汤匙油，小火下豆瓣酱炒出红油，再加姜蒜末和葱白炒香。
steps.en: Add the last tablespoon of oil and fry the chilli bean paste over low heat until the oil turns red, then add the ginger, garlic and spring onion whites.

steps.zh: 倒回茄子，把鱼香汁搅匀倒入，大火翻炒 1 分钟，汤汁浓稠、裹住茄子后撒葱绿出锅。
steps.en: Return the eggplant, stir the sauce and pour it in, then toss over high heat for a minute until it thickens and coats the eggplant; scatter with the spring onion greens.

summary.zh: 大火快炒，梗脆叶嫩，蒜香浓郁，几分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Flash-fried over high heat with plenty of garlic — crunchy stems, tender leaves and on the table in minutes.

steps.zh: 空心菜掐去老根，洗净后彻底沥干，切成 5 厘米段，梗和叶分开放；蒜切末。
steps.en: Snap off the tough ends, wash the water spinach and drain it thoroughly, then cut it into 5 cm lengths, keeping stems and leaves apart; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅烧到很热再放油，下一半蒜末炒香。
steps.en: Get the wok very hot, add the oil and fry half the garlic until fragrant.

steps.zh: 先下菜梗大火翻炒 1 分钟，再下菜叶快炒 1 分钟，炒到刚变软。
steps.en: Add the stems and stir-fry over high heat for a minute, then the leaves for another minute, until just wilted.

steps.zh: 加盐和剩下的蒜末翻匀，马上出锅，炒久了会发黑出水。
steps.en: Add the salt and the rest of the garlic, toss and serve straight away; cooked any longer, it turns dark and watery.

summary.zh: 大火一炒，淋几滴醋，豆芽脆嫩爽口，最省事的家常小炒。
summary.en: Bean sprouts tossed over fierce heat with a splash of vinegar — crisp, juicy and about as easy as cooking gets.

steps.zh: 豆芽洗净，挑去豆壳，彻底沥干；有空可以掐掉根须，更好看。葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开。
steps.en: Rinse the bean sprouts, pick out any husks and drain them thoroughly; nipping off the root tails makes them neater if you have time. Cut the spring onions into short lengths, keeping whites and greens apart.

steps.zh: 锅烧到很热再放油，下葱白炒香。
steps.en: Get the wok very hot, add the oil and fry the spring onion whites until fragrant.

steps.zh: 下豆芽大火快炒 1 分钟，沿锅边淋入白醋，加盐再翻炒 30 秒。
steps.en: Add the sprouts and toss over high heat for a minute; splash the vinegar down the side of the wok, add the salt and toss for 30 seconds more.

steps.zh: 豆芽刚变透明、还脆的时候撒葱绿出锅，炒久了会出水变软。
steps.en: Scatter with the spring onion greens and serve while the sprouts are just translucent but still crisp; cooked longer, they go limp and watery.

summary.zh: 白菜帮大火快炒，裹上酸甜微咸的醋汁，脆嫩开胃。
summary.en: Crisp Chinese cabbage stems stir-fried fast and glazed in a tangy, slightly sweet vinegar sauce.

note.en: about 500 g; mostly the white stems

steps.zh: 白菜帮斜刀片成薄片，菜叶撕成小块，分开放；蒜切片，干辣椒剪段。
steps.en: Slice the white cabbage stems thinly on the diagonal and tear the leaves into pieces, keeping the two apart; slice the garlic and snip the chillies.

steps.zh: 醋、生抽、糖、淀粉和 2 汤匙水调成碗汁。
steps.en: Mix the vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornflour and 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，下蒜片和干辣椒炒香，放菜帮大火翻炒 2 分钟，炒到边缘透明。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the garlic and chillies until fragrant, then stir-fry the stems over high heat for 2 minutes, until translucent at the edges.

steps.zh: 下菜叶炒到刚软，加一点盐，把碗汁搅匀倒入，大火翻炒到汤汁浓稠发亮即可。
steps.en: Add the leaves and toss until just wilted, season with a little salt, then stir the sauce, pour it in and toss over high heat until it turns thick and glossy.

summary.zh: 翠绿的青菜配上滑嫩的香菇，裹一层薄薄的咸鲜芡汁。
summary.en: Bright green bok choy and silky shiitake in a light, savoury glaze.

steps.zh: 青菜洗净沥干，大棵的对半切开；香菇去蒂，切厚片；蒜切片。
steps.en: Wash and drain the bok choy, halving any large heads; trim the shiitake stems and cut the caps into thick slices; slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 生抽、蚝油、糖、淀粉和 3 汤匙水调成汁。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, cornflour and 3 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，中火炒香蒜片，下香菇炒 2–3 分钟，炒到变软、边缘微黄。
steps.en: Heat the oil and fry the garlic over medium heat until fragrant, then add the shiitake and cook for 2–3 minutes until soft and golden at the edges.

steps.zh: 转大火下青菜，翻炒 1–2 分钟到翠绿刚软。
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add the bok choy and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes, until bright green and just tender.

steps.zh: 把汁搅匀倒入，翻炒到汤汁浓稠、裹住青菜和香菇，尝一下再加盐。
steps.en: Stir the sauce, pour it in and toss until it thickens and coats the greens and mushrooms; taste and add salt if needed.

summary.zh: 木耳爽脆，拌上蒜香酸甜的汁，清爽开胃的一盘凉菜。
summary.en: Crunchy wood ear mushrooms in a garlicky sweet-sour dressing — a bright, refreshing cold dish.

steps.zh: 干木耳用温水泡 30 分钟到完全泡开（冷水泡 2 小时口感更脆），但别泡过夜。泡好后剪去硬根，撕成小朵，反复搓洗干净。
steps.en: Soak the wood ear in warm water for 30 minutes until fully swollen (2 hours in cold water gives a crunchier bite), but never leave it overnight. Snip off the hard bases, tear into bite-sized pieces and rinse well.

steps.zh: 水烧开，下木耳焯 2 分钟，捞出过冷水，沥干。
steps.en: Blanch the wood ear in boiling water for 2 minutes, then cool it under cold running water and drain well.

steps.zh: 蒜切末，辣椒切圈，香菜切段；蒜末、生抽、醋、糖和香油调成汁。
steps.en: Mince the garlic, slice the chilli and chop the coriander; mix the garlic with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil.

steps.zh: 木耳倒进汁里，加辣椒和香菜拌匀，尝一下再加盐；放 5 分钟更入味。
steps.en: Toss the wood ear with the dressing, chilli and coriander, then taste and add salt if needed; it is even better after 5 minutes.

summary.zh: 五花肉煸出油香，花菜大火炒到焦边，干香微辣，越吃越香。
summary.en: Cauliflower seared in rendered pork belly with dried chilli and garlic until charred at the edges — smoky, savoury and a little hot.

steps.zh: 花菜掰成小朵，粗梗切薄片，洗净后彻底沥干；五花肉和蒜切薄片，干辣椒剪段，蒜苗切段。
steps.en: Break the cauliflower into small florets and slice any thick stalk thinly; wash and drain thoroughly. Thinly slice the pork belly and garlic, snip the chillies and cut the garlic shoots into lengths.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中小火下五花肉煸 3–4 分钟，煸到出油、边缘微焦。
steps.en: Fry the pork belly in the oil over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, until the fat runs and the edges crisp.

steps.zh: 加蒜片和干辣椒炒香，转大火下花菜翻炒 3 分钟，沿锅边淋入 2 汤匙水，盖上锅盖焖 2 分钟。
steps.en: Add the garlic and chillies and fry until fragrant, then turn up the heat, add the cauliflower and stir-fry for 3 minutes; splash 2 tbsp water down the side of the wok, cover and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.zh: 开盖继续大火翻炒，炒到水分收干、花菜边缘焦黄，淋入生抽，加糖和盐，放蒜苗翻匀出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and keep stir-frying over high heat until the liquid has gone and the cauliflower is browned at the edges; add the soy sauce, sugar and salt, toss in the garlic shoots and serve.

summary.zh: 荷兰豆大火快炒，碧绿脆甜，只用蒜片和盐就很好吃。
summary.en: Snow peas stir-fried fast with sliced garlic — bright green, sweet and snappy.

steps.zh: 荷兰豆掐去两头，顺手撕掉两边的老筋，洗净沥干；蒜切片。
steps.en: Snap the ends off the snow peas, pulling away the strings along the sides as you go; wash and drain. Slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，小火下蒜片炒香。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the garlic over low heat until fragrant.

steps.zh: 转大火下荷兰豆翻炒 1 分钟，沿锅边淋入 2 汤匙水，继续翻炒 1–2 分钟，炒到颜色翠绿、刚断生。
steps.en: Turn the heat to high, add the snow peas and stir-fry for a minute; splash 2 tbsp water down the side of the wok and keep tossing for 1–2 minutes, until bright green and just cooked.

steps.zh: 加盐翻匀，马上出锅，趁脆吃。
steps.en: Season with salt, toss and serve at once, while they are still crisp.

summary.zh: 冰凉嫩滑的豆腐配上皮蛋，浇一勺蒜香酱汁，几分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Cool, silky tofu topped with century egg and a sizzling garlic and soy dressing — ready in minutes.

steps.zh: 嫩豆腐撕去盒膜，倒扣在盘里，盒底剪个小口，豆腐就能完整滑出；倒掉渗出的水，切成小块。
steps.en: Peel the film off the tofu, turn the box over onto a plate and snip a small hole in the base so the tofu slides out whole; pour off the liquid and cut it into cubes.

steps.zh: 皮蛋剥壳，切成小瓣或小丁，摆在豆腐上；刀上抹点水，蛋黄不容易粘。
steps.en: Peel the century eggs, cut them into wedges or small dice and arrange them over the tofu; a wet knife stops the yolk sticking.

steps.zh: 蒜切末，葱切花，辣椒切圈，一起放进小碗；油烧到冒烟，浇在上面激出香味，再加生抽、醋和糖调匀。
steps.en: Mince the garlic, finely slice the spring onion and chilli and put them in a small bowl; heat the oil until it smokes, pour it over so it sizzles, then stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar.

steps.zh: 吃之前把汁浇在豆腐和皮蛋上，喜欢的话再滴几滴香油；豆腐提前冷藏过更好吃。
steps.en: Spoon the dressing over the tofu and eggs just before serving, with a few drops of sesame oil if you like; the tofu is best straight from the fridge.

summary.zh: 菠菜一焯一拌，裹满芝麻香和蒜香，清爽不腻。
summary.en: Blanched spinach tossed in a nutty dressing of toasted sesame, garlic and soy.

steps.zh: 菠菜摘去老叶，切掉须根，用清水多洗几遍，把泥沙洗净；蒜切末。
steps.en: Pick off any tired leaves, trim the roots and wash the spinach in several changes of water to get rid of the grit; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 一大锅水烧开，放菠菜焯 30–40 秒，叶子一软就捞出，马上过冷水。
steps.en: Blanch the spinach in a large pot of boiling water for 30–40 seconds, just until the leaves wilt, then cool it at once under cold water.

steps.zh: 菠菜挤干水分，切成 4–5 厘米段，放进碗里。
steps.en: Squeeze the spinach firmly to get the water out, cut it into 4–5 cm lengths and put it in a bowl.

steps.zh: 芝麻用勺背稍微压碎更香。取一半芝麻，和蒜末、生抽、醋、糖、香油调成汁，倒在菠菜上拌匀，尝一下再加盐，最后撒上剩下的芝麻。
steps.en: Lightly crush the sesame seeds with the back of a spoon. Mix half of them with the garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil, toss the spinach in the dressing, taste for salt and scatter with the rest of the seeds.

summary.zh: 西葫芦清甜，鸡蛋松软，十分钟就能做好的家常快手菜。
summary.en: Sweet, tender courgette with soft scrambled egg — an everyday stir-fry on the table in ten minutes.

steps.zh: 西葫芦洗净，对半剖开，斜切成薄片；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散；蒜切片，葱切花。
steps.en: Halve the courgettes lengthways and slice them thinly on the diagonal; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt; slice the garlic and the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油烧热，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就推成大块，还有点嫩的时候盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil, pour in the eggs and, as they begin to set, push them into large soft curds; take them out while still a little runny.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，下蒜片炒香，转大火下西葫芦翻炒 2 分钟，炒到边缘透明、刚变软，加盐。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the garlic until fragrant, then stir-fry the courgette over high heat for 2 minutes, until translucent at the edges and just tender; season with salt.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻匀，撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss everything together and finish with spring onion.

name.en: King oyster mushrooms in oyster sauce

summary.zh: 杏鲍菇煎到微焦，裹上浓郁的蚝油汁，口感有嚼劲，鲜香下饭。
summary.en: Thick slices of king oyster mushroom seared golden and glazed in rich oyster sauce — meaty, savoury and made for rice.

steps.zh: 杏鲍菇擦净，切成 1 厘米厚的片，两面划上浅浅的十字花刀，更容易入味；蒜切末，葱切花。
steps.en: Wipe the mushrooms clean, cut them into 1 cm slices and score both sides in a shallow criss-cross so they take up the sauce; mince the garlic and slice the spring onion.

steps.zh: 蚝油、生抽、糖和 2 汤匙水调成汁。
steps.en: Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 平底锅不放油，中火把杏鲍菇片干煎 4–5 分钟（锅小就分两批），中间翻一次面，煎到两面微黄、水分收干，这样不会吸太多油。
steps.en: Dry-fry the slices in a frying pan with no oil over medium heat for 4–5 minutes (in two batches if the pan is small), turning once, until lightly browned on both sides and their moisture has cooked off; this stops them soaking up too much oil.

steps.zh: 倒入油，下蒜末炒香，淋入调好的汁，大火翻炒 1 分钟，汤汁收浓、裹住杏鲍菇后撒葱花出锅。
steps.en: Add the oil and the garlic and fry until fragrant, then pour in the sauce and toss over high heat for a minute, until it reduces to a glaze that coats the mushrooms; finish with spring onion.

summary.zh: 藕片洁白爽脆，带着蒜香和一点醋香，清清爽爽。
