summary.en: Crisp, snow-white slices of lotus root stir-fried with garlic and a splash of vinegar.

steps.zh: 藕去皮，切成 2–3 毫米的薄片，泡在加了几滴白醋的清水里，防止变黑；蒜切片，葱切花。
steps.en: Peel the lotus root, cut it into 2–3 mm slices and drop them into cold water with a few drops of the vinegar so they don't darken; slice the garlic and the spring onion.

steps.zh: 水烧开，下藕片焯 1 分钟，捞出过冷水，沥干。
steps.en: Blanch the slices in boiling water for a minute, then rinse under cold water and drain well.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，下蒜片炒香，倒入藕片大火翻炒 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the garlic until fragrant, then add the lotus root and stir-fry over high heat for 1–2 minutes.

steps.zh: 沿锅边淋入剩下的白醋，加盐翻匀，撒葱花出锅；藕片要保持爽脆。
steps.en: Splash the rest of the vinegar down the side of the wok, season with salt, toss and finish with spring onion; the slices should stay crisp.

summary.zh: 手挤的猪肉丸子鲜嫩弹牙，冬瓜煮到清透，汤清味鲜。
summary.en: Springy hand-shaped pork meatballs and translucent winter melon in a clear, savoury broth.

note.en: a little fat keeps it tender

steps.zh: 冬瓜切 0.5 厘米厚的片；姜切末，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Cut the winter melon into 5 mm slices; mince the ginger and chop the spring onions.

steps.zh: 肉末加姜末、一半葱花、鸡蛋、生抽、料酒、淀粉、少许盐和白胡椒，分几次加入 2 汤匙水，朝一个方向搅到肉馅上劲发黏。
steps.en: Mix the mince with the ginger, half the spring onion, the egg, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornflour and a little salt and white pepper. Add 2 tbsp of the water a little at a time, stirring in one direction until the mixture is sticky and springy.

steps.zh: 锅里倒入剩下的水，烧开后转小火，保持微微冒泡；抓一把肉馅，从虎口挤出丸子，用勺子刮进锅里。
steps.en: Bring the rest of the water to the boil and lower the heat to a gentle simmer. Squeeze the mince up through your fist into walnut-sized balls and scoop them into the pot with a spoon.

steps.zh: 丸子全部浮起后撇去浮沫，放入冬瓜，中火煮 6–8 分钟，到冬瓜变透明、丸子熟透，切开中间没有粉色。
steps.en: When all the meatballs float, skim off the foam, add the melon and simmer over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, until the melon is translucent and the meatballs are cooked through with no pink in the middle.

steps.zh: 加盐和白胡椒调味，撒上剩下的葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Season with salt and white pepper, then finish with the rest of the spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 醋的酸香配上胡椒的辣，豆腐、木耳和蛋花满满一碗，酸辣过瘾。
summary.en: Sharp with vinegar and hot with white pepper, and thick with tofu, wood ear and ribbons of egg.

note.zh: 鲜香菇或泡发的干香菇

steps.zh: 木耳用温水泡 15 分钟至软，去掉硬蒂后切丝；泡木耳的同时，豆腐切细条，香菇、竹笋和猪肉切细丝，鸡蛋打散。
steps.en: Soak the wood ear in warm water for 15 minutes until soft, trim off any hard bits and shred it. Meanwhile cut the tofu, shiitake, bamboo shoots and pork into thin strips and beat the egg.

steps.zh: 高汤烧开，有肉丝的话先下肉丝，用筷子拨散，再放木耳、香菇和笋丝，煮 2–3 分钟到肉丝熟透；然后轻轻放入豆腐，再煮 1 分钟。
steps.en: Bring the stock to the boil. Stir in the pork, if using, to separate the strips, then add the wood ear, shiitake and bamboo shoots and simmer for 2–3 minutes, until the pork is cooked through. Slide in the tofu and simmer 1 minute more.

steps.zh: 加生抽和老抽，尝一下再酌情加盐，用汤块做的高汤本身就有咸味；淀粉加 4 汤匙水调匀，边搅边淋入，煮到汤汁浓稠。
steps.en: Add the soy sauce and dark soy, then taste before adding any salt, as stock made from cubes is already salty. Mix the cornflour with 4 tbsp water and stir it in, cooking until the soup thickens.

steps.zh: 转小火，蛋液细细淋入，等几秒再轻轻推开成蛋花。
steps.en: Turn the heat down, pour in the egg in a thin stream and wait a few seconds before stirring gently into ribbons.

steps.zh: 关火后加醋和白胡椒粉搅匀，醋最后放才够香；尝一下味道，撒葱花，淋辣椒油或香油。
steps.en: Off the heat, stir in the vinegar and white pepper; added last, the vinegar stays bright. Taste, then finish with spring onion and a little chilli or sesame oil.

summary.zh: 上海人家的老味道：牛肉、番茄、包菜和土豆一锅慢炖，酸甜浓郁。
summary.en: The Shanghai home favourite — beef slow-simmered with tomato, cabbage and potato into a rich, sweet-sour soup.

note.en: about a quarter of a head

note.zh: 或 4 汤匙番茄沙司，糖减半
note.en: or 4 tbsp ketchup with half the sugar
cooked in the butter to thicken

steps.zh: 牛肉块冷水下锅，大火煮开后撇去浮沫，捞出用温水洗净；汤锅洗净擦干。
steps.en: Put the beef in the pot with cold water, bring to the boil and skim, then drain and rinse the beef in warm water; wash and dry the pot.

steps.zh: 洋葱切丁，番茄切小块。锅里放油，中火把洋葱炒 3 分钟到变软，加番茄炒到出汁软烂，再加番茄膏和糖炒 2 分钟，炒到红亮。
steps.en: Dice the onion and chop the tomatoes. Heat the oil in the pot and soften the onion over medium heat for 3 minutes; add the tomatoes and cook until they collapse, then stir in the tomato paste and sugar for 2 minutes until glossy and red.

steps.zh: 放入牛肉、2 升水和香叶，大火烧开后转小火，盖盖炖 40 分钟；趁这时把土豆和胡萝卜切小块，包菜切片，芹菜切段。
steps.en: Add the beef, 2 litres of water and the bay leaves, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Meanwhile cut the potatoes and carrot into small chunks, the cabbage into pieces and the celery into short lengths.

steps.zh: 加土豆和胡萝卜炖 20 分钟，再加包菜和芹菜炖 10 分钟，到牛肉软烂、土豆变软、汤汁微微浓稠。
steps.en: Add the potatoes and carrot and simmer for 20 minutes, then the cabbage and celery for 10 minutes more, until the beef is tender, the potatoes are soft and the soup has thickened a little.

steps.zh: 想更浓稠的话，用小锅把黄油融化，加面粉小火炒 2–3 分钟到微黄，舀一勺汤搅开，再倒回锅里煮几分钟。最后加盐和黑胡椒调味。
steps.en: For a thicker soup, melt the butter in a small pan, stir in the flour and cook over low heat for 2–3 minutes until pale gold; whisk in a ladle of soup, then stir it all back into the pot and simmer for a few minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

summary.zh: 杭州名菜：细碎的牛肉、雪白的蛋花和香菜，汤汁清亮滑口。
summary.en: A Hangzhou classic — minced beef, snowy egg white and coriander in a silky, glossy broth.

steps.zh: 牛肉末加少许盐、料酒、1 茶匙淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓匀，腌 10 分钟；香菇切小丁，姜切末，香菜切碎；鸡蛋只取蛋清，打散。
steps.en: Mix the beef with a little salt, the Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp of the cornflour and 1 tbsp water and leave for 10 minutes. Dice the shiitake, mince the ginger, chop the coriander and beat the egg whites (keep the yolks for another dish).

steps.zh: 锅里加 700 毫升水和姜末烧开，放香菇丁煮 2 分钟；转中火下牛肉末，马上用筷子搅散，煮 1–2 分钟到完全变色熟透，撇去浮沫。
steps.en: Bring 700 ml water to the boil with the ginger and simmer the shiitake for 2 minutes. Over medium heat add the beef and stir it apart at once with chopsticks; cook for 1–2 minutes until it has changed colour all through, then skim off the foam.

steps.zh: 加盐调味；剩下的淀粉加 3 汤匙水调匀，分两三次淋入，边淋边搅，煮到汤汁浓稠透亮。
steps.en: Season with salt. Mix the rest of the cornflour with 3 tbsp water and stir it in, in two or three goes, until the soup is thick and glossy.

steps.zh: 转小火，蛋清细细淋入，等几秒再轻轻推开，就是雪白的蛋花。
steps.en: Turn the heat down, pour in the egg whites in a thin stream and wait a few seconds before stirring gently into white ribbons.

steps.zh: 关火，撒入香菜末和白胡椒粉，滴几滴香油即可。
steps.en: Off the heat, stir in the coriander and white pepper and add a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 碧绿的菠菜配上白嫩的豆腐，十几分钟就能上桌的家常汤。
summary.en: Bright green spinach and soft tofu in a simple broth, on the table in about fifteen minutes.

steps.zh: 菠菜洗净切段；豆腐切 2 厘米小块；姜切丝。
steps.en: Wash the spinach and cut it into lengths; cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and shred the ginger.

steps.zh: 锅里烧一锅开水，菠菜焯 30 秒去掉涩味，捞出过凉水，轻轻挤干；倒掉焯菜的水。
steps.en: Blanch the spinach in a pot of boiling water for 30 seconds, then cool it under the tap and squeeze it gently dry; this takes away its astringency. Pour away the water.

steps.zh: 锅擦干后放油，小火把姜丝炒香，加 600 毫升水烧开，放入豆腐，中火煮 3 分钟。
steps.en: Wipe the pot dry, heat the oil and fry the ginger gently until fragrant; add 600 ml water, bring to the boil, add the tofu and simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入菠菜，再次煮开后加盐和白胡椒调味，滴几滴香油即可。
steps.en: Add the spinach and bring back to the boil, then season with salt and white pepper and finish with a few drops of sesame oil.

name.en: Pork & pickled mustard tuber (zha cai) soup

summary.zh: 榨菜咸鲜脆爽，肉丝嫩滑，十五分钟就能喝上一碗。
summary.en: Crunchy, savoury zha cai and silky strips of pork in a quick broth, ready in fifteen minutes.

steps.zh: 肉丝加一小撮盐、料酒、淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓匀，腌 5 分钟。榨菜用清水冲一下，挤干，太长的切短；姜切丝。
steps.en: Mix the pork with a pinch of salt, the Shaoxing wine, the cornflour and 1 tbsp water and leave for 5 minutes. Rinse the zha cai briefly, squeeze it dry and cut any long shreds shorter; shred the ginger.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火把姜丝和榨菜炒 1 分钟出香味，加 600 毫升水，大火烧开。
steps.en: Fry the ginger and zha cai gently in the oil for a minute until fragrant, then add 600 ml water and bring to the boil.

steps.zh: 转中火，肉丝分散着放入，用筷子轻轻拨开，煮 2–3 分钟到肉丝全部变白熟透，撇去浮沫。
steps.en: Over medium heat, add the pork a little at a time and stir it apart gently with chopsticks; simmer for 2–3 minutes until it is white and cooked through, then skim off any foam.

steps.zh: 榨菜本身很咸，先尝味道再决定加不加盐；撒白胡椒和葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Zha cai is salty, so taste before adding any salt; finish with white pepper, spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 鸡肉和香菇小火慢炖，汤色金黄，鲜香浓郁。
summary.en: Chicken and shiitake simmered low and slow into a golden, deeply savoury broth.

note.zh: 干香菇最香，鲜的也可以
note.en: dried for the most flavour; fresh is fine

steps.zh: 干香菇冲洗后用温水泡 30 分钟至软（鲜香菇不用泡），泡香菇的水留着；剪去香菇蒂，大的切半。红枣洗净。
steps.en: Rinse the dried shiitake and soak them in warm water for 30 minutes until soft (fresh ones need no soaking), keeping the water. Snip off the stems and halve any large caps; rinse the red dates.

steps.zh: 泡香菇的同时，鸡腿冷水下锅，加 2 片姜和料酒，大火煮开后撇去浮沫，捞出用温水洗净。
steps.en: While they soak, put the chicken in a pot of cold water with 2 slices of ginger and the Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil and skim, then drain and rinse in warm water.

steps.zh: 鸡腿、香菇、红枣和剩下的姜片放进洗净的汤锅，加约 2 升水（包括泡香菇的水，碗底的沙不要倒进去），大火烧开后转小火，盖盖炖 50 分钟。
steps.en: Put the chicken, shiitake, dates and the rest of the ginger in the rinsed pot with about 2 litres of water, including the soaking water but not the grit at the bottom. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 50 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入枸杞再炖 5 分钟。确认鸡肉熟透、靠近骨头的地方没有血色，撇去表面多余的油，加盐调味，撒葱花。
steps.en: Add the goji berries and simmer 5 minutes more. Check that the chicken is cooked through with no pink near the bone, skim off any excess fat, then season with salt and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 番茄汤底里满是蔬菜、白芸豆和小段意面，一碗就很满足。
summary.en: Vegetables, white beans and little pasta in a tomato broth — a soup that eats like a meal.

note.en: broken into short pieces; or small pasta shapes

steps.zh: 洋葱、胡萝卜、芹菜和西葫芦都切成 1 厘米小丁，蒜切末。
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrot, celery and courgette into 1 cm pieces and chop the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放橄榄油，中小火把洋葱、胡萝卜和芹菜炒 6–8 分钟到变软，加蒜末再炒 1 分钟。
steps.en: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the olive oil over medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes, then add the garlic for another minute.

steps.zh: 加番茄、高汤、香叶和干香草，烧开后转小火煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, stock, bay leaf and herbs, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入西葫芦、白芸豆和意面，再煮 10 分钟左右，到意面变软（以包装上的时间为准）；汤太稠就加点水。
steps.en: Add the courgette, beans and pasta and simmer for about 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender (check the packet); add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

steps.zh: 加盐和黑胡椒调味，盛出后撒上帕玛森芝士碎。
steps.en: Season with salt and pepper and serve with grated parmesan on top.

summary.zh: 黄油炒香的蘑菇打成浓汤，奶香顺滑，配面包正好。
summary.en: Mushrooms cooked in butter and blended into a smooth, creamy soup — just right with bread.

steps.zh: 蘑菇切片，洋葱切丁，蒜切末。
steps.en: Slice the mushrooms, dice the onion and chop the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里小火融化黄油，炒洋葱和蒜 3 分钟到变软；加蘑菇转中火炒 5–6 分钟，到蘑菇出水后又收干、微微上色，盛出几片留作装饰。
steps.en: Melt the butter over low heat and soften the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 5–6 minutes, until their juices have run and cooked off and they start to brown; set a few slices aside to garnish.

steps.zh: 撒入面粉和干香草，小火翻炒 1–2 分钟到看不见干粉；慢慢倒入高汤，边倒边搅以免结块，烧开后小火煮 8 分钟。
steps.en: Sprinkle in the flour and herbs and stir over low heat for 1–2 minutes until no dry flour shows. Pour in the stock slowly, stirring so it stays smooth, bring to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.zh: 稍凉后用搅拌机打成细滑的汤，倒回锅里，加牛奶小火加热到快要沸腾，别大火煮滚。
steps.en: Let it cool a little, blend until smooth and return it to the pot; add the milk and heat gently until just below the boil — don't let it boil hard.

steps.zh: 加盐和黑胡椒调味，拌入淡奶油，放上留出的蘑菇片。
steps.en: Season with salt and pepper, stir in the cream and top with the reserved mushroom slices.

summary.zh: 大米掺上糙米、黑米等杂粮，电饭煲煮出来软糯又有嚼劲。
summary.en: Rice cooked with brown rice, black rice and other grains — soft, nutty and a little chewy.

note.en: brown rice, black rice, millet, oats and the like

steps.zh: 杂粮和大米放在一起，用清水轻轻淘洗两遍。
steps.en: Rinse the mixed grains and rice together gently, twice.

steps.zh: 放进电饭煲，按 1 杯米配约 1.5 杯水加水；杂粮越多，水要越多。
steps.en: Put them in the rice cooker with about 1.5 cups of water per cup of grain; the more mixed grain, the more water it needs.

steps.zh: 选“杂粮饭”或“糙米”模式；没有这个模式的话，先泡 1 小时再按普通煮饭键。
steps.en: Cook on the multigrain or brown-rice setting; if your cooker has neither, soak the grains for an hour first and use the normal setting.

steps.zh: 跳到保温后再焖 10 分钟，用饭勺翻松即可。杂粮里豆子多的话，最好提前泡几个小时。
steps.en: Leave it on keep-warm for 10 minutes, then fluff with the paddle. If your mix has a lot of beans, soak it for a few hours beforehand.

summary.zh: 只用面粉、酵母和温水，揉好发好，蒸出白胖松软、带着麦香的馒头。
summary.en: Flour, yeast and warm water, kneaded, proved and steamed into soft, fluffy white buns.

steps.zh: 酵母和糖放进温水里搅匀，倒入面粉中，用筷子搅成棉絮状，再用手揉成光滑的面团，约 10 分钟。
steps.en: Stir the yeast and sugar into the warm water, pour it into the flour and mix with chopsticks into shaggy flakes, then knead by hand for about 10 minutes into a smooth dough.

steps.zh: 盖上保鲜膜或湿布，放在温暖的地方发酵约 1 小时，到面团胀到两倍大，手指蘸面粉戳个洞不回缩。
steps.en: Cover with cling film or a damp cloth and leave somewhere warm for about an hour, until doubled in size and a floured finger leaves a hole that doesn't spring back.

steps.zh: 取出面团揉 5 分钟，把气泡揉出来，搓成长条，切成 8 个剂子，整成圆馒头，或直接切成方块。
steps.en: Knead the dough for 5 minutes to press out the air, roll it into a log and cut it into 8 pieces; shape them into rounds, or leave them as squares.

steps.zh: 蒸笼垫上油纸或湿屉布，馒头间隔摆好，盖上锅盖放在冷水锅上再醒 20 分钟，到馒头明显胀大、轻按会慢慢回弹。
steps.en: Set them well apart on baking paper or a damp cloth in the steamer basket, cover and leave over the cold water for another 20 minutes, until puffy and slow to spring back when pressed.

steps.zh: 开大火，上汽后转中火蒸 15 分钟；关火后焖 3–5 分钟再开盖，馒头不容易回缩塌陷。
steps.en: Turn the heat to high; once it is steaming, steam over medium heat for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and wait 3–5 minutes before lifting the lid, so the buns don't wrinkle or collapse.

summary.zh: 烫面饼层层抹油酥、撒葱花，煎到外酥里软，一撕就是一层层。
summary.en: Layered with spring onion and a savoury oil paste, fried until crisp outside and soft and flaky within.

steps.zh: 面粉留出 2 汤匙备用，其余放进盆里，先冲入一半开水，用筷子搅成絮状，再加凉水揉成柔软的面团，盖上醒 15–20 分钟。
steps.en: Set 2 tbsp of the flour aside. Pour half the water, boiling, over the rest and stir with chopsticks into shaggy flakes, then add the cold water and knead into a soft dough. Cover and rest for 15–20 minutes.

steps.zh: 2 汤匙油烧热，浇在留出的面粉、盐和五香粉上，搅成油酥；葱切葱花。
steps.en: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil and pour it over the reserved flour, the salt and the five-spice, then stir into a paste. Chop the spring onions.

steps.zh: 面团分成 4 份，每份擀成薄薄的长方形，抹上油酥，撒满葱花，从长边卷成条，再盘成圆饼，尾端压在底下，轻轻擀成约 0.5 厘米厚。
steps.en: Divide the dough into 4. Roll each piece into a thin rectangle, spread with the paste and scatter with spring onion, roll it up from a long side into a rope, coil it into a snail and tuck the end underneath; roll it out gently to about 5 mm thick.

steps.zh: 平底锅中小火，放少许油，放入饼煎 3–4 分钟到底面金黄，翻面再煎 3 分钟；用铲子从边缘往中间推挤几下，层次更明显。切块趁热吃。
steps.en: Fry the pancakes in a little of the remaining oil over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until golden underneath, then turn and cook another 3 minutes. Push the edges in towards the middle with a spatula a few times to open up the layers. Cut into wedges and eat hot.

summary.zh: 整个上锅蒸到软糯香甜，最简单的一道主食。
summary.en: Kumara steamed whole until soft, sweet and fluffy — about the simplest staple there is.

steps.zh: 红薯刷洗干净，不用去皮；粗的切成两三段，蒸得更快更均匀。
steps.en: Scrub the kumara but leave the skin on; cut thick ones into two or three pieces so they cook faster and more evenly.

steps.zh: 蒸锅水烧开，放入红薯，盖上锅盖，中大火蒸 20–25 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water, covered, on medium-high heat for 20–25 minutes, until a chopstick slides through easily.

steps.zh: 想更软糯，可以关火再焖 5 分钟。趁热吃，放凉了也好吃。
steps.en: For an even softer texture, leave them in the covered steamer off the heat for 5 minutes more. Eat hot — they're good cold too.

summary.zh: 新鲜玉米清水煮几分钟，清甜多汁，抹点黄油更香。
summary.en: Fresh corn boiled for a few minutes until sweet and juicy; a little butter makes it even better.

steps.zh: 玉米剥去外皮和玉米须，留一两层嫩皮一起煮会更香；太长的切成两段。
steps.en: Strip off the husks and silk — leaving the innermost layer or two on adds flavour — and cut long cobs in half.

steps.zh: 放进锅里，加水没过玉米，大火烧开后转中火煮 8–10 分钟；糯玉米要煮 15–20 分钟。
steps.en: Cover with water in a pot, bring to the boil and cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes (15–20 minutes for waxy corn).

steps.zh: 捞出沥干，喜欢的话趁热抹一点黄油，撒少许盐。
steps.en: Drain, and rub with a little butter and a sprinkle of salt while hot, if you like.

summary.zh: 先煮后烤，外皮金黄酥脆，里面绵软粉糯。
summary.en: Parboiled, then roasted in hot oil until crisp and golden outside and fluffy inside.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 220°C。土豆去皮，切成 4–5 厘米的大块。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 220°C. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 4–5 cm chunks.

steps.zh: 锅里烧开水，加一小撮盐，放入土豆煮 7–8 分钟，到外层变软、中间还硬。沥干后盖上锅盖晃几下，把表面晃得毛糙，烤出来才酥脆。
steps.en: Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water for 7–8 minutes, until soft on the outside but still firm in the middle. Drain, put the lid back on and shake the pot to rough up the edges; that's what makes them crisp.

steps.zh: 煮土豆的同时，烤盘里倒入橄榄油，放进烤箱烧热 5 分钟。小心取出，放入土豆在热油里翻匀，加拍扁的蒜和香草，撒盐，铺成一层。
steps.en: Meanwhile heat the olive oil in a roasting tin in the oven for 5 minutes. Take it out carefully, tip in the potatoes and turn them in the hot oil, add the crushed garlic and herbs, salt them and spread them in a single layer.

steps.zh: 烤 30–35 分钟，中途翻一两次，到外皮金黄酥脆，撒黑胡椒，趁热吃。
steps.en: Roast for 30–35 minutes, turning once or twice, until golden and crisp; grind over some pepper and serve hot.

summary.zh: 台式家常味道：五花肉丁和炸香的红葱头一起慢慢卤到软糯油亮，浇在热米饭上，再配一颗卤蛋。
summary.en: Taiwanese comfort food — diced pork belly braised slowly with fried shallots and five-spice until glossy and meltingly soft, spooned over hot rice with a braised egg.

steps.zh: 五花肉切 1 厘米小丁（稍微冻硬更好切），红葱头和蒜切薄片。鸡蛋冷水下锅，水开后煮 8 分钟，过冷水剥壳。大米淘好，按平常的方法煮饭。
steps.en: Cut the pork into 1 cm dice (it is easier half-frozen) and thinly slice the shallots and garlic. Put the eggs in cold water, bring to the boil, cook for 8 minutes, then cool and peel. Rinse the rice and cook it as usual.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中小火下红葱头，不停翻动炸 5–8 分钟到金黄，加蒜片再炒 1 分钟，盛出；别炸到深褐色，会发苦。
steps.en: Fry the shallots in the oil over medium-low heat, stirring, for 5–8 minutes until golden; add the garlic for another minute, then lift them out. Don't let them go dark brown or they turn bitter.

steps.zh: 同一锅里下肉丁，中火炒 5–6 分钟到出油、表面微黄，加料酒、生抽、老抽和冰糖翻炒上色。
steps.en: In the same pot, fry the pork over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until the fat runs and it colours a little, then add the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, dark soy and rock sugar and stir until evenly coated.

steps.zh: 倒回红葱头和蒜，加五香粉、白胡椒和 700 毫升热水，放入鸡蛋，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 50–60 分钟，中途搅几次防粘底，顺便给鸡蛋翻面。
steps.en: Return the shallots and garlic, add the five-spice, white pepper and 700 ml hot water and put in the eggs; bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 50–60 minutes, stirring now and then so it doesn't catch and turning the eggs.

steps.zh: 开盖中火收汁 5–10 分钟，到汤汁浓稠油亮，尝一下再决定加不加盐。喜欢的话，把青菜放进开水焯 1 分钟。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over medium heat for 5–10 minutes until thick and glossy; taste before adding any salt. If you like, blanch the bok choy in boiling water for a minute.

steps.zh: 米饭盛碗，浇上卤肉和汤汁，每碗配一颗对半切开的卤蛋和青菜。
steps.en: Spoon the pork and sauce over bowls of rice and serve each with a halved egg and the greens.

summary.zh: 广东大排档的经典：大火把河粉炒得干身油亮、带着镬气，牛肉滑嫩，豆芽爽脆。
summary.en: A Cantonese classic — flat rice noodles tossed over fierce heat until smoky and glossy, with tender beef and crunchy bean sprouts.

steps.zh: 牛肉片加 ½ 汤匙生抽、½ 茶匙糖、淀粉和 1 汤匙水抓匀，再拌入 1 茶匙油，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the beef with ½ tbsp of the soy sauce, ½ tsp of the sugar, the cornflour and 1 tbsp water, then stir in 1 tsp of the oil; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 河粉用手轻轻撕散，冷藏过变硬的先用微波炉加热 1 分钟再撕；葱切 4–5 厘米长段，葱白和葱绿分开；剩下的生抽、老抽和糖调匀。
steps.en: Gently pull the noodles apart by hand (if they are stiff from the fridge, microwave them for a minute first). Cut the spring onions into 4–5 cm lengths, keeping the whites and greens apart, and stir the rest of the soy sauce with the dark soy and the rest of the sugar.

steps.zh: 锅烧到冒烟，放 1 汤匙油，下牛肉大火快炒到八成熟，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, add 1 tbsp of the oil and sear the beef over high heat until nearly done; take it out.

steps.zh: 补入剩下的油，下洋葱和葱白炒香，放河粉，大火用筷子挑散、轻轻翻动 2 分钟，别用锅铲用力炒，免得河粉碎，让它略微煎出焦香；再淋入调好的酱油，翻匀上色。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the onion and spring onion whites until fragrant, then add the noodles and toss over high heat for 2 minutes, lifting them with chopsticks or tongs rather than stirring so they don't break, and letting them catch a little; pour in the soy mixture and toss until evenly coloured.

steps.zh: 放豆芽、牛肉和葱绿，大火翻炒 1 分钟，豆芽刚断生就出锅。
steps.en: Add the bean sprouts, beef and spring onion greens and toss over high heat for a minute, until the sprouts just wilt; serve straight away.

summary.zh: 鸡蛋面先煎到微微焦脆，再和嫩肉丝、包菜丝一起大火翻炒，酱香入味。
summary.en: Egg noodles fried until lightly crisp, then tossed over high heat with tender pork and shredded cabbage in a savoury soy glaze.

steps.zh: 肉丝加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒、淀粉和白胡椒抓匀，腌 10 分钟。包菜和胡萝卜切丝，葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开。
steps.en: Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, the cornflour and the white pepper and leave for 10 minutes. Shred the cabbage and carrot and cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the whites and greens apart.

steps.zh: 面条放进开水煮 1 分钟（干面按包装时间少煮 1–2 分钟），捞出过凉水，沥得很干，拌入 1 茶匙油防粘。
steps.en: Boil the noodles for 1 minute (dried ones for 1–2 minutes less than the packet says), rinse under cold water, drain very well and toss with 1 tsp of the oil so they don't stick.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，把面条铺开，中火煎 2–3 分钟到底面微焦，翻面再煎 1–2 分钟，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the wok, spread the noodles out and fry over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly crisp underneath, then turn them and fry for another 1–2 minutes; take them out.

steps.zh: 补入剩下的油，大火下肉丝炒散，炒到完全变白，再加包菜、胡萝卜、豆芽和葱白炒 1–2 分钟到断生。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the pork over high heat until it has all turned white, then add the cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts and spring onion whites for 1–2 minutes until just tender.

steps.zh: 倒回面条，淋入剩下的生抽、老抽和糖，用筷子挑散翻匀上色，放葱绿，尝一下咸淡再加盐，滴几滴香油出锅。
steps.en: Return the noodles with the rest of the soy sauce, the dark soy and the sugar and toss with chopsticks or tongs until evenly coloured; add the spring onion greens, taste for salt and finish with a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 四川街头小吃：麻辣红油汁拌细面，盖上酥香的肉臊和花生碎。
summary.en: Sichuan street food — thin noodles in a numbing, chilli-red sauce, topped with crisp-fried pork and crushed peanuts.

note.zh: 剁碎；有宜宾芽菜更地道
note.en: finely chopped; Yibin ya cai is more traditional

steps.zh: 榨菜剁碎，蒜切末，葱切葱花，花生压碎；花椒用干锅小火焙香后磨成粉。
steps.en: Finely chop the zha cai, mince the garlic, chop the spring onion and crush the peanuts; toast the Sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan over low heat, then grind them.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下肉末炒散，炒 5–6 分钟到水分收干、微微焦黄，加料酒、1 茶匙生抽和榨菜碎再炒 2 分钟，盛出。
steps.en: Fry the mince in the oil over medium heat, breaking it up, for 5–6 minutes until dry and lightly browned; add the Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp of the soy sauce and the zha cai, fry for 2 minutes more and take it out.

steps.zh: 把芝麻酱、剩下的生抽、醋、糖、蒜末、花椒粉和红油平均分到每个碗里。
steps.en: Divide the sesame paste, the rest of the soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar, garlic, ground Sichuan pepper and chilli oil between the bowls.

steps.zh: 面条放进开水按包装时间煮熟，最后 1 分钟放青菜一起烫。每个碗先舀入 2 汤匙煮面的热水，把酱料搅开。
steps.en: Cook the noodles in boiling water for the time on the packet, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Stir 2 tbsp of the hot cooking water into each bowl to loosen the sauce.

steps.zh: 面条和青菜捞进碗里，铺上肉臊，撒花生碎和葱花，吃之前从碗底拌匀。
steps.en: Lift the noodles and greens into the bowls, spoon over the pork, scatter with the peanuts and spring onion and toss from the bottom before eating.

summary.zh: 夏天的味道：凉面拌上浓香的麻酱汁，配爽脆的黄瓜丝和手撕鸡丝。
summary.en: A summer favourite — chilled noodles in a rich sesame sauce with crisp cucumber and shredded chicken.

steps.zh: 一锅水烧开，放入鸡胸肉、姜片和料酒，再开后转最小火煮 8 分钟，关火盖盖焖 5 分钟，到最厚的地方切开也不再发粉。
steps.en: Bring a pan of water to the boil, add the chicken, ginger and Shaoxing wine, return to the boil, then poach on the lowest heat for 8 minutes; turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, until the thickest part is no longer pink when cut.

steps.zh: 同时另一锅煮面，按包装时间煮熟，捞出用冷水冲到完全凉透，沥干后拌入香油抖散，防止粘连。
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the noodles in another pot for the time on the packet, rinse under cold water until completely cool, drain well and toss with the sesame oil so they don't stick.

steps.zh: 黄瓜切细丝，蒜捣成泥。芝麻酱分几次加入 3 汤匙煮鸡的汤或凉开水，搅成顺滑的稀糊，再加生抽、醋、糖和蒜泥调匀。
steps.en: Cut the cucumber into fine strips and crush the garlic. Stir 3 tbsp of the chicken's cooking water (or cooled boiled water) into the sesame paste a little at a time until smooth and pourable, then mix in the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and garlic.

steps.zh: 鸡胸肉捞出稍凉，顺着纹理撕成细丝；葱切葱花。
steps.en: Lift out the chicken, let it cool a little and tear it into fine shreds along the grain; chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 面条装碗，铺上黄瓜丝和鸡丝，淋上麻酱汁，喜欢辣的加红油，撒花生碎和葱花，拌匀吃。
steps.en: Pile the noodles into bowls, top with the cucumber and chicken and pour over the sauce; add chilli oil if you like heat, scatter with the peanuts and spring onion and toss before eating.

summary.zh: 广式煲仔饭：腊肠的油香渗进米饭，锅底结一层焦脆锅巴，淋上豉油拌着吃。
summary.en: Cantonese claypot rice — the sausage's savoury fat seeps into the rice, a crisp crust forms underneath and a sweet soy dressing goes over the top.

steps.zh: 大米淘净，用清水泡 20 分钟，沥干。
steps.en: Rinse the rice, soak it in fresh water for 20 minutes and drain.

steps.zh: 砂锅（或厚底锅）内壁抹一层油，放入大米和 1¾ 杯水，中火烧开（砂锅火太猛容易裂），不盖盖煮 5–8 分钟，到水面降到和米齐平、表面出现小孔。
steps.en: Brush the inside of a claypot (or heavy-based pot) with a little of the oil, add the rice and 1¾ cups water and bring to the boil over medium heat (a claypot can crack over fierce heat); cook uncovered for 5–8 minutes, until the water has dropped to the level of the rice and small holes appear.

steps.zh: 铺上腊肠片和姜丝，盖盖转最小火焖 10–12 分钟，到米饭熟透。
steps.en: Lay the sausage and ginger on top, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10–12 minutes, until the rice is tender.

steps.zh: 沿锅边淋一圈剩下的油，盖盖转中火 2–3 分钟，慢慢转动锅子让锅底均匀受热，听到噼啪声、闻到焦香就关火，再焖 5 分钟。
steps.en: Drizzle the rest of the oil around the edge, cover and turn the heat to medium for 2–3 minutes, turning the pot so the whole base heats, until it crackles and smells toasty; turn off the heat and leave for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 同时把菜心放进开水焯 1 分钟捞出；生抽、老抽和糖搅到糖化开；葱切葱花。
steps.en: Meanwhile, blanch the choy sum in boiling water for a minute and drain; stir the soy sauce, dark soy and sugar until the sugar dissolves; chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 开盖摆上菜心，淋上酱油汁，撒葱花，连锅巴一起拌匀吃。
steps.en: Arrange the choy sum on top, pour over the soy dressing, scatter with spring onion and mix everything up, crust and all.

summary.zh: 北方家常味道：白菜猪肉馅鲜嫩多汁，一家人围在一起包，煮好蘸醋吃。
summary.en: A northern Chinese family favourite — juicy pork and cabbage dumplings, wrapped together, boiled and dipped in black vinegar.

steps.zh: 白菜切碎，加 ½ 茶匙盐拌匀，放 15 分钟出水，再用手或干净的纱布把水分挤干。葱、姜切末。
steps.en: Finely chop the cabbage, toss it with ½ tsp of the salt and leave for 15 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as you can with your hands or a clean cloth. Mince the spring onion and ginger.

steps.zh: 肉末加生抽、料酒、剩下的盐、白胡椒和姜末，朝一个方向搅拌；3 汤匙水分三次加入，每次都搅到吸收，搅到肉馅黏稠起胶。
steps.en: Mix the pork with the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, the rest of the salt, the white pepper and the ginger, stirring in one direction; add the 3 tbsp water in three goes, stirring until each is absorbed and the filling is sticky.

steps.zh: 白菜碎先拌入食用油和香油，再和葱末一起拌进肉馅，拌匀就停，久搅会出水。
steps.en: Toss the cabbage with the cooking oil and sesame oil, then fold it into the pork with the spring onion; stop as soon as it is even, as overmixing makes it watery.

steps.zh: 每张饺子皮中间放约 1 汤匙馅，对折后把边缘捏紧，喜欢的话捏出褶子；包好的饺子放在铺了烘焙纸的托盘上，彼此别挨着。
steps.en: Put about 1 tbsp of filling in the middle of each wrapper, fold it in half and pinch the edges firmly shut, pleating them if you like; set the dumplings on a tray lined with baking paper, not touching.

steps.zh: 大锅水烧开，分批下饺子，用勺背轻推防粘；每次水再开就加半碗冷水，共加三次，到饺子鼓起浮起、肉馅熟透，约 6–8 分钟。
steps.en: Bring a large pot of water to the boil and cook the dumplings in batches, nudging them with the back of a spoon so they don't stick. Each time the water returns to the boil, add half a bowl of cold water; after the third time they should be puffed up and floating, with the filling cooked through (6–8 minutes in all).

steps.zh: 捞出装盘，蘸醋吃。多包的生饺子可以冷冻起来，下次不用解冻直接煮，多煮 2–3 分钟。
steps.en: Lift them out and serve with black vinegar for dipping. Extra uncooked dumplings freeze well; cook them from frozen for 2–3 minutes longer.

summary.zh: 皮薄馅嫩的鲜肉馄饨，配一碗清鲜的热汤，早餐夜宵都合适。
summary.en: Delicate pork wontons in a light, savoury broth — just right for breakfast or a late supper.

note.en: a little fat keeps it juicy

note.zh: 鸡汤或骨头汤，低盐的更好
note.en: chicken or pork bone; low-salt is best

steps.zh: 葱切葱花。肉末加姜末、鸡蛋、1 汤匙生抽、料酒、½ 茶匙盐和少许白胡椒，朝一个方向用力搅拌；3 汤匙水分几次加入，搅到肉馅黏稠起胶，再拌入一半葱花和 1 茶匙香油。
steps.en: Chop the spring onions. Mix the pork with the ginger, egg, 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, ½ tsp salt and a little white pepper, stirring hard in one direction; add the 3 tbsp water a little at a time and keep stirring until the filling is sticky, then mix in half the spring onion and 1 tsp of the sesame oil.

steps.zh: 每张馄饨皮放 1 小勺馅（约 10 克），对折成长方形，再把两端向中间拢起捏紧；包好的放在铺了烘焙纸的托盘上。多包的生馄饨可以直接冷冻。
steps.en: Put a heaped teaspoon of filling (about 10 g) on each wrapper, fold it in half into a rectangle, then bring the two ends together and pinch them; set the wontons on a tray lined with baking paper. Extra uncooked wontons can go straight into the freezer.

steps.zh: 高汤烧开，保持微滚。每个碗里放少许生抽、盐、白胡椒和香油，再放撕碎的紫菜、虾皮和剩下的葱花。
steps.en: Bring the stock to the boil and keep it simmering. Into each bowl put a little soy sauce, salt, white pepper and sesame oil, plus torn laver, dried shrimp and the rest of the spring onion.

steps.zh: 另一大锅水烧开，下馄饨，用勺背轻推防粘，浮起后再煮 1–2 分钟，到肉馅熟透，共约 4–5 分钟，冷冻的多煮 2 分钟；青菜最后 1 分钟放进去一起烫。
steps.en: Bring a large pot of water to the boil and add the wontons, nudging them so they don't stick; once they float, cook 1–2 minutes more until the filling is cooked through, 4–5 minutes in all (2 minutes longer from frozen). Add the bok choy for the last minute.

steps.zh: 每碗冲入约 250 毫升滚烫的高汤，捞入馄饨和青菜，趁热吃。
steps.en: Pour about 250 ml of the boiling stock into each bowl, add the wontons and greens and eat hot.

summary.zh: 台式红烧牛肉面：牛腱慢炖到软烂，汤头浓郁微辣，配劲道的面条和青菜。
summary.en: Taiwanese-style — beef shank simmered for hours into a rich, gently spicy broth, served with chewy noodles and greens.

note.zh: 约 300 克；或其他绿叶菜
note.en: about 300 g; or other leafy greens

steps.zh: 牛肉切 3–4 厘米块，冷水下锅，加 1 汤匙料酒和两片姜，烧开后撇去浮沫，再煮 3 分钟，捞出用温水洗净。
steps.en: Cut the beef into 3–4 cm chunks and put it in cold water with 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine and two slices of the ginger; bring to the boil, skim, cook for 3 minutes more, then rinse in warm water.

steps.zh: 番茄切块，葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开，蒜拍扁。锅里放油，中小火下剩下的姜片、蒜、葱白、八角、花椒、桂皮和香叶炒香，再下豆瓣酱炒 1–2 分钟到出红油。
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into chunks, cut the spring onions into lengths (keeping the greens aside) and crush the garlic. Fry the rest of the ginger, the garlic, spring onion whites, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, cinnamon and bay leaves in the oil over medium-low heat until fragrant, then add the chilli bean paste and fry for 1–2 minutes until the oil turns red.

steps.zh: 放入牛肉和番茄翻炒 2 分钟，加剩下的料酒、生抽、老抽和冰糖炒匀，倒入 2.5 升热水，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 1.5–2 小时，到筷子能轻松插透牛肉。
steps.en: Add the beef and tomatoes and toss for 2 minutes, then the rest of the wine, the soy sauce, dark soy and rock sugar; pour in 2.5 litres of hot water, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 1½–2 hours, until a chopstick slides easily into the beef.

steps.zh: 捞出香料、姜片和葱段，尝一下汤再加盐。另一锅水烧开，按包装时间煮面，最后 1 分钟放青菜一起烫熟，捞进大碗。
steps.en: Fish out the whole spices, ginger and spring onion and taste the broth for salt. Cook the noodles in a separate pot of boiling water for the time on the packet, adding the bok choy for the last minute, and lift them into large bowls.

steps.zh: 每碗舀入滚烫的牛肉和汤，撒上切碎的葱绿，喜欢的话配一点酸菜。
steps.en: Ladle the hot beef and broth over the noodles, scatter with the chopped spring onion greens and add some pickled mustard greens if you like.

summary.zh: 不加奶油，靠意面的余温把鸡蛋和芝士拌成顺滑的酱汁，配焦香培根和现磨黑胡椒。
summary.en: No cream needed — eggs and parmesan turn silky in the heat of the pasta, with crisp bacon and plenty of black pepper.

note.en: for the pasta water; go easy

steps.zh: 一大锅水烧开，加少许盐（培根和芝士都偏咸，别放多），下意面按包装时间煮。
steps.en: Bring a large pot of water to the boil, salt it lightly (the bacon and cheese are salty) and cook the spaghetti for the time on the packet.

steps.zh: 同时把鸡蛋打进碗里，加入大部分帕玛森芝士和黑胡椒，搅匀。
steps.en: Meanwhile, beat the eggs in a bowl with most of the parmesan and the black pepper.

steps.zh: 培根放进冷的平底锅（培根很瘦的话加 1 茶匙橄榄油），中火煎 5–6 分钟到出油、边缘焦脆，关火。
steps.en: Put the bacon in a cold frying pan (with 1 tsp olive oil if it is very lean) and fry over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until the fat runs and the edges crisp; turn off the heat.

steps.zh: 意面煮好前舀出约 100 毫升煮面水。意面捞出直接放进培根锅里拌匀，让锅稍微降温 1 分钟。
steps.en: Just before the pasta is ready, scoop out about 100 ml of the cooking water. Lift the spaghetti straight into the bacon pan, toss well and let it cool for a minute.

steps.zh: 锅离火，倒入蛋液和 2–3 汤匙煮面水，快速翻拌，让意面的热度把蛋液烫熟，变成顺滑、能挂住面条的酱汁；太稠就再加点面水。酱汁一直很稀的话，放回最小火上不停翻拌几秒钟，久了会结成蛋花。
steps.en: Off the heat, add the egg mixture and 2–3 tbsp of the pasta water and toss quickly, so the heat of the pasta cooks the egg into a silky sauce that clings to the strands; loosen with a little more water if it is too thick. If it stays runny, put the pan back on the lowest heat for a few seconds, tossing all the time — any longer and the egg scrambles.

steps.zh: 撒上剩下的帕玛森，再磨一点黑胡椒，马上吃。
steps.en: Finish with the rest of the parmesan and another grind of pepper and serve at once.

summary.zh: 番茄牛肉酱、奶香白酱和面皮层层叠起，烤到芝士金黄冒泡，适合一家人分着吃。
summary.en: Layers of rich beef ragù, creamy white sauce and pasta, baked until the cheese is golden and bubbling — one to share.

steps.zh: 洋葱、胡萝卜和芹菜切小丁，蒜切末。锅里放橄榄油，中小火把蔬菜丁炒软，约 8 分钟，再加蒜末炒香。
steps.en: Finely dice the onion, carrot and celery and mince the garlic. Soften the vegetables in the olive oil over medium-low heat for about 8 minutes, then add the garlic.

steps.zh: 转大火下牛肉末炒散到变色，加番茄膏炒 1 分钟，倒入番茄罐头，用勺子压碎，加香草和香叶，小火煮 20 分钟到浓稠，加盐和黑胡椒调味，取出香叶。
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add the mince and break it up until browned; stir in the tomato paste for a minute, then add the tomatoes, crushing them with a spoon, plus the herbs and bay leaf. Simmer for 20 minutes until thick, season with salt and pepper and remove the bay leaf.

steps.zh: 同时做白酱：另一锅小火化开黄油，加面粉炒 1–2 分钟，离火分几次倒入牛奶，边倒边搅到顺滑，再回到中火搅 5 分钟到浓稠，加少许盐。烤箱预热到 180°C。
steps.en: Meanwhile make the white sauce — melt the butter in another pan over low heat, stir in the flour for 1–2 minutes, then take it off the heat and whisk in the milk a little at a time until smooth. Return it to medium heat and stir for about 5 minutes until thick; season with a little salt. Heat the oven to 180°C.

steps.zh: 烤盘（约 20×30 厘米）底部抹一层肉酱，铺一层面皮，再铺肉酱、淋白酱，这样叠三四层，最上面是面皮和白酱，撒上芝士和帕玛森。
steps.en: Spread a little meat sauce over the base of a baking dish (about 20 × 30 cm) and cover with lasagne sheets, then meat sauce and white sauce; repeat for three or four layers, finishing with sheets and white sauce, and scatter over the cheese and parmesan.

steps.zh: 盖上锡纸烤 20 分钟，揭开再烤 15 分钟，到表面金黄冒泡、刀能轻松插透面皮；出炉静置 5–10 分钟再切。
steps.en: Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 15 minutes, until golden and bubbling and a knife slides easily through the pasta. Leave to rest for 5–10 minutes before cutting.

summary.zh: 米粒一勺一勺吸饱高汤，慢慢搅出奶油般的口感，配煎得金黄的蘑菇和帕玛森芝士。
summary.en: Rice stirred ladle by ladle into a creamy risotto, with golden fried mushrooms and parmesan.

note.zh: 切片；混合几种蘑菇更香
note.en: sliced; a mix of mushrooms is tastier

note.zh: 鸡汤或蔬菜高汤，低盐的更好
note.en: chicken or vegetable; low-salt is best

steps.zh: 高汤倒进小锅加热，保持微微冒泡。洋葱和蒜切碎，蘑菇切片。
steps.en: Heat the stock in a small pan and keep it just simmering. Finely chop the onion and garlic and slice the mushrooms.

steps.zh: 宽口平底锅里放橄榄油和一半黄油，中大火下蘑菇炒 5–6 分钟，到出的水收干、表面金黄，加少许盐，盛出一半留着最后放。
steps.en: Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the mushrooms for 5–6 minutes, until their juices have cooked off and they are golden; season lightly and set half aside for the top.

steps.zh: 转中小火，下洋葱炒软约 4 分钟，加蒜末和米，翻炒 1–2 分钟到米粒边缘变透明。
steps.en: Lower the heat, soften the onion for about 4 minutes, then add the garlic and rice and stir for 1–2 minutes until the edges of the grains turn translucent.

steps.zh: 舀入一勺热高汤，不停搅拌到汤汁快吸干再加下一勺，这样持续 18–20 分钟，到米粒变软、中心还有一点嚼劲，整体像稠粥一样能慢慢流动。
steps.en: Add a ladle of hot stock and stir until it is almost absorbed before adding the next; keep going for 18–20 minutes, until the rice is soft with a slight bite in the centre and the risotto flows slowly like a thick porridge.

steps.zh: 关火，拌入剩下的黄油和大部分帕玛森，盖盖静置 2 分钟，加盐和黑胡椒调味。盛盘后放上留出的蘑菇，撒剩下的芝士和欧芹。
steps.en: Off the heat, stir in the rest of the butter and most of the parmesan, cover and leave for 2 minutes, then season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with the reserved mushrooms, the rest of the parmesan and the parsley.

summary.zh: 鸡肚里塞上柠檬和蒜，烤到鸡皮金黄酥脆，鸡肉鲜嫩多汁。
summary.en: A whole chicken stuffed with lemon and garlic, roasted to crisp golden skin and juicy meat.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。鸡从冰箱取出，用厨房纸把里外擦干；鸡皮越干，烤出来越脆。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Take the chicken out of the fridge and pat it dry inside and out with paper towels; the drier the skin, the crisper it roasts.

steps.zh: 柠檬切半，和拍扁的蒜、一半香草一起塞进鸡肚。喜欢的话，用手指把软化的黄油塞进鸡胸的皮下抹匀。鸡皮抹上橄榄油，里外撒盐、黑胡椒和剩下的香草。
steps.en: Halve the lemon and push it into the cavity with the crushed garlic and half the herbs. If you like, work the softened butter under the breast skin with your fingers. Rub the skin with the olive oil and season inside and out with salt, pepper and the rest of the herbs.

steps.zh: 洋葱切厚片铺在烤盘里，鸡胸朝上放在洋葱上；没有洋葱就直接放进烤盘。烤 60–75 分钟（约 1.5 千克的鸡），中途舀起盘里的汁淋一次。
steps.en: Lay the onion in thick slices in a roasting dish and sit the chicken on top, breast up, or put it straight in the dish. Roast for 60–75 minutes for a 1.5 kg bird, spooning the pan juices over it once halfway.

steps.zh: 用刀插进大腿最厚处检查：流出的汁是清的、骨头边没有粉色就熟了，有温度计的话大腿处应到 75°C。没熟就再烤 10 分钟再查。
steps.en: Pierce the thickest part of the thigh to check — it is done when the juices run clear and there is no pink by the bone, or 75°C on a thermometer. If not, roast for another 10 minutes and check again.

steps.zh: 取出后松松地盖上锡纸，静置 10–15 分钟再切，淋上盘里的汁。
steps.en: Cover loosely with foil and rest for 10–15 minutes before carving, then spoon over the pan juices.

summary.zh: 羊排大火煎到外焦里嫩，肥边酥脆，带着蒜和香草的香气。
summary.en: Lamb cutlets seared to a browned crust and a pink, juicy middle, with crisp fat and a hint of garlic and herbs.

note.zh: 法式羊排，约 2 厘米厚

steps.zh: 有时间的话，羊排提前 15 分钟从冰箱取出。用厨房纸擦干，两面撒盐、黑胡椒和香草；蒜拍扁。
steps.en: If there is time, take the lamb out of the fridge 15 minutes ahead. Pat the cutlets dry and season both sides with salt, pepper and the herbs; crush the garlic.

steps.zh: 平底锅中大火烧热，放油，羊排平铺下锅，不要挤在一起。每面煎 2–3 分钟到焦黄，约 2 厘米厚时是三分到五分熟；喜欢全熟就每面多煎 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Heat a frying pan over medium-high heat, add the oil and lay in the cutlets without crowding. Cook for 2–3 minutes a side until well browned — medium-rare to medium for 2 cm — or 1–2 minutes more a side for well done.

steps.zh: 用夹子把羊排立起来，肥边贴着锅煎 1 分钟到酥脆；同时放入蒜，煎香后舀起锅里的油淋在羊排上。
steps.en: Stand the cutlets on their fatty edge with tongs for a minute to crisp the fat, adding the garlic at the same time, and spoon the hot fat over them.

steps.zh: 取出静置 3–5 分钟，让肉汁回流，挤上柠檬汁即可。
steps.en: Rest for 3–5 minutes so the juices settle, then squeeze over the lemon and serve.

summary.zh: 羊腿扎满蒜条、抹上香草和橄榄油，烤到外皮焦香，切开肉嫩多汁。
summary.en: A leg of lamb studded with garlic and rubbed with herbs and olive oil, roasted to a browned crust and a juicy middle.

steps.zh: 有时间的话，羊腿提前 30–60 分钟从冰箱取出回温。烤箱预热到 220°C，蒜切成小条。
steps.en: If there is time, take the lamb out of the fridge 30–60 minutes ahead. Heat the oven to 220°C and cut the garlic into slivers.

steps.zh: 用小尖刀在羊腿上扎十几个约 2 厘米深的小口，每个口里塞一条蒜。橄榄油加香草、盐和黑胡椒拌匀，抹遍羊腿表面。
steps.en: With a small sharp knife, make a dozen or so slits about 2 cm deep all over the lamb and push a sliver of garlic into each. Mix the olive oil with the herbs, salt and pepper and rub it all over.

steps.zh: 羊腿放进烤盘，220°C 烤 15 分钟上色，再转 180°C 烤 60–70 分钟，约 1.5 千克的羊腿这时中心还带粉色；喜欢全熟就烤 80–90 分钟。中途舀起盘里的汁淋一两次。
steps.en: Roast in a roasting dish at 220°C for 15 minutes to brown, then turn the oven down to 180°C for 60–70 minutes, which leaves a 1.5 kg leg pink in the middle, or 80–90 minutes for well done. Baste with the pan juices once or twice.

steps.zh: 取出后松松地盖上锡纸，静置 15–20 分钟让肉汁回流，再贴着骨头切片，淋上盘里的汁。
steps.en: Cover loosely with foil and rest for 15–20 minutes so the juices settle, then carve into slices off the bone and spoon over the pan juices.

summary.zh: 鸡腿裹上生抽蜂蜜酱汁进烤箱，烤到红亮微焦，甜咸入味。
summary.en: Drumsticks coated in honey and soy sauce and roasted until sticky, glossy and caramelised at the edges.

steps.zh: 鸡腿用厨房纸擦干，在肉厚的地方斜划两三刀，方便入味。
steps.en: Pat the drumsticks dry and cut two or three deep slashes into the thickest part of each so the glaze can soak in.

steps.zh: 生抽、蜂蜜、油、蒜末和姜泥搅匀，倒在鸡腿上抓匀。有时间的话盖好放冰箱腌 30 分钟到一夜。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, honey, oil, minced garlic and grated ginger, pour over the drumsticks and turn to coat. If there is time, cover and leave in the fridge for 30 minutes or up to overnight.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。烤盘铺上烘焙纸（蜂蜜容易烤焦粘盘），摆上鸡腿，腌汁留着，烤 20 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a tray with baking paper, since honey catches and sticks. Lay out the drumsticks, keeping the marinade, and roast for 20 minutes.

steps.zh: 取出翻面，刷上剩下的腌汁，再烤 15–20 分钟，到表面红亮、边缘微焦。在最厚处贴着骨头切开检查，没有粉色、流出的汁是清的才算熟。
steps.en: Turn them, brush with the rest of the marinade and roast for 15–20 minutes more, until glossy and dark at the edges. Cut into the thickest part by the bone to check — no pink and clear juices means they are done.

steps.zh: 盛盘，淋上烤盘里的汁，撒上葱花即可。
steps.en: Spoon over the juices from the tray and scatter with sliced spring onion.

summary.zh: 鸡胸肉敲薄裹上面包糠，煎到金黄酥脆，挤点柠檬汁趁热吃。
summary.en: Thin chicken breast in a crisp golden crumb, eaten hot with a squeeze of lemon.

steps.zh: 鸡胸肉横刀片成两三片，盖上保鲜膜，用擀面杖或锅底敲成约 1 厘米厚，两面撒盐和黑胡椒。
steps.en: Slice the chicken horizontally into two or three thin steaks, cover with cling film and beat with a rolling pin or the base of a pan to about 1 cm thick. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 准备三个盘子，分别放面粉、打散的鸡蛋和面包糠。鸡排先裹一层面粉，抖掉多余的，再蘸蛋液，最后两面按上面包糠。
steps.en: Set out three plates — flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Dust each piece in flour and shake off the excess, dip it in the egg, then press it into the crumbs on both sides.

steps.zh: 平底锅放油，中火烧到丢一点面包糠会滋滋冒泡，下鸡排每面煎 3–4 分钟到金黄酥脆；锅小就分两批煎。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat until a crumb sizzles, then fry the schnitzels for 3–4 minutes a side until golden and crisp, in two batches if the pan is small.

steps.zh: 切开最厚的一块检查，肉全白、没有粉色、流出的汁是清的才算熟；没熟就转小火再煎 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Cut into the thickest piece to check that the meat is white all through, with no pink and clear juices; if not, give it 1–2 minutes more over low heat.

steps.zh: 放在厨房纸上吸掉多余的油，配柠檬角趁热吃。
steps.en: Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lemon wedges.

summary.zh: 香肠煎得焦香，淋上慢慢炒出甜味的洋葱浓汁，配土豆泥最对味。
summary.en: Browned sausages in a rich gravy of slowly cooked, sweet onions — made for mashed potato.

steps.zh: 洋葱对半切开，再顺着纹路切成细丝。
steps.en: Halve the onions and slice them thinly.

steps.zh: 平底锅放油，中小火煎香肠 10–15 分钟，不时翻动，到表面焦黄、中心熟透：切开一根检查，里面没有粉色、流出的汁是清的。盛出保温。
steps.en: Fry the sausages in the oil over medium-low heat for 10–15 minutes, turning often, until browned all over and cooked through — cut one open to check there is no pink and the juices run clear. Lift out and keep warm.

steps.zh: 锅里留下煎香肠的油，下洋葱丝和一小撮盐，中小火炒约 10 分钟，不时翻炒，到洋葱软烂、变成焦糖色。
steps.en: Cook the onions in the sausage fat with a pinch of salt over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and deep golden.

steps.zh: 撒入面粉炒 1 分钟，慢慢倒入高汤，边倒边搅以免结块。加香草，小火煮 3–5 分钟到浓稠，加盐和黑胡椒调味。
steps.en: Stir in the flour for a minute, then pour in the stock gradually, stirring so it stays smooth. Add the herbs and simmer for 3–5 minutes until thick; season with salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 香肠放回锅里，裹上洋葱汁热透即可。
steps.en: Return the sausages to the pan and turn them in the gravy until hot.

summary.zh: 肉丸先煎得金黄，再放进番茄酱汁里慢慢煮，酸甜浓郁。
summary.en: Golden meatballs simmered gently in a rich, tangy tomato sauce.

steps.zh: 洋葱和蒜切末。肉末加鸡蛋、面包糠、少许蒜末、½ 茶匙盐和黑胡椒，轻轻拌匀，别搅过头，丸子才嫩；搓成核桃大小的丸子，约 12 个。
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, a little of the garlic, ½ tsp salt and some pepper — gently, as overworking makes them tough — and roll into about 12 walnut-sized balls.

steps.zh: 平底锅放 1 汤匙橄榄油，中火把丸子煎到四面焦黄，约 6–8 分钟，盛出；这时还没熟透，后面接着煮。
steps.en: Brown the meatballs in 1 tbsp of the olive oil over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, turning them, then lift out; they finish cooking in the sauce.

steps.zh: 锅里放剩下的油，小火把洋葱炒软，约 5 分钟，再加剩下的蒜末炒香。倒入番茄罐头，用勺子压碎，加香草、糖和少许盐煮开。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and soften the onion over low heat for about 5 minutes, then stir in the rest of the garlic. Add the tomatoes, crushing them with a spoon, with the herbs, sugar and a little salt, and bring to the boil.

steps.zh: 丸子放回锅里，盖盖小火煮 15 分钟，中途翻一次，到丸子中心熟透、没有粉色，酱汁变浓；尝一下，再加盐和黑胡椒调味。
steps.en: Return the meatballs, cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes, turning once, until they are cooked through with no pink in the middle and the sauce has thickened. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 撒上磨碎的帕玛森芝士，配意面、米饭或面包都好吃。
steps.en: Grate over the parmesan and serve with pasta, rice or crusty bread.

summary.zh: 白肉鱼铺在柠檬片上进烤箱，淋上蒜香柠檬汁，鱼肉嫩滑清香。
summary.en: White fish baked on lemon slices with garlic and herbs until just flaky and tender.

note.zh: 白肉鱼柳，约 2 厘米厚
note.en: firm white fish about 2 cm thick

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。鱼柳用厨房纸擦干，两面撒盐和黑胡椒。柠檬一半切薄片，另一半挤汁；蒜切末。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Pat the fish dry and season both sides with salt and pepper. Thinly slice half the lemon and squeeze the juice from the other half; mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 烤盘抹一层薄油，铺上柠檬片，把鱼柳放在柠檬片上。
steps.en: Oil a baking dish lightly, lay the lemon slices in it and sit the fish on top.

steps.zh: 剩下的橄榄油加柠檬汁、蒜末和香草拌匀，淋在鱼上。
steps.en: Mix the rest of the olive oil with the lemon juice, garlic and herbs and spoon it over the fish.

steps.zh: 烤 10–15 分钟，看鱼的厚薄，到鱼肉变白不透明、用叉子轻轻一拨就能分开。
steps.en: Bake for 10–15 minutes, depending on thickness, until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.

steps.zh: 撒上切碎的欧芹，舀起盘里的汁淋在鱼上即可。
steps.en: Scatter with chopped parsley and spoon the pan juices over to serve.

summary.zh: 猪排煎到两面金黄、肥边焦脆，蒜和香草提香，咬下去满是肉汁。
summary.en: Pork chops seared golden with garlic and herbs — crisp at the edges and juicy inside.

steps.zh: 猪排用厨房纸擦干，在肥边上每隔 2–3 厘米切一小刀，煎的时候不会卷起来。两面撒盐、黑胡椒和香草；蒜拍扁。
steps.en: Pat the chops dry and snip through the fat along the edge every 2–3 cm so they don't curl. Season both sides with salt, pepper and the herbs, and crush the garlic.

steps.zh: 平底锅中大火烧热，放油，下猪排煎 3–4 分钟到底面金黄，翻面转中火再煎 3–4 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chops for 3–4 minutes until golden underneath; turn, lower the heat to medium and cook for 3–4 minutes more.

steps.zh: 最后 2 分钟放入蒜，舀起锅里的油淋在猪排上；再用夹子把猪排立起来，肥边贴锅煎 1 分钟到焦脆。
steps.en: Add the garlic for the last 2 minutes and spoon the hot fat over the chops, then stand them on the fatty edge with tongs for a minute to crisp it.

steps.zh: 在骨头旁边切一小刀检查，肉已发白、没有粉色、流出的汁是清的就熟了；没熟就转小火盖盖再煎 2–3 分钟。
steps.en: Cut near the bone to check — the meat should be white with no pink and the juices clear. If not, cover and cook over low heat for 2–3 minutes more.

steps.zh: 取出静置 3–5 分钟再吃，肉汁更多。
steps.en: Rest for 3–5 minutes before serving so the juices settle.

summary.zh: 番茄、黄瓜、洋葱和橄榄淋上橄榄油，顶上盖一大块咸香的菲达奶酪。
summary.en: Ripe tomato, cucumber, onion and olives in olive oil, topped with a slab of salty feta.

steps.zh: 番茄切大块；黄瓜纵向切半，再切成厚片；洋葱切细圈；青椒去籽切圈。
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, halve the cucumber lengthways and cut it into thick slices, and slice the onion and the seeded green pepper into thin rings.

steps.zh: 蔬菜放进大碗，加大部分橄榄油、柠檬汁、一半香草和少许盐、黑胡椒，轻轻拌匀。
steps.en: Put the vegetables in a wide bowl and toss gently with most of the olive oil, the lemon juice, half the herbs and a little salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 放上橄榄，把菲达奶酪整块放在最上面，或掰成大块，淋上剩下的橄榄油，撒上剩下的香草。
steps.en: Scatter over the olives, lay the feta on top in a slab or in large chunks, drizzle with the rest of the oil and sprinkle with the rest of the herbs.

steps.zh: 马上吃；放久了番茄和黄瓜会出水。
steps.en: Serve straight away; left to sit, the tomatoes and cucumber turn watery.

summary.zh: 卷心菜和胡萝卜切成细丝，拌上蛋黄酱，爽脆清甜，配烤肉、炸鸡都合适。
summary.en: Finely shredded cabbage and carrot in a creamy mayonnaise dressing — crunchy and fresh beside a roast or a barbecue.

steps.zh: 卷心菜去掉硬芯，尽量切成细丝；胡萝卜去皮擦丝；葱切葱花。
steps.en: Cut out the cabbage core and shred the leaves as finely as you can; peel and grate the carrot and slice the spring onion.

steps.zh: 有时间的话，卷心菜丝加一小撮盐抓匀，放 5–10 分钟，再挤掉渗出的水，拌好后不容易出水。
steps.en: If there is time, toss the cabbage with a pinch of salt, leave it for 5–10 minutes and squeeze out the liquid so the slaw doesn't turn watery.

steps.zh: 蛋黄酱、白醋、糖和黑胡椒搅匀；卷心菜没用盐腌过的话，再加少许盐。
steps.en: Whisk the mayonnaise with the vinegar, sugar and pepper, plus a little salt if you didn't salt the cabbage.

steps.zh: 酱汁倒进卷心菜、胡萝卜和葱花里拌匀即可。吃不完的放冰箱冷藏，当天吃完。
steps.en: Toss the dressing through the cabbage, carrot and spring onion. Keep any leftovers in the fridge and eat them the same day.

summary.zh: 胡萝卜用黄油和蜂蜜煮到软嫩，收出一层亮晶晶的糖衣，配烤肉正合适。
summary.en: Carrots simmered in butter and honey until tender and shiny with a sweet glaze — just right beside a roast.

steps.zh: 胡萝卜去皮，斜切成约 1 厘米厚的片，或切成手指粗的条。
steps.en: Peel the carrots and cut them on the diagonal into slices about 1 cm thick, or into finger-thick sticks.

steps.zh: 胡萝卜放进平底锅，加水、黄油、蜂蜜和一小撮盐，水大约到胡萝卜一半高。中火煮开后转小火，盖盖煮 8–10 分钟，到胡萝卜刚好变软。
steps.en: Put the carrots in a frying pan with the water, butter, honey and a pinch of salt — the water should come about halfway up. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 8–10 minutes until just tender.

steps.zh: 开盖转中大火，不时晃动锅子，煮 5–8 分钟到水分收干，汁变得浓稠发亮、裹在胡萝卜上；快收干时留意别煮糊。
steps.en: Uncover, turn the heat up to medium-high and cook for 5–8 minutes, shaking the pan now and then, until the liquid has reduced to a glossy glaze that coats the carrots; watch closely at the end so it doesn't catch.

steps.zh: 撒上黑胡椒和切碎的欧芹即可。
steps.en: Finish with black pepper and chopped parsley.

summary.zh: 小米熬出一层米油，南瓜煮得软烂化进粥里，一碗金黄香甜。
summary.en: Millet simmered until creamy with soft pumpkin stirred through — golden and gently sweet.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1.2 升水烧开；等水开的时候，把小米淘洗两遍沥干，南瓜切成 2 厘米的小块。
steps.en: Bring 1.2 litres of water to the boil; meanwhile rinse the millet twice and drain it, and cut the pumpkin into 2 cm cubes.

steps.zh: 水开后倒入小米，再次烧开后转小火，盖子留条缝防止溢锅，煮 10 分钟，中途搅几下防粘底。
steps.en: Stir in the millet and, once it is boiling again, simmer over low heat for 10 minutes with the lid ajar to stop it boiling over, stirring now and then so it doesn't catch.

steps.zh: 放入南瓜块，继续小火煮 20 分钟，到南瓜软烂、粥变得浓稠，表面浮起一层米油。
steps.en: Add the pumpkin and simmer for 20 minutes more, until it is very soft and the porridge is thick and creamy.

steps.zh: 用勺子把一部分南瓜压碎拌匀，粥会变成金黄色；喜欢甜的加冰糖煮化，最后放枸杞再煮 1 分钟。
steps.en: Mash some of the pumpkin against the side of the pot and stir it in to turn the porridge golden; add the rock sugar if you like it sweet and stir until it dissolves, then add the goji berries for the last minute.

steps.zh: 粥放一会儿会变稠，太稠就加少许开水调开。
steps.en: It thickens as it stands; loosen it with a little boiling water if needed.

summary.zh: 饼皮层层起酥，鼓起来灌进蛋液，刷上甜面酱卷片生菜，街头早餐在家就能做。
summary.en: A flaky flatbread that puffs up to take a filling of egg, brushed with sweet bean sauce and wrapped round lettuce — the street-stall breakfast at home.

note.en: 180 g for the dough and 20 g for the paste

note.zh: 60 毫升开水和 50 毫升凉水

steps.zh: 180 克面粉加一半的盐，先冲入 60 毫升开水，用筷子搅成絮状，再加约 50 毫升凉水，揉成柔软的面团，盖好醒 10–15 分钟。
steps.en: Mix 180 g of the flour with half the salt, stir in 60 ml boiling water with chopsticks until shaggy, then add about 50 ml cold water and knead into a soft dough; cover and rest for 10–15 minutes.

steps.zh: 醒面时调油酥：剩下的 20 克面粉加剩下的盐，浇上 1 汤匙烧热的油，拌成稀糊。鸡蛋加葱花打散。
steps.en: While it rests, pour 1 tbsp hot oil over the remaining 20 g flour and salt and stir into a smooth paste. Beat the eggs with the chopped spring onion.

steps.zh: 面团分成 4 份，每份擀成长方形薄片，抹一层油酥，从长边卷成长条，两头捏紧，盘成蜗牛状，按扁后擀成直径约 18 厘米的圆饼。
steps.en: Divide the dough into 4. Roll each piece into a thin rectangle, spread it with the paste and roll it up from a long side into a rope; pinch the ends, coil it like a snail, press it flat and roll it into a round about 18 cm across.

steps.zh: 平底锅刷薄油，中小火放入饼煎 1 分钟，翻面后饼中间会鼓起；用筷子在鼓起处挑开一个口，灌入四分之一蛋液，马上翻面让蛋液那面朝下。
steps.en: Brush a frying pan with oil and cook a flatbread over medium-low heat for 1 minute; turn it and the middle puffs up. Poke a hole in the puffed part with a chopstick, pour in a quarter of the egg and turn it straight away, egg side down.

steps.zh: 再煎 1–2 分钟到蛋液凝固、两面金黄，盛出；其余几张同样做，锅干了再刷点油。
steps.en: Cook for 1–2 minutes more, until the egg has set and both sides are golden; repeat with the rest, brushing the pan with more oil as needed.

steps.zh: 趁热刷一层甜面酱（喜欢辣的再刷点辣椒油），放一片生菜，卷起来或对折着吃。
steps.en: Brush with sweet bean sauce while hot (and chilli oil if you like heat), add a lettuce leaf and roll or fold it up.

summary.zh: 红茶和卤料慢慢煮、泡上一夜，蛋白入味，剥开是漂亮的大理石花纹。
summary.en: Eggs simmered in spiced tea and soy, then steeped overnight until fragrant all through and marbled when peeled.

note.zh: 约 3 汤匙散茶或 4 个茶包
note.en: about 3 tbsp loose leaf or 4 tea bags

steps.zh: 鸡蛋冷水下锅，水没过鸡蛋，中火烧开后转小火煮 8 分钟，捞出泡冷水 5 分钟。
steps.en: Put the eggs in a pot with cold water to cover, bring to the boil over medium heat and simmer for 8 minutes; move them to cold water for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 用勺背把蛋壳轻轻敲出均匀的裂纹，不要剥掉；裂纹越细越密，花纹越好看。
steps.en: Tap the shells all over with the back of a spoon to crack them without peeling; the finer the cracks, the prettier the marbling.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 升水、红茶、生抽、老抽、冰糖、盐和全部香料，烧开后放入鸡蛋，盖上盖小火煮 30 分钟。
steps.en: Put 1 litre of water in the pot with the tea, both soy sauces, the rock sugar, salt and spices; bring to the boil, add the eggs and simmer gently, covered, for 30 minutes.

steps.zh: 关火，鸡蛋留在汤汁里放凉，再连汤汁一起盖好放冰箱冷藏泡一夜，至少 8 小时，颜色和味道才进得去；不要在室温下放过夜。
steps.en: Turn off the heat and let the eggs cool in the liquid, then cover and refrigerate them in it overnight, at least 8 hours, so the colour and flavour soak in; don't leave them out at room temperature overnight.

steps.zh: 吃的时候连汤汁加热，或放到室温再剥壳；泡在汤汁里冷藏，2–3 天内吃完。
steps.en: Warm them in the liquid or let them come to room temperature, then peel; kept in the liquid in the fridge, eat them within 2–3 days.

how.zh: 剥壳就能吃；连卤汤冷藏可放 3 天，想吃热的放回卤汤里热一热。
how.en: Peel and eat; kept in their liquid in the fridge they last 3 days — warm them in it if you like them hot.

summary.zh: 发面松软，肉馅打足了水，一口咬下去满是肉汁。
summary.en: Soft, fluffy steamed buns around a juicy, savoury pork filling.

note.zh: 270 毫升和面，80 毫升调馅
note.en: 270 ml for the dough and 80 ml for the filling

steps.zh: 酵母和糖用 270 毫升温水化开，倒进面粉里，用筷子搅成絮状，再揉成光滑的面团；盖好放温暖处发酵约 1 小时（天冷要更久），到面团涨到两倍大、手指戳个洞不回缩。
steps.en: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in 270 ml lukewarm water, stir it into the flour with chopsticks until shaggy, then knead into a smooth dough. Cover and leave somewhere warm for about an hour (longer when it's cold), until doubled and a finger hole doesn't spring back.

steps.zh: 发面时调馅：姜切末，葱切葱花；肉末加姜末、生抽、老抽、料酒、盐和白胡椒粉，朝一个方向搅到起胶，再分 3 次加入 80 毫升水，每次都搅到吸收，最后拌入香油，放冰箱冷藏。
steps.en: Make the filling while the dough rises. Mince the ginger and chop the spring onion. Stir the pork with the ginger, both soy sauces, Shaoxing wine, salt and white pepper in one direction until sticky, beat in 80 ml water in three goes, letting each be absorbed, then stir in the sesame oil and chill.

steps.zh: 发好的面团揉几分钟排出气泡，搓成长条，切成 12 个剂子，擀成中间厚、边缘薄、直径 10–12 厘米的圆皮。
steps.en: Knead the risen dough for a few minutes to knock out the air, roll it into a log and cut it into 12 pieces; roll each into a round 10–12 cm across, thicker in the middle than at the edge.

steps.zh: 肉馅拌入葱花，每张皮放一大勺馅，边捏褶边转，收口捏紧；放在垫了油纸或湿屉布的蒸笼里，留出间距，盖上盖再醒 15 分钟。
steps.en: Stir the spring onion into the filling. Put a heaped spoonful on each wrapper, pleat the edge up around it and pinch the top shut; set the buns well apart on baking paper or a damp cloth in the steamer and leave, covered, for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 蒸锅加冷水，放上蒸笼，大火烧开后转中大火蒸 15 分钟，肉馅才能熟透；关火焖 3–5 分钟再开盖，包子不容易塌。
steps.en: Set the steamer over cold water and bring it to the boil, then steam over medium-high heat for 15 minutes so the pork is cooked through; turn off the heat and wait 3–5 minutes before lifting the lid so the buns don't collapse.

steps.zh: 吃不完的放凉后冷冻，早上不用解冻，水开后蒸 15–20 分钟，到中间热透即可。
steps.en: Freeze any leftovers once cool; steam them from frozen for 15–20 minutes once the water boils, until piping hot in the middle.

summary.zh: 吐司吸饱蛋奶液，用黄油煎得外酥里嫩，淋上枫糖浆趁热吃。
summary.en: Bread soaked in egg and milk, fried in butter until crisp outside and custardy within, then drizzled with maple syrup.

note.zh: 厚片吐司，放了一两天的更好
note.en: thick slices; a day or two old is best

steps.zh: 鸡蛋、牛奶、糖、肉桂粉和一小撮盐放进浅盘里打匀。
steps.en: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt together in a shallow dish.

steps.zh: 面包片放进蛋奶液里，每面泡 10–20 秒，让它吸饱但不要泡烂。
steps.en: Lay the bread in the mixture for 10–20 seconds a side, so it soaks it up without falling apart.

steps.zh: 平底锅中小火放一半黄油，融化冒泡后放入两片面包，每面煎 2–3 分钟到金黄，按一下中间不再渗出蛋液。
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium-low heat; when it foams, add two slices and cook for 2–3 minutes a side, until golden and no egg seeps out when you press the middle.

steps.zh: 放剩下的黄油，煎好另外两片，淋上枫糖浆趁热吃。
steps.en: Add the rest of the butter and cook the other two; serve hot with maple syrup.

summary.zh: 黄油煎香的蘑菇和融化的芝士，卷进嫩滑的蛋饼里。
summary.en: Buttery browned mushrooms and melting cheese, rolled up in a soft omelette.

steps.zh: 蘑菇切片；鸡蛋加牛奶和一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Slice the mushrooms; beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 平底锅中大火放一半黄油，下蘑菇炒 3–4 分钟，到出的水收干、表面微微焦黄，加少许盐和黑胡椒，盛出。
steps.en: Fry the mushrooms in half the butter over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes, until their liquid has cooked off and they start to brown; season with a little salt and pepper and set aside.

steps.zh: 转中小火，放一半剩下的黄油，倒入一半蛋液，轻轻晃锅，用铲子把凝固的边缘推向中间，让没熟的蛋液流到锅边。
steps.en: Turn the heat to medium-low, melt half the remaining butter and pour in half the egg; tilt the pan and draw the set edges into the middle with a spatula so the runny egg flows to the edge.

steps.zh: 表面还有点湿润时，在中间铺上一半芝士和蘑菇，把蛋饼从一边卷起来（或对折），再煎 30 秒让芝士融化，滑到盘子里。
steps.en: While the top is still a little moist, scatter half the cheese and mushrooms down the middle, roll the omelette up from one side (or fold it in half) and cook 30 seconds more to melt the cheese; slide it onto a plate.

steps.zh: 用剩下的黄油、蛋液、芝士和蘑菇再做一个，撒上黑胡椒。
steps.en: Make a second omelette with the rest and grind over some black pepper.

summary.zh: 烤得酥脆的吐司抹上厚厚的牛油果泥，挤点柠檬汁，喜欢的话再放个水波蛋。
summary.en: Crisp toast piled with lemony smashed avocado, with a poached egg on top if you like.

note.zh: 厚切的酸面包或全麦面包

steps.zh: 要做水波蛋的话，先用小锅烧一锅水，保持微微冒小泡的小火。
steps.en: If you're poaching eggs, first bring a small pan of water to a gentle simmer.

steps.zh: 牛油果对半切开去核，挖出果肉放进碗里，挤入柠檬汁，加少许盐和黑胡椒，用叉子压成粗泥。
steps.en: Halve and stone the avocado, scoop it into a bowl and squeeze in the lemon; season with a little salt and pepper and mash roughly with a fork.

steps.zh: 面包放进烤面包机，或用干的平底锅中火烤到两面金黄酥脆。
steps.en: Toast the bread in a toaster, or in a dry frying pan over medium heat, until golden and crisp on both sides.

steps.zh: 水波蛋：鸡蛋先打进小碗，用筷子把水搅出漩涡，把蛋轻轻滑进漩涡中间，煮 3 分钟到蛋白凝固、蛋黄还软，用漏勺捞出；喜欢全熟就多煮 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: For each poached egg, crack the egg into a cup, stir the water into a gentle whirlpool and slip the egg into the middle; cook for 3 minutes, until the white has set but the yolk is still soft, then lift it out with a slotted spoon. Cook 1–2 minutes longer for a firm yolk.

steps.zh: 趁热把牛油果泥厚厚地抹在吐司上，放上水波蛋，撒少许辣椒粉和黑胡椒。
steps.en: Spread the avocado thickly on the hot toast, top with the eggs and finish with a pinch of chilli flakes and black pepper.

summary.zh: 鸡肉、土豆和胡萝卜炖得软糯，裹上浓稠微甜的咖喱，浇在热米饭上。
summary.en: Chicken, potato and carrot simmered soft in a thick, mildly sweet curry and spooned over hot rice.

note.zh: 约 100 克；选不辣的口味
note.en: about 100 g; choose a mild one

note.zh: 以咖喱块包装上的水量为准
note.en: or as much as the roux packet says

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切一口大小的块，洋葱切瓣；土豆和胡萝卜去皮切滚刀块，土豆泡在水里防止变色。
steps.en: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and the onion into wedges. Peel the potatoes and carrot and cut them into chunks; keep the potatoes in water so they don't brown.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火把洋葱炒 5 分钟左右，到变软、边缘微黄；下鸡肉炒到表面全部变白。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for about 5 minutes, until soft and golden at the edges; add the chicken and stir until it has turned white all over.

steps.zh: 加入沥干的土豆和胡萝卜炒 1 分钟，倒入 700 毫升水，大火烧开后撇去浮沫，盖盖转小火煮 15–20 分钟，到土豆和胡萝卜变软、鸡肉熟透。
steps.en: Add the drained potatoes and the carrot and stir for a minute. Pour in 700 ml water, bring to the boil and skim, then cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the chicken is cooked through.

steps.zh: 关火，放入掰开的咖喱块，搅到完全化开；再开小火煮 5–10 分钟，不时搅拌防止粘锅，到汤汁浓稠。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, break in the roux and stir until it has melted completely. Simmer over low heat for 5–10 minutes, stirring often so it doesn't catch, until thick.

steps.zh: 米饭盛进盘里，浇上咖喱即可。
steps.en: Serve the curry over plates of hot rice.

summary.zh: 鸡皮煎得金黄酥脆，再裹上咸甜发亮的照烧汁，切块配米饭正好。
summary.en: Chicken thighs seared until the skin is crisp, then glazed in a glossy, sweet-savoury teriyaki sauce.

note.zh: 带皮去骨鸡腿约 2 块

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉用厨房纸擦干，在肉的那面用刀尖划几刀切断筋，太厚的地方片开一些，让整块厚薄均匀。生抽、味醂和糖调成酱汁。
steps.en: Pat the chicken dry. Make a few shallow cuts across the sinews on the flesh side and open out any thick parts so each thigh is an even thickness. Stir the soy sauce, mirin and sugar together.

steps.zh: 平底锅放油，鸡皮朝下放入，中火煎 6–8 分钟，不时用铲子压平，到鸡皮金黄酥脆。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and lay the chicken in skin side down. Cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, pressing it flat now and then, until the skin is deep golden and crisp.

steps.zh: 翻面，倒入料酒，盖盖转小火焖 4–5 分钟，到鸡肉熟透：最厚处切开不见粉红，流出的肉汁是清的。
steps.en: Turn the chicken, add the Shaoxing wine, cover and cook over low heat for 4–5 minutes, until cooked through — no pink at the thickest part and the juices run clear.

steps.zh: 用厨房纸吸掉锅里多余的油，倒入酱汁，转中火煮到冒大泡，不停把酱汁舀起淋在鸡肉上，1–2 分钟收到浓稠发亮。
steps.en: Blot up the excess fat with kitchen paper, pour in the sauce and let it bubble over medium heat, spooning it over the chicken for 1–2 minutes until thick and glossy.

steps.zh: 切条装盘，淋上锅里剩下的酱汁，喜欢的话撒点葱花。
steps.en: Slice, spoon over the rest of the glaze and scatter with spring onion if you like.

summary.zh: 鸡肉和洋葱在甜咸的高汤里煮软，用嫩滑的蛋液包住，整片盖在热米饭上。
summary.en: Chicken and onion simmered in a sweet-savoury broth, set in silky egg and slid over hot rice.

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切一口大小的块，洋葱切丝，葱斜切成段。鸡蛋打散，用筷子划几下就好，留一点蛋白不打匀，口感更嫩。
steps.en: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, slice the onion thinly and cut the spring onion on the diagonal. Beat the eggs with just a few strokes of the chopsticks, leaving streaks of white for a softer set.

steps.zh: 小平底锅里放高汤、生抽、味醂和糖，中火煮开，放洋葱煮 2–3 分钟到变软。
steps.en: Bring the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar to the boil in a small frying pan over medium heat; add the onion and simmer for 2–3 minutes until soft.

steps.zh: 放入鸡肉铺开，盖盖转中小火煮 5–6 分钟，中途翻一次，到鸡肉熟透、切开中间不见粉红。
steps.en: Add the chicken in one layer, cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 5–6 minutes, turning once, until cooked through with no pink in the middle.

steps.zh: 转小火，先把三分之二的蛋液绕圈淋在鸡肉上，盖盖煮约 1 分钟到半凝固，再淋入剩下的蛋液，撒上葱段，盖盖焖 30 秒后关火；喜欢蛋全熟就多焖 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Turn the heat to low and pour two-thirds of the egg over the chicken in a circle. Cover and cook for about a minute until half set, then add the rest of the egg and the spring onion, cover for 30 seconds and turn off the heat. Leave it a minute or two longer if you like the egg fully set.

steps.zh: 米饭盛进两个碗里，用锅铲把鸡肉和蛋分成两份，连汤汁一起滑到米饭上。
steps.en: Fill two bowls with hot rice, divide the chicken and egg in two with a spatula and slide each half onto the rice with its sauce.

summary.zh: 嫩豆腐和裙带菜浸在鲜香的味噌汤里，十分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Silken tofu and wakame in a savoury miso broth, on the table in ten minutes.

steps.zh: 嫩豆腐切 1.5 厘米的小方块，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Cut the tofu into 1.5 cm cubes and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 高汤倒进小锅，中火烧开后转小火，放入豆腐和干裙带菜，煮 1–2 分钟，到豆腐热透、裙带菜泡开。
steps.en: Bring the dashi to the boil in a small pot, lower the heat, add the tofu and the dried wakame and simmer for 1–2 minutes, until the tofu is hot and the wakame has opened out.

steps.zh: 关火，把味噌放在汤勺里浸到汤中，用筷子慢慢搅散化开；尝一下，不够咸再加一点。
steps.en: Turn off the heat. Hold the miso in a ladle just under the surface and stir it with chopsticks until it dissolves; taste and add a little more if needed.

steps.zh: 再开小火加热到快要沸腾就关火，别煮滚，一滚味噌的香味就散了。撒上葱花即可。
steps.en: Warm the soup over low heat until it is just about to boil — boiling dulls the miso — and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 热米饭上铺满五颜六色的蔬菜、牛肉末和煎蛋，拌上甜辣的韩式辣酱一起吃。
summary.en: Hot rice topped with colourful vegetables, savoury beef and a fried egg, all mixed with a sweet-spicy gochujang sauce.

note.en: or beef cut into thin strips

steps.zh: 调拌饭酱：韩式辣酱加 2 茶匙香油、1 茶匙糖和 1 汤匙水搅匀。牛肉末加生抽、剩下的糖和 1 瓣蒜末拌匀。胡萝卜和西葫芦切细丝，香菇切片。
steps.en: For the sauce, stir the gochujang with 2 tsp of the sesame oil, 1 tsp of the sugar and 1 tbsp water. Mix the beef with the soy sauce, the rest of the sugar and one clove of garlic, minced. Cut the carrot and courgette into matchsticks and slice the mushrooms.

steps.zh: 烧一锅开水，菠菜焯 30 秒，捞出过凉、挤干切段，加一小撮盐、另一瓣蒜末和半茶匙香油拌匀。豆芽放进同一锅水里煮 1–2 分钟，捞出沥干，加一小撮盐和剩下的香油拌匀。
steps.en: Bring a pot of water to the boil. Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, cool it under cold water, squeeze it dry and cut it into lengths; toss with a pinch of salt, the other clove of garlic, minced, and ½ tsp sesame oil. Cook the bean sprouts in the same water for 1–2 minutes, drain and toss with a pinch of salt and the last of the sesame oil.

steps.zh: 平底锅中火，放 1 茶匙油，把胡萝卜丝炒 1–2 分钟到刚变软，加一小撮盐盛出；再放 1 茶匙油，用同样的方法炒西葫芦。
steps.en: Heat 1 tsp oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the carrot for 1–2 minutes until just soft, with a pinch of salt; set it aside and do the same with the courgette in another teaspoon of oil.

steps.zh: 同一个锅转大火，下牛肉末和香菇炒 3–4 分钟，把肉末炒散，炒到完全变色、看不到粉红色。
steps.en: Turn the heat up and fry the beef and mushrooms in the same pan for 3–4 minutes, breaking up the mince, until no pink remains.

steps.zh: 放剩下的油，中火煎两个荷包蛋，蛋黄的生熟按自己喜欢。
steps.en: Add the last of the oil and fry the eggs over medium heat, with the yolks as soft or firm as you like.

steps.zh: 热米饭盛进碗里，各样蔬菜和牛肉一堆堆码在饭上，中间放煎蛋，撒芝麻。拌饭酱按口味加，吃前全部拌匀。
steps.en: Divide the hot rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef on top in separate piles and put an egg in the middle; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Add as much sauce as you like and mix everything together before eating.

summary.zh: 酸辣的泡菜和米饭大火翻炒，盖上一个煎蛋，二十分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Tangy, spicy kimchi stir-fried with rice and topped with a fried egg — on the table in twenty minutes.

note.zh: 煮好的米饭，最好是隔夜饭

steps.zh: 泡菜切碎，留出 2 汤匙泡菜汁；葱切葱花，葱白和葱绿分开放；洋葱切小丁，五花肉切小薄片；米饭用手抓散。
steps.en: Chop the kimchi and keep 2 tbsp of its juice. Slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts apart; dice the onion and cut the pork belly into small thin pieces. Break up the rice with your hands.

steps.zh: 炒锅中火放 1.5 汤匙油，下葱白炒香；用五花肉的话一起下，炒 3 分钟到出油、完全熟透。再下洋葱丁炒软。
steps.en: Heat 1½ tbsp oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the white parts of the spring onion; if you're using pork belly, add it too and fry for 3 minutes until it is cooked through and has rendered some fat. Add the onion and fry until soft.

steps.zh: 加泡菜和辣椒粉，用韩式辣酱和糖的话也这时加，炒 2–3 分钟到泡菜变软、微微焦香。
steps.en: Add the kimchi and chilli flakes, plus the gochujang and sugar if using, and fry for 2–3 minutes until the kimchi is soft and just starting to catch.

steps.zh: 倒入米饭和泡菜汁，转大火翻炒 3–4 分钟，把饭炒散、炒热，每粒都裹上红色；尝一下，需要再加盐。
steps.en: Add the rice and the kimchi juice and stir-fry over high heat for 3–4 minutes, until the rice is hot, separate and evenly red; taste and add salt if it needs it.

steps.zh: 同时在平底锅里放剩下的油，煎两个荷包蛋。
steps.en: Meanwhile, fry the eggs in the rest of the oil in a frying pan.

steps.zh: 炒饭关火，淋上香油，盛进碗里，盖上煎蛋，撒葱绿和芝麻。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, drizzle the rice with the sesame oil and spoon it into bowls; top each with an egg and scatter with the green spring onion and sesame seeds.

summary.zh: 午餐肉、香肠、泡菜和方便面煮在一锅红汤里，盖上芝士片，热热闹闹一大锅。
summary.en: Luncheon meat, sausages, kimchi and instant noodles in a chilli-red broth, topped with melting cheese — a lively pot to share.

note.zh: 最好是韩国拉面；只用面饼
note.en: Korean ramyeon is best; noodles only

steps.zh: 调酱：辣椒粉、韩式辣酱、生抽、蒜末、糖和黑胡椒拌匀。午餐肉切 1 厘米厚片，香肠斜切片，泡菜切小块，豆腐切厚片，洋葱和香菇切片，葱切段。
steps.en: Mix the chilli flakes, gochujang, soy sauce, minced garlic, sugar and pepper into a paste. Slice the luncheon meat 1 cm thick and the sausages on the diagonal; cut the kimchi into bite-size pieces and the tofu into thick slices, slice the onion and mushrooms and cut the spring onions into lengths.

steps.zh: 取一口宽口浅锅，把午餐肉、香肠、泡菜、豆腐、洋葱和香菇一堆堆码好，酱放在中间。
steps.en: Arrange the luncheon meat, sausages, kimchi, tofu, onion and mushrooms in separate piles in a wide, shallow pot, with the paste in the middle.

steps.zh: 倒入高汤，大火烧开后转中火，把酱搅散，煮 8–10 分钟，让汤入味、香肠热透。
steps.en: Pour in the stock and bring to the boil over high heat, then stir the paste into the broth and simmer over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, until the broth is full of flavour and the sausages are heated through.

steps.zh: 放入方便面饼和葱段，煮 2–3 分钟，用筷子把面拨散，面一变软就好；调料包不用放。
steps.en: Add the noodle blocks and the spring onion and cook for 2–3 minutes, loosening the noodles with chopsticks, until just soft; the seasoning sachets aren't needed.

steps.zh: 转小火，芝士片铺在面上，盖上锅盖等 30 秒让芝士化开，整锅端上桌趁热吃。
steps.en: Turn the heat down, lay the cheese slices on the noodles and cover for 30 seconds to melt them; take the whole pot to the table and eat it hot.

summary.zh: 鸡肉嫩滑、鸡皮爽弹，米饭用鸡汤和鸡油煮得喷香，再配三种蘸料。
summary.en: Silky poached chicken and fragrant rice cooked in its stock and fat, with three dipping sauces.

note.zh: 约 1.5 千克；三黄鸡最好

note.en: long red; for the chilli sauce

steps.zh: 鸡洗净擦干，把鸡腔口的肥油切下来留着。用约 1 汤匙盐把鸡里外搓一遍，再冲干净。大锅里加 3–4 升水，放入切片的姜和 2 根葱，大火烧开。
steps.en: Rinse and dry the chicken, cutting off the fat around the cavity and keeping it. Rub the bird inside and out with about 1 tbsp salt, then rinse it off. Bring 3–4 litres of water to the boil in a large pot with the sliced ginger and 2 of the spring onions.

steps.zh: 把鸡放进开水里再提起来，重复三次，让鸡腔里外受热一致，然后整只浸入。水再次微开后转最小火，保持水面只冒小泡，煮 15 分钟。
steps.en: Lower the chicken into the boiling water and lift it out again three times so the cavity heats up too, then submerge it. When the water just simmers again, turn the heat to its lowest and poach for 15 minutes, with only the odd bubble breaking the surface.

steps.zh: 舀出 2.5 杯鸡汤留着煮饭，然后关火，盖上锅盖焖 25–30 分钟。用筷子扎鸡腿最厚的地方，流出的汁清澈、不带血水才算熟；还有粉红色就开小火再煮 5 分钟。捞出浸入冰水 10 分钟，鸡皮会更爽脆。
steps.en: Ladle out 2.5 cups of the stock for the rice, then turn off the heat, cover and leave for 25–30 minutes. Pierce the thickest part of a thigh with a chopstick — the juices must run clear; if they're still pink, poach over low heat for another 5 minutes. Lift the chicken into iced water for 10 minutes to firm the skin.

steps.zh: 大米淘净沥干。鸡油放进炒锅，加 1.5 汤匙油小火炼 3–4 分钟，捞出油渣；放 4 瓣蒜和红葱头（都切末）炒到微黄，倒入大米翻炒 2 分钟，让每粒米都裹上油。倒进电饭煲，加 2.5 杯鸡汤和 1 茶匙盐，照常煮饭。
steps.en: Rinse and drain the rice. Render the chicken fat with 1.5 tbsp oil in the wok over low heat for 3–4 minutes and lift out the crisp bits; fry 4 cloves of garlic and the shallots, finely chopped, until pale gold, then add the rice and stir for 2 minutes until every grain is coated. Tip it into the rice cooker with the 2.5 cups of stock and 1 tsp salt and cook as usual.

steps.zh: 做蘸料。姜葱酱：姜蓉加另外 2 根葱切的葱花和半茶匙盐，浇上烧到冒烟的 2 汤匙油拌匀。辣椒酱：辣椒、2 瓣蒜和少许姜蓉剁成细末（或用料理机打碎），加青柠汁、1 茶匙糖、少许盐和 2 汤匙鸡汤拌匀。酱油汁：生抽、老抽加 1 茶匙糖和 3 汤匙鸡汤调匀。
steps.en: Make the sauces. For the ginger sauce, mix the grated ginger with the other 2 spring onions, finely chopped, and ½ tsp salt, then pour over 2 tbsp smoking-hot oil. For the chilli sauce, chop the chillies, 2 cloves of garlic and a little of the grated ginger very finely (or blitz them) and stir in the lime juice, 1 tsp sugar, a pinch of salt and 2 tbsp of the stock. For the soy sauce, mix the soy sauce and dark soy with 1 tsp sugar and 3 tbsp of the stock.

steps.zh: 鸡沥干，斩块装盘，配黄瓜片和香菜。米饭翻松，和三种蘸料一起上桌；锅里剩下的鸡汤加盐调味，就是一碗清汤。
steps.en: Drain the chicken, chop it into pieces and plate it with sliced cucumber and coriander. Fluff the rice and serve with the three sauces; the rest of the stock, seasoned with salt, makes a light soup on the side.

summary.zh: 酸辣鲜香，香茅、南姜和青柠叶的香气扑鼻，大虾鲜甜弹牙。
summary.en: Hot, sour and fragrant with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves, with sweet, juicy prawns.

note.zh: 带壳，最好带头；约 10 只

steps.zh: 大虾剥壳、挑去虾线，尾巴可以留着；虾头和虾壳留着熬汤。香茅切掉老根和叶子，用刀背拍裂后切段；南姜切片；青柠叶撕掉中间的硬梗；辣椒拍裂；蘑菇切片，番茄切块。
steps.en: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails on if you like; keep the heads and shells for the stock. Trim the lemongrass, bruise it with the back of a knife and cut it into short lengths; slice the galangal; tear the lime leaves away from their central rib; bruise the chillies; slice the mushrooms and cut the tomato into wedges.

steps.zh: 虾头和虾壳放进 800 毫升水里煮开，转小火煮 5 分钟，用勺子压一压虾头，把鲜味压出来，然后捞出不要。
steps.en: Bring the heads and shells to the boil in 800 ml water and simmer for 5 minutes, pressing the heads with a spoon to release their flavour, then scoop them out.

steps.zh: 放入香茅、南姜和青柠叶，小火煮 3 分钟出香味；加冬阴功酱搅散，再放蘑菇、番茄和辣椒煮 2–3 分钟。
steps.en: Add the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves and simmer for 3 minutes until fragrant; stir in the tom yum paste, then add the mushrooms, tomato and chillies and simmer for 2–3 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入虾，煮 1–2 分钟，虾一变红、整只不透明就关火，煮久了会老。想要浓汤版，就在关火前倒入椰浆，热透即可，不要大滚。
steps.en: Add the prawns and cook for 1–2 minutes, just until pink and opaque all the way through, then turn off the heat before they toughen. For a creamy version, stir in the coconut milk just before turning off the heat and warm it through without boiling hard.

steps.zh: 关火后加鱼露，挤入青柠汁（和糖）调味，青柠汁不煮才清香。尝一尝，酸、辣、咸都要够味，撒上香菜即可。香茅、南姜和青柠叶只取香味，不用吃。
steps.en: Off the heat, season with the fish sauce and the lime juice (and sugar); lime juice tastes fresher when it isn't boiled. Taste and adjust until it's sharply sour, hot and salty, then scatter with coriander. The lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves are there for flavour, not for eating.

summary.zh: 椰香浓郁、微辣带甜，鸡肉嫩，茄子吸饱了咖喱汁，最适合浇在米饭上。
summary.en: A creamy coconut curry with a gentle green-chilli heat, tender chicken and silky eggplant — made for spooning over rice.

note.zh: 也可用鸡胸肉；切一口大小
长茄子；也可用泰国圆茄

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉切成一口大小；茄子切滚刀块；青柠叶撕掉硬梗；九层塔摘下叶子；辣椒斜切成片。
steps.en: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and the eggplant into chunks; tear the lime leaves away from their ribs, pick the basil leaves and slice the chilli on the diagonal.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火下绿咖喱酱炒 1 分钟出香味；倒入约三分之一的椰浆（罐子上层浓稠的部分最好），转中火边搅边煮 2–3 分钟，到椰浆变稠、表面浮出一层油。
steps.en: Fry the curry paste in the oil over low heat for a minute until fragrant, then add about a third of the coconut milk (the thick cream from the top of the can is best) and cook over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until it thickens and the oil begins to separate.

steps.zh: 下鸡肉翻炒到表面变白，倒入剩下的椰浆和 100 毫升水，加入青柠叶、茄子（和竹笋）。烧开后转小火煮 10–12 分钟，到茄子变软、鸡肉熟透，切开最大的一块，里面没有粉红色。
steps.en: Add the chicken and stir until it turns white, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk and 100 ml water and add the lime leaves and eggplant (and bamboo shoots). Bring to the boil and simmer for 10–12 minutes, until the eggplant is soft and the chicken is cooked through, with no pink in the middle of the largest piece.

steps.zh: 加鱼露和糖调味，尝一尝，咸、甜、辣要平衡；想更辣，就用少许汤汁化开一点咖喱酱再拌进去。
steps.en: Season with the fish sauce and sugar and taste — salty, sweet and hot should be in balance; for more heat, loosen a little more paste in some of the sauce and stir it in.

steps.zh: 关火拌入九层塔叶，撒上辣椒片，配米饭吃。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, stir in the basil and scatter with the chilli; serve with rice.

summary.zh: 薄薄的牛肉片和洋葱在甜咸高汤里煮到入味，连汤汁一起盖在米饭上。
summary.en: Thin slices of beef and soft onion simmered in a sweet soy broth and piled over rice with the juices.

note.zh: 肥牛片或切得很薄的牛肉
note.en: hot-pot beef slices or very thinly sliced beef

steps.zh: 洋葱顺纹切成 1 厘米宽的条；牛肉片太长的话切成 5–6 厘米的段；姜切细丝。
steps.en: Cut the onion along the grain into 1 cm strips, cut any long slices of beef into 5–6 cm lengths and shred the ginger.

steps.zh: 平底锅里放高汤、生抽、味醂、料酒和糖，中火煮开，放洋葱煮 4–5 分钟，到变软、半透明。
steps.en: Bring the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, Shaoxing wine and sugar to the boil in a frying pan over medium heat; add the onion and simmer for 4–5 minutes until soft and translucent.

steps.zh: 放入牛肉和姜丝，用筷子拨散，撇去浮沫，小火煮 3–5 分钟，到牛肉全部变色、入味。
steps.en: Add the beef and ginger, separating the slices with chopsticks, skim off the foam and simmer over low heat for 3–5 minutes, until the beef has changed colour all through and taken on the sauce.

steps.zh: 米饭盛进碗里，铺上牛肉和洋葱，浇一两勺汤汁，撒上葱花即可。
steps.en: Fill two bowls with hot rice, pile the beef and onion on top, spoon over some of the broth and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 牛肉片、土豆和洋葱在甜咸的高汤里慢慢炖，土豆粉糯、吸饱汤汁。
summary.en: Thin beef, potato and onion simmered in a sweet soy and dashi broth until the potatoes are soft and full of flavour.

note.en: hot-pot beef slices or thinly sliced

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切成大块，泡在水里；胡萝卜切滚刀块，洋葱切瓣，牛肉片切成 5 厘米的段。粉丝用温水泡软，剪短一些。
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into large chunks and keep them in water. Cut the carrot into chunks, the onion into wedges and the beef into 5 cm lengths. Soak the glass noodles in warm water until soft and snip them shorter.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火把牛肉炒到变色，加入洋葱、沥干的土豆和胡萝卜翻炒 1–2 分钟，让土豆表面裹上油。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and stir-fry the beef until it changes colour; add the onion, the drained potatoes and the carrot and toss for 1–2 minutes to coat them in the oil.

steps.zh: 倒入高汤、料酒、糖和味醂，大火烧开后撇去浮沫。剪一张中间有小孔的烘焙纸，直接盖在食材上（日式落盖），转中小火煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Add the dashi, Shaoxing wine, sugar and mirin, bring to the boil and skim. Lay a circle of baking paper with a small hole in the middle directly on the food (a Japanese drop lid) and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 加入生抽和粉丝，再煮 8–10 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透土豆、汤汁剩下约三分之一，尝一下咸淡。
steps.en: Add the soy sauce and the glass noodles and simmer for another 8–10 minutes, until a chopstick slides easily into the potatoes and about a third of the broth is left; taste for seasoning.

steps.zh: 荷兰豆放进开水里焯 1 分钟，摆在炖好的菜上，连汤汁一起盛出。
steps.en: Blanch the snow peas in boiling water for a minute, scatter them over the stew and serve with its broth.

summary.zh: 蛋液一层层卷成厚蛋卷，微甜带着高汤香，切开层次分明。
summary.en: Thin layers of egg rolled into a thick omelette, lightly sweet with a hint of dashi and neatly layered when sliced.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋打进碗里，加高汤、糖和一小撮盐，用筷子贴着碗底来回划着打散，别打出太多泡；想要更细腻可以过一次筛。
