steps.en: Beat the eggs with the dashi, sugar and a pinch of salt, moving the chopsticks back and forth along the bottom of the bowl so you don't whisk in much air; strain the mixture for an even smoother roll.

steps.zh: 玉子烧锅或小平底锅中小火烧热，用蘸了油的厨房纸擦一层薄油，滴一滴蛋液能马上发出滋滋声就行。倒入约四分之一的蛋液，转动锅子铺满锅底，戳破大气泡。
steps.en: Heat a tamagoyaki pan or small frying pan over medium-low heat and wipe it with oiled kitchen paper; a drop of egg should sizzle at once. Pour in about a quarter of the egg, tilt the pan to cover the base and prick any large bubbles.

steps.zh: 表面还有点湿、半凝固时，用筷子或铲子从锅的远端往近端卷起。把蛋卷推回远端，空出的地方再擦一层油。
steps.en: While the top is still a little wet, roll the omelette up from the far side towards you. Push the roll back to the far side and wipe the empty part of the pan with oil.

steps.zh: 再倒入一层蛋液，抬起蛋卷让蛋液流到下面，半凝固时连着蛋卷往回卷；重复到蛋液用完，最后把蛋卷四面各贴锅煎几秒定型。
steps.en: Pour in another layer, lifting the roll so some egg runs underneath, and roll it back up when half set. Repeat until the egg is used up, then press each side of the roll against the pan for a few seconds to firm it.

steps.zh: 出锅后用竹帘或厨房纸包住整形，放 2–3 分钟，切成 2 厘米厚的块。
steps.en: Wrap the roll in a bamboo mat or kitchen paper to shape it, leave for 2–3 minutes and cut into 2 cm slices.

summary.zh: 三文鱼抹上甜咸的味噌酱，烤到表面焦香、鱼肉嫩滑。
summary.en: Salmon spread with a sweet-savoury miso glaze and roasted until caramelised on top and tender inside.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C，烤盘铺上烘焙纸。三文鱼用厨房纸擦干。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Pat the salmon dry with kitchen paper.

steps.zh: 味噌、味醂和糖搅成顺滑的酱，均匀抹在三文鱼的表面和侧面，鱼皮那面不用抹。
steps.en: Stir the miso, mirin and sugar into a smooth paste and spread it over the top and sides of the fillets, leaving the skin bare.

steps.zh: 鱼皮朝下放在烤盘上，烤 12–15 分钟，到表面呈焦糖色、鱼肉中间刚好变色，用叉子一拨就散开。味噌容易焦，上色太快就松松地盖一张锡纸。
steps.en: Lay the fillets skin side down on the tray and roast for 12–15 minutes, until the glaze is caramelised and the fish is just opaque in the centre and flakes easily with a fork. Miso scorches easily, so cover loosely with foil if it darkens too fast.

steps.zh: 撒上葱花即可。
steps.en: Scatter with spring onion to serve.

summary.zh: 牛猪混合的肉饼先煎后焖，一按就冒汁，淋上用锅底肉汁调的番茄酱汁。
summary.en: Juicy beef and pork patties, browned and then steamed tender, with a quick tomato sauce made from the pan juices.

steps.zh: 洋葱切碎，用 1 茶匙油中小火炒 5 分钟到变软、微黄，盛出放凉。面包糠倒进牛奶里泡软。
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and soften it in 1 tsp of the oil over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, until lightly golden; leave it to cool. Soak the panko in the milk.

steps.zh: 牛肉末和猪肉末加盐和黑胡椒，用手抓拌到发黏，再加入鸡蛋、泡好的面包糠和放凉的洋葱拌匀。
steps.en: Mix the beef and pork mince with the salt and pepper by hand until sticky, then work in the egg, the soaked panko and the cooled onion.

steps.zh: 分成两份，手上抹点油，把肉团在两手之间来回摔打十几下排出空气，整成约 2 厘米厚的椭圆形肉饼，中间按一个浅坑，煎的时候就不会鼓起来。
steps.en: Divide the mixture in two. With oiled hands, toss each portion from hand to hand a dozen times to knock out the air, then shape it into an oval about 2 cm thick with a shallow dip in the centre so it doesn't puff up in the pan.

steps.zh: 平底锅放剩下的油，中火把肉饼煎 3 分钟到底面焦黄，翻面后加 3 汤匙水，盖盖转小火焖 8–10 分钟，到肉饼熟透：按压时流出的肉汁是清的，切开不见粉红（中心温度 71°C）。
steps.en: Heat the rest of the oil in a frying pan and brown the patties over medium heat for 3 minutes. Turn them, add 3 tbsp water, cover and cook over low heat for 8–10 minutes, until cooked through — the juices run clear when pressed and there is no pink inside (71°C in the centre).

steps.zh: 肉饼盛出。锅里的肉汁加番茄酱、伍斯特酱和黄油，小火煮 1 分钟到浓稠，淋在肉饼上。
steps.en: Lift out the patties. Add the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce and butter to the juices in the pan, simmer for a minute until thickened and spoon the sauce over the patties.

summary.zh: 厚切猪排裹上日式面包糠，炸到金黄酥脆，配卷心菜丝和柠檬。
summary.en: Thick pork cutlets in a crisp golden panko crust, served with shredded cabbage and lemon.

note.zh: 去骨里脊排，约 1.5 厘米厚

steps.zh: 猪排在肥肉和瘦肉相接的白筋上切几刀，防止炸的时候卷起；用刀背把两面轻轻拍松，再整回原来的形状，两面撒盐和黑胡椒。
steps.en: Cut through the sinew between the fat and the meat in a few places so the chops don't curl, tap both sides lightly with the back of a knife and press them back into shape; season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 准备三个盘子，分别放面粉、打散的鸡蛋和面包糠。猪排先拍一层薄薄的面粉，再裹满蛋液，最后放进面包糠里两面按紧。
steps.en: Set out three plates with the flour, the beaten egg and the panko. Dust each chop thinly with flour, coat it in egg, then press it firmly into the panko on both sides.

steps.zh: 锅里倒油约 3 厘米深，中火加热到 170°C：丢几粒面包糠进去，马上冒细泡、浮起来就可以了。锅边不要有水，炸的时候别离开灶台。
steps.en: Heat oil about 3 cm deep in a wok to 170°C — a few crumbs dropped in should sizzle and float at once. Keep water away from the pan and stay at the stove while frying.

steps.zh: 猪排从靠近自己的锅边轻轻滑入，每面炸约 3 分钟，到外皮金黄酥脆、肉熟透，最厚处切开不见粉红。一次别放太多，以免油温下降。
steps.en: Slide the chops in gently, away from you, and fry for about 3 minutes a side, until deep golden and cooked through with no pink at the thickest part. Don't crowd the pan, or the oil will cool.

steps.zh: 捞出竖着放在架子或厨房纸上沥油，静置 2 分钟后切条，配卷心菜丝和柠檬角。伍斯特酱和番茄酱调匀就是简易猪排酱。用过的油放凉后再处理。
steps.en: Stand the cutlets on a rack or kitchen paper to drain, rest for 2 minutes and slice. Serve with the cabbage and lemon wedges, and mix the Worcestershire sauce and ketchup for a quick tonkatsu sauce. Let the oil cool completely before you deal with it.

summary.zh: 牛肉薄片用酱油、洋葱泥和香油腌透，大火快煎，甜咸焦香。
summary.en: Thin slices of beef marinated in soy sauce, grated onion and sesame oil, then seared hot until sweet, savoury and caramelised.

note.zh: 切薄片；也可用火锅肥牛片
note.en: thinly sliced; hot-pot beef slices work well

steps.zh: 牛肉逆着纹路切成薄片，半冻的牛肉更好切；用火锅肥牛片就省了这一步。半个洋葱磨成泥，另一半切丝；葱切段，蒜切末。
steps.en: Slice the beef paper-thin across the grain (it's easier half-frozen), or use hot-pot slices. Grate half the onion and slice the other half; cut the spring onions into lengths and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 洋葱泥、生抽、糖、味醂、蒜末、香油和黑胡椒拌匀，放入牛肉抓匀，盖好放冰箱腌 30 分钟；时间充裕的话腌几个小时到过夜更入味。
steps.en: Mix the grated onion with the soy sauce, sugar, mirin, garlic, sesame oil and pepper, add the beef and massage it in; cover and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes, or for a few hours or overnight for more flavour.

steps.zh: 大平底锅大火烧热，放油，下洋葱丝和牛肉（连腌汁一起）摊开，先别急着翻，煎炒 4–6 分钟，到牛肉熟透、汤汁收干、边缘微焦。锅小就分两批。
steps.en: Heat a large frying pan over high heat, add the oil, then the sliced onion and the beef with its marinade, spread out. Let it sear before you stir, and cook for 4–6 minutes until the beef is cooked through, the juices have cooked away and the edges are caramelised. Cook it in two batches if your pan is small.

steps.zh: 加葱段翻炒几下，出锅撒芝麻。配米饭吃，也可以用生菜叶包着吃。
steps.en: Toss in the spring onion and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with rice, and with lettuce leaves for wrapping if you like.

summary.zh: 弹滑的红薯粉条拌上牛肉丝和五颜六色的蔬菜，用香油和酱油调味，咸中带甜。
summary.en: Springy sweet potato noodles tossed with beef and colourful vegetables in a sweet sesame and soy dressing.

note.zh: 鲜香菇或泡发的干香菇

steps.zh: 烧一锅开水，先把菠菜焯 30 秒，捞出过凉、挤干切段。再放粉条煮 6–7 分钟（以包装说明为准），煮到软而有弹性，捞出用凉水冲一下沥干，用剪刀剪几刀，拌上 1 茶匙香油防粘。
steps.en: Bring a pot of water to the boil. Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, cool it under cold water, squeeze it dry and cut it into lengths. Then boil the noodles for 6–7 minutes (or as the packet says) until soft but springy; rinse under cold water, drain, snip them a few times with scissors and toss with 1 tsp of the sesame oil so they don't stick.

steps.zh: 牛肉丝加 1 茶匙生抽、半茶匙糖和一半蒜末抓匀。洋葱切丝，胡萝卜和彩椒切细丝，香菇切片，葱切段。剩下的生抽、糖、香油和蒜末调成汁。
steps.en: Mix the beef with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, ½ tsp of the sugar and half the garlic. Slice the onion, cut the carrot and capsicum into matchsticks, slice the mushrooms and cut the spring onions into lengths. Stir the rest of the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and garlic together for the sauce.

steps.zh: 炒锅中大火放一半油，下洋葱、胡萝卜和彩椒炒 2 分钟到刚断生，加一小撮盐，盛出。再放剩下的油，下牛肉和香菇炒 2–3 分钟，炒到牛肉熟透。
steps.en: Heat half the oil in the wok over medium-high heat and stir-fry the onion, carrot and capsicum for 2 minutes until just tender, with a pinch of salt; set aside. Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the beef and mushrooms for 2–3 minutes, until the beef is cooked through.

steps.zh: 转小火，倒回炒好的蔬菜，加入粉条、菠菜、葱段和调好的汁，翻拌 1–2 分钟，到粉条吸饱汁、油亮；尝一下，需要再加盐。
steps.en: Turn the heat down, return the vegetables and add the noodles, spinach, spring onion and sauce; toss for 1–2 minutes until the noodles are glossy and have soaked up the sauce. Taste and add salt if it needs it.

steps.zh: 关火，撒芝麻和黑胡椒。热着吃或放到室温吃都好。
steps.en: Turn off the heat and finish with the sesame seeds and black pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature.

summary.zh: 老泡菜和五花肉先炒香，再炖成酸辣浓郁的一锅汤，加上豆腐，配白米饭正好。
summary.en: Sour kimchi and pork belly fried, then simmered into a rich, spicy broth with tofu — made for a bowl of rice.

steps.zh: 五花肉切薄片；泡菜切小块，留出 3 汤匙泡菜汁；豆腐切 1 厘米厚片，洋葱切丝，葱斜切段，蒜切末。
steps.en: Slice the pork belly thinly and cut the kimchi into bite-size pieces, keeping 3 tbsp of its juice. Cut the tofu into 1 cm slices, slice the onion, cut the spring onion on the diagonal and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火煸炒五花肉 3–4 分钟，到出油、变色；加泡菜、蒜末和辣椒粉（用韩式辣酱的话也这时加），炒 2–3 分钟到泡菜变软、炒出香味。
steps.en: Fry the pork belly in the oil over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until it browns and gives up its fat. Add the kimchi, garlic and chilli flakes (and the gochujang, if using) and fry for 2–3 minutes until the kimchi softens and smells fragrant.

steps.zh: 倒入 500 毫升水和泡菜汁，放洋葱丝，大火烧开后转中小火，盖上盖子煮 10 分钟，让汤煮出泡菜的酸辣味，猪肉也完全熟透。
steps.en: Pour in 500 ml water and the kimchi juice and add the onion. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, until the broth tastes of the kimchi and the pork is cooked through.

steps.zh: 放入豆腐再煮 3 分钟。尝一下：太酸就加半茶匙糖，不够咸再加盐。
steps.en: Add the tofu and simmer for 3 minutes more. Taste, adding ½ tsp sugar if it's very sour and salt if it needs it.

steps.zh: 撒上葱段，连锅端上桌，配米饭吃。
steps.en: Scatter over the spring onion and serve in the pot, with rice.

summary.zh: 大酱煮出醇厚咸香的汤底，豆腐、西葫芦和土豆煮得软软的，地道的韩国家常味。
summary.en: An earthy, savoury soybean paste broth with tofu, courgette and potato simmered until tender — everyday Korean home cooking.

note.en: Korean doenjang if you can get it

steps.zh: 豆腐切 2 厘米方块，西葫芦切半月形厚片，土豆和洋葱切小块，香菇切片，辣椒切圈，葱切葱花，蒜切末。
steps.en: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, the courgette into thick half-moons and the potato and onion into small chunks; slice the mushrooms, chilli and spring onion and mince the garlic.

steps.zh: 高汤倒进锅里烧开，先放 1.5 汤匙大酱，用勺子压开搅匀；尝一下，不够咸再加，不同的酱咸度差别很大。
steps.en: Bring the dashi to the boil and stir in 1½ tbsp of the soybean paste, pressing it against the side of the pot with a spoon to dissolve it; taste and add more only if it needs it, as pastes vary a lot in saltiness.

steps.zh: 放入土豆、洋葱和蒜末，中火煮 5 分钟；再放西葫芦和香菇，煮 3–4 分钟。
steps.en: Add the potato, onion and garlic and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the courgette and mushrooms and simmer for 3–4 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入豆腐和辣椒，再煮 2–3 分钟，到豆腐热透、土豆变软。
steps.en: Add the tofu and chilli and simmer for 2–3 minutes more, until the tofu is hot and the potato is tender.

steps.zh: 撒上葱花，连锅端上桌，配米饭吃。
steps.en: Scatter over the spring onion and serve in the pot, with rice.

summary.zh: 满满的葱段裹上薄薄的面糊，煎到边缘金黄酥脆，蘸着酱油醋吃。
summary.en: A thin batter packed with spring onions and pan-fried until golden and crisp at the edges, with a soy and vinegar dip.

steps.zh: 面粉、淀粉和一小撮盐混合，加入打散的鸡蛋和约 160 毫升冰水，轻轻搅成能流动的稀面糊，有小疙瘩没关系，别搅太久；太稠就再加一点水。用虾仁和辣椒的话也拌进去。
steps.en: Mix the flour, cornflour and a pinch of salt, add the beaten egg and about 160 ml ice-cold water and stir gently into a thin, pourable batter — a few lumps are fine, so don't overmix; add a little more water if it's thick. Stir in the prawns and chilli, if using.

steps.zh: 葱洗净擦干，切成和平底锅差不多长的段，粗的从中间剖开。
steps.en: Wash and dry the spring onions and cut them to the width of your frying pan, halving any thick ones lengthways.

steps.zh: 平底锅中火烧热，放 2 茶匙油，把一半的葱整齐铺在锅里，均匀淋上一半面糊，刚好把葱连在一起就行。
steps.en: Heat 2 tsp oil in the frying pan over medium heat, lay half the spring onions side by side and pour half the batter evenly over them, just enough to bind them.

steps.zh: 煎 3–4 分钟到底面金黄酥脆，翻面，沿锅边再淋 1 茶匙油，用铲子压一压，再煎 3 分钟，虾仁要熟透变红。用同样的方法做第二张。
steps.en: Fry for 3–4 minutes until the underside is golden and crisp, then turn it, drizzle 1 tsp oil around the edge, press it down with the spatula and fry for 3 minutes more, until any prawns are pink and cooked through. Make the second pancake the same way.

steps.zh: 生抽和白醋等量调成蘸汁，可以加一小撮辣椒粉。葱饼切块，趁热蘸着吃。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for a dipping sauce, with a pinch of chilli flakes if you like. Cut the pancakes into pieces and eat them hot with the sauce.

summary.zh: 猪肉末和九层塔、辣椒大火爆炒，咸香带辣，盖在米饭上，再加一个焦边煎蛋。
summary.en: Pork flash-fried with basil, garlic and chilli, spooned over rice and topped with a crisp-edged fried egg.

note.zh: 有打抛叶（圣罗勒）更正宗
note.en: holy basil if you can find it
bird's eye; fewer for less heat
or snake beans; in short lengths

steps.zh: 蒜和辣椒一起捣碎或剁碎；九层塔摘下叶子；四季豆切小段。调碗汁：蚝油、生抽、老抽、鱼露、糖和 2 汤匙水搅匀。
steps.en: Pound or finely chop the garlic and chillies together; pick the basil leaves and cut the beans into short lengths. Stir the oyster sauce, soy sauce, dark soy, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，中大火把鸡蛋逐个煎到蛋白边缘金黄焦脆，蛋黄生熟随意，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over medium-high heat and fry the eggs one at a time until the whites are golden and crisp at the edges, with the yolks as you like them; set aside.

steps.zh: 补 1 汤匙油，大火下蒜和辣椒炒 20–30 秒出香味（很呛，记得开抽油烟机），下肉末炒散，炒 3–4 分钟到完全变色、微微焦香；放四季豆再炒 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the garlic and chillies over high heat for 20–30 seconds until fragrant — the fumes are sharp, so turn on the fan — then add the pork, break it up and fry for 3–4 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned; add the beans for another 1–2 minutes.

steps.zh: 倒入碗汁，大火炒到汤汁收干，关火放入九层塔叶，翻炒几下到叶子刚变软。
steps.en: Pour in the sauce and toss over high heat until it's absorbed; turn off the heat, add the basil and toss until just wilted.

steps.zh: 盛在热米饭上，每盘放一个煎蛋。
steps.en: Spoon over hot rice and top each plate with a fried egg.

summary.zh: 八角桂皮慢炖出清澈香浓的牛肉汤，浇在河粉和薄牛肉片上，再配一大把新鲜香草。
summary.en: A clear, fragrant beef broth slow-simmered with star anise and cinnamon, poured over rice noodles and thin slices of beef, with a pile of fresh herbs.

note.zh: 新鲜河粉；干河粉约 300 克

note.en: 1 for the broth and ½ thinly sliced

steps.zh: 牛腩冷水下锅，大火煮开后再滚 5 分钟，捞出用温水冲净浮沫，锅也刷干净。同时把 1 个洋葱带皮对半切开，和姜一起放进干锅，中火烙 8–10 分钟，到表面焦黑、闻到焦香，再剥掉烧焦的外皮；最后 1–2 分钟把八角和桂皮也放进锅里焙香。
steps.en: Put the brisket in a pot of cold water, bring to the boil and boil for 5 minutes, then rinse it under warm water and scrub the pot. Meanwhile, halve one onion with the skin on and char it with the ginger in a dry pan over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, until blackened in patches and smelling toasty, then peel off the burnt skin; toast the star anise and cinnamon in the pan for the last 1–2 minutes.

steps.zh: 牛腩、洋葱、姜和香料放回汤锅，加 3 升水、冰糖和 1 汤匙鱼露，大火烧开后撇净浮沫，转最小火，半盖锅盖炖 2 小时，中途撇几次浮沫和浮油。保持微微冒泡，汤才清澈。
steps.en: Return the brisket to the pot with the onion, ginger and spices, 3 litres of water, the rock sugar and 1 tbsp of the fish sauce. Bring to the boil, skim well, then turn the heat right down and simmer with the lid ajar for 2 hours, skimming off scum and fat now and then; keeping it to a gentle bubble keeps the broth clear.

steps.zh: 牛腩炖到筷子能轻松插透就捞出，泡在冷水里防止变干，凉后切薄片。汤滤掉香料和洋葱姜，加剩下的鱼露，再用盐调味。
steps.en: When a chopstick slides easily into the brisket, lift it into cold water so it doesn't dry out, then slice it thinly once cool. Strain the broth and season it with the rest of the fish sauce and salt to taste.

steps.zh: 生牛肉冷冻 15 分钟变硬，逆纹切成极薄的片；剩下的半个洋葱切细丝。河粉按包装说明烫软（新鲜河粉在开水里烫 10–20 秒即可），沥干分到 4 个大碗里。
steps.en: Freeze the raw beef for 15 minutes to firm it, then slice it paper-thin across the grain; slice the remaining half onion very thinly. Soften the noodles as the packet says — fresh ones need only 10–20 seconds in boiling water — then drain and divide among four big bowls.

steps.zh: 碗里铺上牛腩片、生牛肉片和洋葱丝。汤重新烧到大滚，马上浇进碗里，把生牛肉烫熟；喜欢全熟的，先把牛肉片放进滚汤里涮 10–20 秒。
steps.en: Top with the brisket, raw beef and sliced onion. Bring the broth back to a rolling boil and ladle it straight into the bowls so it cooks the beef; if you like it well done, dip the slices in the boiling broth for 10–20 seconds first.

steps.zh: 豆芽、九层塔、香菜、葱花、青柠角和辣椒片装一盘，大家按口味自己加。
steps.en: Put the bean sprouts, Thai basil, coriander, chopped spring onion, lime wedges and sliced chilli on a plate for everyone to add as they like.

summary.zh: 红葱头、蒜和辣椒炒得喷香，米饭裹上酱色，甜咸微辣，顶上一个荷包蛋。
summary.en: Indonesian fried rice, fragrant with shallot, garlic and chilli, glossy, sweet-savoury and gently hot, under a fried egg.

note.zh: 煮好的米饭，最好是隔夜饭
或用 2 汤匙印尼甜酱油，不加糖
note.en: or 2 tbsp kecap manis and no sugar

steps.zh: 隔夜饭抓散；红葱头、蒜和辣椒一起剁成细末，或用料理机打成酱；鸡肉切小丁。
steps.en: Break up the cold rice; chop the shallots, garlic and chillies together very finely, or blitz them to a paste; dice the chicken small.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，中火煎两个荷包蛋，煎到蛋白边缘金黄焦脆，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the eggs until the whites are golden and crisp at the edges; set aside.

steps.zh: 补 1 汤匙油，小火下红葱头辣椒酱炒 1–2 分钟，到出香味、颜色变深，别炒糊；有鸡肉的话放入鸡丁，转大火炒到变白熟透。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the shallot paste over low heat for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and a shade darker, without letting it burn; if you're using chicken, add it and stir-fry over high heat until white and cooked through.

steps.zh: 倒入米饭，大火翻炒 3 分钟到饭粒松散、热透；沿锅边淋入老抽，加糖和少许盐，翻炒到每粒米都均匀上色。
steps.en: Add the rice and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes until hot and separate; drizzle the dark soy around the edge of the wok, add the sugar and a little salt and toss until every grain is evenly coloured.

steps.zh: 装盘，放上荷包蛋，旁边配黄瓜片和番茄片。
steps.en: Serve topped with the fried eggs, with slices of cucumber and tomato on the side.

summary.zh: 鸡腿肉用香茅、蒜和鱼露腌透，烤到边缘焦香，越南家常的味道。
summary.en: Chicken thighs marinated in lemongrass, garlic and fish sauce and roasted until caramelised at the edges.

steps.zh: 香茅剥掉粗老的外皮，切掉上半段，把下半段嫩的部分切成极细的末；蒜和红葱头也切末，或和香茅一起用料理机打碎。
steps.en: Peel off the tough outer layers of the lemongrass, cut off the top half and mince the tender lower part very finely; mince the garlic and shallots too, or blitz them all together.

steps.zh: 香茅末、蒜末和红葱头末加鱼露、糖、油和黑胡椒拌匀，抹满鸡腿肉，腌至少 30 分钟；盖好放冰箱腌一夜更入味。
steps.en: Mix the lemongrass, garlic and shallots with the fish sauce, sugar, oil and plenty of black pepper, rub it all over the chicken and leave for at least 30 minutes, or covered in the fridge overnight for more flavour.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 220°C。鸡腿肉皮朝上铺在垫了锡纸的烤盘上，烤 18–22 分钟，到表面焦黄，切开最厚的地方流出的汁清澈、没有粉红色。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 220°C. Lay the chicken skin side up on a lined tray and roast for 18–22 minutes, until browned and the juices run clear when you cut into the thickest part.

steps.zh: 喜欢更焦香的，最后开上火烤 2–3 分钟；糖分很容易烤糊，要守在旁边看着。
steps.en: For more char, finish under a hot grill for 2–3 minutes; the sugar catches quickly, so keep an eye on it.

steps.zh: 静置 3 分钟后切条，挤上青柠汁，撒上香菜，配米饭吃。
steps.en: Rest for 3 minutes, then slice, squeeze over the lime and scatter with coriander; serve with rice.

summary.zh: 酸甜的菠萝配虾仁和鸡蛋，米饭粒粒分明，一盘就有热带风味。
summary.en: Thai-style fried rice with sweet-tart pineapple, prawns and egg, every grain separate and bright with tropical flavour.

note.zh: 煮好的米饭，最好是隔夜饭
去皮切丁；罐头的要沥干
note.en: peeled and diced; drained if canned

steps.zh: 隔夜饭抓散；菠萝切 1 厘米小丁，用厨房纸吸干；虾仁挑去虾线，擦干；鸡蛋打散；蒜切末，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Break up the cold rice; cut the pineapple into 1 cm dice and pat it dry; devein the prawns and pat them dry; beat the eggs; mince the garlic and chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，倒入蛋液炒成小块，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok, scramble the eggs into small curds and take them out.

steps.zh: 补 1 汤匙油，大火下蒜末炒香，放虾仁炒 1–2 分钟，到虾刚变红、整只不透明，盛出和鸡蛋放在一起。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the garlic over high heat until fragrant; add the prawns and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes, until just pink and opaque, then take them out with the egg.

steps.zh: 倒入米饭（和豌豆），大火翻炒 3–4 分钟到饭粒松散、热透，再加菠萝丁炒 1 分钟。
steps.en: Add the rice (and peas) and stir-fry over high heat for 3–4 minutes, until hot and every grain is separate; add the pineapple and toss for a minute.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋和虾仁，加鱼露、盐和白胡椒炒匀，撒上葱花和香菜出锅。
steps.en: Return the egg and prawns, season with the fish sauce, salt and white pepper and toss; finish with the spring onion and coriander.

summary.zh: 蒜苔脆嫩，带着淡淡的蒜香，和松软的炒蛋一起特别下饭。
summary.en: Crisp-tender garlic scapes with a gentle garlicky bite, tossed with soft scrambled egg.

steps.zh: 蒜苔洗净，掐掉顶端的花苞和底部较老的一截，切成 3 厘米长的段；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Wash the garlic scapes, pinch off the flower buds and the tough ends, and cut them into 3 cm lengths; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅烧热，放 1 汤匙油，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就炒成大块，盛出备用。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok and pour in the eggs; as soon as they begin to set, break them into large curds and take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，中大火下蒜苔翻炒 1 分钟，沿锅边淋入 2 汤匙水，继续翻炒 2–3 分钟，炒到颜色翠绿、蒜苔变软，加盐。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the scapes over medium-high heat for a minute; splash 2 tbsp water down the side of the wok and keep tossing for 2–3 minutes, until bright green and tender. Season with salt.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋，大火翻炒均匀即可出锅。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss everything together over high heat and serve.

summary.zh: 蒜苔煸得翠绿脆嫩，肉丝滑嫩咸香，一盘很下饭的家常小炒。
summary.en: Bright green garlic scapes and silky pork strips with a simple soy seasoning — a homely stir-fry made for rice.

steps.zh: 肉丝加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒和淀粉抓匀，腌 5 分钟；蒜苔掐掉花苞和底部较老的一截，切 4 厘米段。
steps.en: Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and the cornflour and leave for 5 minutes. Pinch the flower buds and tough ends off the scapes and cut them into 4 cm lengths.

steps.zh: 锅里放 ½ 汤匙油，中大火下蒜苔煸炒 3 分钟左右，炒到颜色翠绿、表皮微微起皱，撒一小撮盐，盛出。
steps.en: Stir-fry the scapes in ½ tbsp oil over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes, until bright green and lightly wrinkled; add a pinch of salt and take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，大火下肉丝炒散，一直炒到完全变色、熟透。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the pork over high heat, separating the strips, until it has changed colour all over and is cooked through.

steps.zh: 倒回蒜苔，加剩下的生抽大火翻炒 1 分钟；想颜色深一点可以加几滴老抽，尝过咸淡再出锅。
steps.en: Return the scapes with the rest of the soy sauce and toss over high heat for a minute; a few drops of dark soy sauce deepen the colour. Taste for salt and serve.

summary.zh: 洋葱炒出清甜，鸡蛋松软嫩滑，十分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Onion stir-fried until sweet with soft, fluffy egg — a ten-minute everyday classic.

steps.zh: 洋葱去皮，对半切开，再切成细丝；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Peel the onion, halve it and slice it thinly; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油烧热，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就推成大块，趁还有点嫩时盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil, pour in the eggs and push them into large soft curds as they set; take them out while still a little runny.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，中大火下洋葱丝翻炒 2–3 分钟，炒到变软、微微透明，加盐；喜欢脆口就少炒一会儿。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the onion over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes, until soft and turning translucent, then season with salt; cook it a little less if you like some crunch.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻炒均匀，出锅。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss together and serve.

name.en: Guo bao rou (crispy sweet & sour pork)

summary.zh: 哈尔滨名菜：里脊片挂上土豆淀粉糊炸两遍，外壳酥脆，裹着酸甜的糖醋汁。
summary.en: The Harbin classic — thin pork slices in a potato-starch batter, fried twice until crackly and tossed in a bright sweet-and-sour sauce.

note.zh: 里脊，切约 5 毫米厚的大片
note.en: loin; in large slices 5 mm thick

steps.zh: 里脊逆着纹路切成约 5 毫米厚的大片，加一小撮盐和料酒抓匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Slice the pork across the grain into large pieces about 5 mm thick, mix with a pinch of salt and the Shaoxing wine and leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 腌肉的时候，淀粉加 80 毫升水搅成很稠的糊，用筷子挑起能缓慢流下，再拌入 1 茶匙油。胡萝卜、葱和姜切细丝，香菜切段；白糖、白醋、一小撮盐和生抽（可不放）调成糖醋汁。
steps.en: While it marinates, stir the starch with 80 ml water into a very thick batter that falls slowly from chopsticks, then mix in 1 tsp oil. Finely shred the carrot, spring onion and ginger and cut the coriander into short lengths; mix the sugar, vinegar, a pinch of salt and the soy sauce, if using, for the sauce.

steps.zh: 锅里倒油约 3 厘米深，中火烧到约 160°C：插一根干的木筷子进去，周围冒出细密的小泡。面糊沉底了先搅一搅，肉片裹满糊，从靠近自己的锅边一片片轻轻滑入，炸 2–3 分钟到面糊定型、呈浅黄色，捞出。分批炸，别让肉片粘在一起；锅边不要有水，炸的时候别离开灶台。
steps.en: Heat oil about 3 cm deep in the wok over medium heat to about 160°C — fine bubbles should rise around a dry wooden chopstick. Stir the batter (the starch settles), coat the pork thickly and slide the slices in one at a time, away from you; fry for 2–3 minutes, until the coating has set and turned pale gold, then lift out. Fry in batches so the slices don't stick together, keep water away from the pan and stay at the stove while frying.

steps.zh: 把油烧到约 180°C（丢一点面糊进去马上浮起、剧烈冒泡），肉片全部倒回去复炸约 1 分钟，到金黄酥脆，捞出沥油。切开一片看看，肉要熟透、不见粉红。
steps.en: Heat the oil to about 180°C — a drop of batter should float up and sizzle hard at once — then return all the pork and refry for about a minute, until deep golden and crackly; lift out and drain. Cut a slice open to check that the pork is cooked through with no pink.

steps.zh: 小心地把热油倒进耐热的容器，锅里留约 1 汤匙。中火下葱丝、姜丝和胡萝卜丝炒几秒出香味，倒入糖醋汁烧到冒大泡、略微浓稠，马上倒入肉片大火快速翻匀，撒香菜出锅，趁热吃最脆。用过的油放凉后再处理。
steps.en: Carefully pour the hot oil into a heatproof container, leaving about 1 tbsp in the wok. Fry the spring onion, ginger and carrot over medium heat for a few seconds, pour in the sauce and let it bubble hard until slightly syrupy, then tip in the pork and toss quickly over high heat to coat. Scatter with coriander and serve at once, while it's crisp. Let the oil cool completely before you deal with it.

name.en: Liu rou duan (crisp pork in garlic sauce)

summary.zh: 东北下饭菜：肉段裹上蛋糊炸得外酥里嫩，再和青椒一起溜上浓浓的蒜香酱汁。
summary.en: Crisp-fried pork pieces tossed with green pepper in a glossy, garlicky soy sauce — a north-eastern favourite with rice.

note.zh: 60 克挂糊；1½ 茶匙调碗汁
note.en: 60 g for the batter; 1½ tsp for the sauce

steps.zh: 肉切成小指粗、约 4 厘米长的段，加一小撮盐、料酒、白胡椒粉和 1 茶匙生抽抓匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Cut the pork into finger-thick strips about 4 cm long and mix with a pinch of salt, the Shaoxing wine, the white pepper and 1 tsp of the soy sauce; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 腌肉的时候切配菜：青椒去籽切小块，胡萝卜切片，泡好的木耳撕成小朵，蒜、葱和姜切末。剩下的生抽、老抽、糖、醋、一小撮盐、1½ 茶匙淀粉和 4 汤匙水调成碗汁。
steps.en: Meanwhile, seed the pepper and cut it into bite-sized pieces, slice the carrot, tear the soaked wood ear into small pieces and mince the garlic, spring onion and ginger. Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the dark soy, sugar, vinegar, a pinch of salt, 1½ tsp of the starch and 4 tbsp water for the sauce.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋打散，加 60 克淀粉搅成稠糊（太干就加一点水），放入肉段拌匀，每块都厚厚地裹上糊。锅里倒油约 3 厘米深，中火烧到约 160°C（插一根干的木筷子进去，周围冒细密的小泡），肉段从靠近自己的锅边一块块轻轻放入，用筷子拨散，炸 3–4 分钟到表面定型、呈浅黄色，捞出。分批炸；锅边不要有水，炸的时候别离开灶台。
steps.en: Beat the egg with 60 g of the starch into a thick batter (add a splash of water if it's too stiff) and turn the pork in it until every piece is thickly coated. Heat oil about 3 cm deep in the wok over medium heat to about 160°C — fine bubbles should rise around a dry wooden chopstick. Lower the pork in piece by piece, away from you, nudge the pieces apart and fry for 3–4 minutes, until the coating has set and turned pale gold; lift out. Fry in batches, keep water away from the pan and stay at the stove while frying.

steps.zh: 把油烧到约 180°C（丢一点面糊进去马上浮起、剧烈冒泡），肉段倒回去复炸 1 分钟，到金黄酥脆，捞出沥油。切开一块看看，中间要熟透、不见粉红。
steps.en: Heat the oil to about 180°C — a drop of batter should float up and sizzle hard at once — then return the pork and refry for a minute, until deep golden and crisp; lift out and drain. Cut a piece open to check it is cooked through with no pink in the middle.

steps.zh: 小心地把热油倒进耐热的容器，锅里留约 1 汤匙。大火下一半蒜末和葱姜末炒香，放青椒、胡萝卜和木耳翻炒 1 分钟；碗汁搅匀倒进锅里，烧到浓稠发亮，倒入肉段和剩下的蒜末快速翻匀，每块都裹上汁就出锅。用过的油放凉后再处理。
steps.en: Carefully pour the hot oil into a heatproof container, leaving about 1 tbsp in the wok. Fry half the garlic with the spring onion and ginger over high heat until fragrant, add the pepper, carrot and wood ear and toss for a minute. Stir the sauce, pour it in and let it bubble until thick and glossy, then tip in the pork with the rest of the garlic and toss quickly to coat every piece; serve at once. Let the oil cool completely before you deal with it.

summary.zh: 东北酸菜切丝和肉丝一起大火炒，酸香下饭，带一点干辣椒的香辣。
summary.en: Shredded Dongbei suancai stir-fried with pork and a few dried chillies — sour, savoury and made for rice.

note.en: in thin strips; pork belly works too

steps.zh: 肉丝加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒和淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。葱、姜切丝，蒜切片，干辣椒剪段。
steps.en: Mix the pork with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and the cornflour and leave for 10 minutes. Shred the spring onion and ginger, slice the garlic and snip the chillies into pieces.

steps.zh: 腌肉的时候处理酸菜：切成细丝，用清水抓洗两遍，攥干水分；喜欢酸味重的只洗一遍。
steps.en: Meanwhile, shred the suancai finely, rinse it twice in cold water and squeeze it dry; rinse it only once if you like it really sour.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，大火下肉丝炒散，炒到变色、熟透，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the wok with 1 tbsp oil over high heat and stir-fry the pork until it changes colour and is cooked through; take it out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，中火下葱姜丝、蒜片和干辣椒炒香，放酸菜转大火翻炒 3–4 分钟，炒干水汽、炒出酸香味。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the spring onion, ginger, garlic and chillies over medium heat until fragrant; add the suancai, turn up the heat and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, until it is dry and smells sour and savoury.

steps.zh: 倒回肉丝，加剩下的生抽和糖翻炒 1 分钟。酸菜本身有咸味，先尝再决定加不加盐。
steps.en: Return the pork with the rest of the soy sauce and the sugar and toss for a minute. The suancai is already salty, so taste before adding any salt.

summary.zh: 东北冬天的一锅暖：酸菜炖得酸香软烂，白肉片得薄薄的，粉丝吸饱了汤，蘸上蒜泥酱油最香。
summary.en: A warming north-eastern pot of tangy suancai, wafer-thin pork belly and glass noodles, with a garlic and soy dip on the side.

note.en: for the pork; keep the broth

steps.zh: 五花肉整块冷水下锅，水要没过肉，加 2 根葱、3 片姜、八角、花椒和料酒，大火烧开后撇去浮沫，转小火盖盖煮 30 分钟，到筷子能轻松扎透、不冒血水。
steps.en: Put the pork belly in a pot with the cold water — it should cover the meat — and add two of the spring onions, 3 slices of ginger, the star anise, the Sichuan peppercorns and the Shaoxing wine. Bring to the boil over high heat and skim, then cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, until a chopstick goes in easily and no pink juices run out.

steps.zh: 煮肉的时候处理酸菜：先把厚的菜帮横着片成薄片，再切成细丝（买切好的酸菜丝可以省掉这步），用清水洗两遍，攥干。粉丝用温水泡 10 分钟到软。剩下的葱、姜切丝，蒜捣成蒜泥。
steps.en: Meanwhile, prepare the suancai. Slice the thick stems horizontally into thin sheets, then cut everything into fine shreds (pre-shredded suancai skips this), rinse twice in cold water and squeeze dry. Soak the noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until soft. Shred the remaining spring onion and ginger and crush the garlic to a paste.

steps.zh: 肉捞出放凉（泡一下冷水会更快），尽量切成约 2 毫米厚的大薄片。肉汤捞掉葱姜和香料，倒进大碗留用。
steps.en: Lift out the pork and let it cool (a dip in cold water speeds this up), then slice it as thinly as you can, about 2 mm. Fish the aromatics and spices out of the broth and pour it into a large bowl.

steps.zh: 锅擦干放油，中火炒香葱姜丝，下酸菜翻炒 2–3 分钟炒出酸香味，倒入约 1.2 升肉汤（不够就加开水），烧开后转小火炖 15 分钟。
steps.en: Wipe the pot dry, heat the oil over medium heat and fry the shredded spring onion and ginger until fragrant; add the suancai and stir for 2–3 minutes, until it smells sour and savoury. Pour in about 1.2 litres of the broth, topping up with boiling water if needed, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 肉片铺在酸菜上，放入沥干的粉丝，再煮 5 分钟到粉丝透明、肉片热透；加盐和白胡椒粉调味，酸菜本身有咸味，先尝再加。
steps.en: Lay the pork slices over the suancai, add the drained noodles and simmer for 5 minutes more, until the noodles are clear and the pork is hot through. Season with salt and white pepper — taste first, as the suancai is salty.

steps.zh: 蒜泥加生抽调成蘸料（不放生抽的话，用一小撮盐和两勺肉汤调），喜欢的话再加用少许温水澥开的芝麻酱。连锅上桌，肉片蘸着吃。
steps.en: For the dip, mix the garlic with the soy sauce — or, without soy sauce, with a pinch of salt and two spoonfuls of the broth — and stir in sesame paste loosened with a little warm water if you like. Bring the pot to the table and dip the pork as you eat.

summary.zh: 韭黄鲜嫩清甜，拌进蛋液一起炒，蛋香里带着淡淡的韭香。
summary.en: Tender, sweet yellow chives folded into beaten egg and scrambled together — mild, fragrant and quick.

steps.zh: 韭黄洗净，切掉根部，去掉蔫烂的叶尖，沥干水分后切 3 厘米段。
steps.en: Wash the yellow chives, trim off the root ends and any wilted tips, drain well and cut into 3 cm lengths.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散，喜欢可以加少许白胡椒粉；下锅前再拌入韭黄，免得韭黄出水。
steps.en: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, and a little white pepper if you like; stir in the chives just before cooking so they don't go watery.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，转中火倒入蛋液，稍凝固就用锅铲轻轻推动，1–2 分钟后蛋刚凝固、韭黄变软就好。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok, turn the heat to medium and pour in the egg mixture; as it begins to set, push it gently with the spatula for 1–2 minutes, until the egg is just set and the chives have softened.

steps.zh: 尝一下咸淡，需要的话再撒一点盐，趁热出锅。
steps.en: Taste, add a little more salt if needed and serve hot.

summary.zh: 青椒脆嫩清香，鸡蛋松软，两样家常食材就是一盘下饭菜。
summary.en: Crisp green pepper and fluffy scrambled egg — two everyday ingredients, one savoury plate.

steps.zh: 青椒去蒂去籽，切成小块或粗丝；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Seed the peppers and cut them into bite-sized pieces or thick strips; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油烧热，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就炒成大块，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok, pour in the eggs and, as they begin to set, break them into large curds; take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，大火下青椒翻炒 1–2 分钟，炒到颜色发亮、刚断生，加盐。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the peppers over high heat for 1–2 minutes, until glossy and just tender; season with salt.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋，大火翻炒几下就出锅，青椒脆口才好吃。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss over high heat for a few seconds and serve while the peppers are still crisp.

name.en: Steamed scallops (or oysters) with garlic & vermicelli

summary.zh: 半壳扇贝垫上粉丝、铺满金黄蒜蓉大火快蒸，再淋豉油、浇热油，粉丝吸饱了鲜甜的汁水。
summary.en: Scallops on the half shell, steamed fast on a bed of vermicelli under golden garlic and finished with soy sauce and sizzling oil, so the noodles soak up every drop of juice.

note.en: or seasoned soy sauce for fish

steps.zh: 粉丝用温水泡 10–15 分钟到变软，剪成小段，沥干。
steps.en: Soak the vermicelli in warm water for 10–15 minutes until soft, then snip it into short lengths and drain.

steps.zh: 扇贝刷净外壳，用小刀贴着壳把贝肉剔下来，扯掉黑色的内脏（橙色的扇贝黄可以留着），冲洗干净；冷冻的先放冷藏室解冻。生蚝要买活的，张着口、敲一敲也不合上的扔掉，撬开后同样冲洗干净。
steps.en: Scrub the shells, run a small knife under each scallop to free it and pull off the dark gut (keep the orange roe), then rinse; thaw frozen scallops in the fridge first. Oysters should be bought live, so discard any that gape and don't close when tapped, then shuck and rinse them the same way.

steps.zh: 蒜切成细末，一半放进碗里；另一半和 1 汤匙油一起下锅，小火炒到浅金黄，连油倒进生蒜末里，加一小撮盐拌匀。
steps.en: Mince the garlic finely and put half in a bowl. Fry the other half in 1 tbsp of the oil over low heat until pale gold, then pour it, oil and all, over the raw garlic and stir in a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 每个壳里垫一小团粉丝，放上贝肉，舀上蒜蓉，摆在耐热盘里。水烧开后放入，大火蒸 5–6 分钟（大个的生蚝多蒸 1–2 分钟），贝肉变白、刚刚凝固就关火，蒸久了会老。
steps.en: Lay a small nest of vermicelli in each shell, set the scallop on top, spoon over the garlic and arrange them on a heatproof plate. Steam over boiling water on high for 5–6 minutes (a minute or two longer for large oysters), just until the flesh turns opaque and firm; any longer and it toughens.

steps.zh: 生抽、糖和 1 汤匙水调匀，每个淋上一点，撒葱花；剩下的油烧到冒烟，浇在葱花上，趁热吃。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, sugar and 1 tbsp water and spoon a little over each one, then scatter with the spring onion. Heat the rest of the oil until it smokes and pour it over so it sizzles; serve hot.

summary.zh: 海虹加姜葱、料酒大火一煮，开口就出锅，肉嫩汁鲜，蘸着蒜香醋汁吃。
summary.en: Mussels boiled hard with ginger, spring onion and Shaoxing wine just until they open — plump, sweet and juicy, with a garlicky soy and vinegar dip.

steps.zh: 海虹在流水下用刷子刷净外壳，下锅前再扯掉壳边的足丝（“胡子”）。壳破了的扔掉；张着口的轻敲几下，不合上的也扔掉。
steps.en: Scrub the mussels under running water and pull off the beards just before cooking. Discard any with broken shells, and any open ones that don't close when tapped.

steps.zh: 姜切片，葱切段。做蘸料：蒜切末，加生抽和醋拌匀，喜欢辣的再加辣椒圈。
steps.en: Slice the ginger and cut the spring onions into lengths. For the dip, mince the garlic and mix it with the soy sauce and vinegar, adding sliced chilli if you like heat.

steps.zh: 锅里放 100 毫升水、姜片、葱段和料酒，大火烧开，倒入海虹，盖上锅盖大火煮 4–6 分钟，中途晃几下锅，壳都张开就关火。
steps.en: Bring 100 ml water to the boil in a pot with the ginger, spring onion and Shaoxing wine. Tip in the mussels, cover and boil hard for 4–6 minutes, shaking the pot once or twice, until the shells open.

steps.zh: 海虹捞出装盘，煮完还紧闭不开的扔掉。趁热蘸料吃；锅里的汤很鲜，可以舀一点浇在上面。
steps.en: Lift the mussels into a bowl, discarding any that stay shut. Eat them hot with the dip, with a little of the tasty cooking liquid spooned over.

name.en: Quick seafood in chilled laozhi sauce

summary.zh: 虾和鱿鱼快速焯熟，冰水一激更爽脆，泡进蒜香酸辣的捞汁里，配上清脆的黄瓜。
summary.en: Prawns and squid blanched in moments, chilled in iced water until snappy and tossed in a garlicky, tangy chilli sauce with crisp cucumber.

note.zh: 或青口、花蛤（带壳 400 克）
note.en: or 400 g mussels or clams in the shell

steps.zh: 调捞汁：蒜切末，小米辣切圈，香菜切段。蒜末和辣椒圈放进碗里，加生抽、醋、糖和 4 汤匙凉白开，搅到糖化开，喜欢的话再加香油。
steps.en: For the sauce, mince the garlic, slice the chillies and chop the coriander. Put the garlic and chilli in a bowl with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 4 tbsp cooled boiled water, stir until the sugar dissolves and add the sesame oil if you like.

steps.zh: 黄瓜拍裂后切小段，洋葱切细丝，铺在深盘底。大虾剪去虾须和虾枪，从背部剪开，挑出虾线；鱿鱼处理干净，身子切圈，须切段。
steps.en: Smash the cucumber and cut it into short pieces, slice the onion thinly and spread both over a deep dish. Trim the prawns' feelers and spikes, cut along the back and pull out the vein; clean the squid and cut the body into rings and the tentacles into short lengths.

steps.zh: 备一大碗冰水。一锅水加姜片和料酒烧开，先下鱿鱼焯 30–60 秒，卷起变白就捞进冰水；再下大虾煮 1–2 分钟，变红、虾肉刚好不透明就捞进冰水。换成青口或花蛤的话（花蛤要先吐沙），煮到开口就捞，没开口的扔掉。
steps.en: Set out a large bowl of iced water. Bring a pot of water to the boil with the ginger and Shaoxing wine. Blanch the squid for 30–60 seconds, until it curls and turns white, and lift it into the iced water; then cook the prawns for 1–2 minutes, until pink and just opaque all through, and chill them too. Mussels or clams (purge clams in salted water first) need only boil until they open; discard any that stay shut.

steps.zh: 海鲜在冰水里泡 2–3 分钟到凉透，捞出沥干，放在黄瓜和洋葱上，倒入捞汁，撒香菜拌匀。现拌现吃，或冷藏 10 分钟更入味，当天吃完。
steps.en: Leave the seafood in the iced water for 2–3 minutes until cold, drain well and pile it onto the cucumber and onion. Pour over the sauce, scatter with the coriander and toss. Eat it straight away or after 10 minutes in the fridge to soak up more flavour, and finish it the same day.

summary.zh: 广式小炒，鸡蛋小火轻推，嫩滑得几乎要流动，裹着一颗颗弹牙的虾仁。
summary.en: The Cantonese classic — eggs pushed gently over low heat until barely set and silky, folded around plump, springy prawns.

steps.zh: 虾仁挑去虾线，冲洗后用厨房纸彻底吸干，加一小撮盐、白胡椒、料酒和 ½ 茶匙淀粉抓匀。葱切葱花。
steps.en: Devein the prawns if needed, rinse and pat them thoroughly dry, then toss with a pinch of salt, the white pepper, the Shaoxing wine and ½ tsp of the cornflour. Chop the spring onion.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋加一小撮盐和几滴香油（可不放）打散；剩下的 1 茶匙淀粉加 2 汤匙水调匀，倒进蛋液里再打匀。
steps.en: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and a few drops of sesame oil, if using. Mix the remaining 1 tsp cornflour with 2 tbsp water and beat it into the eggs.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 2 茶匙油，中火下虾仁炒 1 分钟左右，炒到变红卷起、刚好熟透，盛出倒进蛋液里拌匀。
steps.en: Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and stir-fry the prawns for about a minute, until pink, curled and just cooked through; tip them into the eggs and stir.

steps.zh: 锅里放剩下的油，转中小火，倒入虾仁蛋液，等边缘稍凝固，用铲子从边缘往中间慢慢推成大块。大部分凝固、表面还湿润发亮时就关火盛出，余温会让蛋刚好熟。撒葱花即可。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil, turn the heat to medium-low and pour in the egg and prawns. As the edges begin to set, push them slowly from the sides to the middle in large soft folds. Take the pan off the heat while the eggs are mostly set but still moist and glossy, as they keep cooking; scatter with the spring onion.

summary.zh: 鲜虾加姜葱开水一灼，红亮弹牙，蘸着姜丝豉油吃，吃的就是虾本身的鲜甜。
summary.en: Fresh prawns cooked briefly in boiling water with ginger and spring onion until pink and snappy, then dipped in gingery soy sauce — nothing hides their sweetness.

note.zh: 活虾最好；冷冻的先解冻
note.en: live are best; thaw if frozen

note.zh: 拇指大小；切几片煮虾，其余切细丝做蘸料
note.en: thumb-sized; a few slices for the pot and the rest shredded for the dip
or seasoned soy sauce for fish

steps.zh: 大虾冲洗干净，剪去虾须和虾枪；想去虾线的话，用牙签从虾背第二节插进去挑出来。
steps.en: Rinse the prawns and trim off the feelers and spikes. To devein them, push a toothpick through the back between the second and third shell segments and pull the vein out.

steps.zh: 姜切几片，剩下的切细丝；葱挽成结。做蘸料：姜丝和辣椒圈放进小碗，油烧到冒烟后浇上去，再加生抽和糖拌匀。
steps.en: Cut a few slices of ginger and finely shred the rest; tie the spring onions in a knot. For the dip, put the ginger shreds and sliced chilli in a small heatproof bowl, pour over the oil heated until smoking, then stir in the soy sauce and sugar.

steps.zh: 一锅水加姜片、葱结和料酒大火烧开，倒入大虾煮 1–2 分钟，虾身变红弯起、虾肉刚好不透明就捞出；个头大的多煮半分钟。
steps.en: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil with the ginger slices, spring onion and Shaoxing wine. Add the prawns and cook for 1–2 minutes, until red and curled and the flesh is just opaque, giving large ones 30 seconds more.

steps.zh: 沥干装盘（过一下冰水口感更爽脆），剥壳蘸料吃。
steps.en: Drain and pile onto a plate (a quick dip in iced water makes them even snappier), then peel and eat with the dip.

summary.zh: 吐净沙的花蛤和姜丝、葱段大火爆炒，一开口就出锅，鲜咸的汤汁拌饭一流。
summary.en: Clams tossed over high heat with ginger and spring onion until they pop open, in a briny, savoury juice that is perfect over rice.

steps.zh: 花蛤冲洗后泡进淡盐水里（每升水约 1 汤匙盐，水要没过花蛤），放在阴凉处静置吐沙至少 30 分钟，市场买的活花蛤最好泡 1–2 小时；包装上写明已吐沙的冲洗干净即可。
steps.en: Rinse the clams and cover them with salted water, about 1 tbsp salt to a litre, then leave them somewhere cool for at least 30 minutes to purge their sand, or 1–2 hours for live clams from the market; clams sold as purged just need a rinse.

steps.zh: 把花蛤从水里捞出（沉在盆底的沙别倒回去），互相搓洗外壳后冲净。壳破的扔掉，张着口、敲一敲也不合上的也扔掉。姜切丝，葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开放，蒜切片，辣椒切圈。
steps.en: Lift the clams out, leaving the sand behind in the bowl, then rub them together under running water and rinse. Discard any with broken shells, and any open ones that don't close when tapped. Shred the ginger, cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the whites and greens apart, and slice the garlic and chilli.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，下姜丝、葱白、蒜片和辣椒小火炒香，转大火倒入花蛤翻炒 1 分钟，沿锅边淋入料酒，盖上锅盖焖 2–3 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the ginger, spring onion whites, garlic and chilli gently until fragrant. Turn the heat to high, add the clams and toss for a minute, then splash the Shaoxing wine around the side of the wok, cover and cook for 2–3 minutes.

steps.zh: 开盖后花蛤大多已经开口，加生抽和葱绿，大火翻炒到全部开口、汤汁稍稍收浓就出锅；炒完还紧闭不开的扔掉。
steps.en: By now most of the clams will have opened. Add the soy sauce and spring onion greens and toss over high heat until they have all opened and the juices have reduced a little; discard any that stay shut, and serve.

summary.zh: 芹菜脆嫩清香，肉丝滑嫩，咸鲜下饭的经典家常小炒。
summary.en: Crunchy, fragrant celery with silky strips of pork — a classic everyday stir-fry.

steps.zh: 猪肉先切薄片再切细丝，加 1 茶匙生抽、料酒、淀粉和 1 茶匙油抓匀，腌 5 分钟。
steps.en: Slice the pork thinly, then cut it into fine strips; mix with 1 tsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, the cornflour and 1 tsp oil and leave for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 芹菜摘掉叶子洗净，粗的茎先撕掉老筋、对半剖开，再切 4 厘米段；蒜切片。
steps.en: Strip the leaves off the celery and wash it; pull the strings off any thick stalks and halve them lengthways, then cut everything into 4 cm lengths. Slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，大火下肉丝快速划散，炒到完全变色、熟透，盛出。
steps.en: Heat the rest of the oil in the wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork, separating the strips quickly, until it has changed colour all over and is cooked through; take it out.

steps.zh: 锅里留底油，下蒜片炒香，放芹菜大火翻炒 1–2 分钟，炒到颜色翠绿、刚断生，加少许盐。
steps.en: Fry the garlic in the oil left in the wok until fragrant, add the celery and stir-fry over high heat for 1–2 minutes, until bright green and just tender; season with a little salt.

steps.zh: 倒回肉丝，加剩下的生抽大火翻匀，即可出锅。
steps.en: Return the pork with the rest of the soy sauce, toss over high heat and serve.

summary.zh: 黄瓜快炒后依然清脆，配上嫩滑的鸡蛋，清爽又下饭。
summary.en: Cucumber flash-fried so it stays crisp and fresh, with soft golden egg — a quick, clean-tasting stir-fry.

steps.zh: 黄瓜洗净，对半剖开，籽多的话用小勺刮掉，再斜切成约 3 毫米厚的片；鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散；蒜切片。
steps.en: Wash the cucumber and halve it lengthways, scraping out the seeds with a teaspoon if there are a lot, then slice it on the diagonal about 3 mm thick; beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and slice the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油烧热，倒入蛋液，稍凝固就推成大块，盛出备用。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil, pour in the eggs and push them into large curds as they set; take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，下蒜片炒香，转大火下黄瓜片快炒 1 分钟左右，炒到颜色翠绿、刚断生，加盐。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the garlic until fragrant, then stir-fry the cucumber over high heat for about a minute, until bright green and barely tender; season with salt.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻匀，马上出锅；黄瓜炒久了会出水变软。
steps.en: Return the eggs, toss and serve at once; cucumber cooked any longer turns soft and watery.

summary.zh: 东北凉菜：尖椒、黄瓜、香菜和葱切丝一拌，生辣爽脆，越吃越下饭。
summary.en: Raw green chilli, cucumber, coriander and spring onion in a tangy soy dressing — a fiery, crunchy north-eastern cold dish.

note.en: long green chillies; or 1 green capsicum

steps.zh: 尖椒去蒂去籽，切成细丝，怕太辣就把白筋也去掉；黄瓜和葱切细丝，香菜切段，小米辣切圈。切完辣椒记得洗手，别碰眼睛。
steps.en: Stem and seed the green chillies and cut them into fine strips, trimming out the pale ribs too if you want less heat; cut the cucumber and spring onions into fine strips, the coriander into short lengths and the bird's eye chillies into rings. Wash your hands after handling chillies and keep them away from your eyes.

steps.zh: 生抽、醋、糖和香油放进小碗，搅到糖化开。
steps.en: Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil together in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.

steps.zh: 吃之前再把汁倒进菜里拌匀，尝一下，不够咸再加一点盐。现拌现吃最脆，放久了会出水。
steps.en: Toss the vegetables with the dressing just before serving, then taste and add a little salt if needed. It is crunchiest eaten at once; left to stand, it turns watery.

summary.zh: 一清二白的家常凉菜：嫩豆腐撒满葱花，只用盐和香油调味，清爽滑嫩。
summary.en: Cool, silky tofu under a shower of spring onion, dressed simply with salt and sesame oil.

steps.zh: 嫩豆腐撕去盒膜，倒扣在盘里，盒底剪个小口，豆腐就能完整滑出；倒掉渗出的水，切成约 2 厘米的小块。
steps.en: Peel the film off the tofu, turn the box over onto a plate and snip a small hole in the base so the tofu slides out whole; pour off the liquid and cut it into roughly 2 cm cubes.

steps.zh: 小葱洗净，切成细葱花，多放一点才香。
steps.en: Wash the spring onions and slice them finely — be generous.

steps.zh: 豆腐上均匀撒盐，铺上葱花，淋香油，用勺子轻轻拌一拌，豆腐碎一点也没关系，拌好马上吃。
steps.en: Sprinkle the salt evenly over the tofu, scatter with the spring onion, drizzle with the sesame oil and fold gently with a spoon — a few broken pieces don't matter. Eat straight away.

summary.zh: 东北家常小炒：干豆腐切条，和尖椒一起大火快炒，豆香浓，微微辣，很下饭。
summary.en: A north-eastern everyday stir-fry of tofu skin strips and green chilli — savoury, with a gentle kick.

note.en: long green chillies; or 1 green capsicum

steps.zh: 干豆腐切成约 1 厘米宽的条，放进碗里，倒入开水烫 1 分钟去掉豆腥味，捞出沥干。尖椒去蒂去籽，切成细条；蒜切片，葱切段。
steps.en: Cut the tofu skin into strips about 1 cm wide, put them in a bowl and cover with boiling water for a minute to take away the raw beany taste; drain well. Stem and seed the green chillies and cut them into thin strips; slice the garlic and cut the spring onion into short lengths.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放油，中火下葱段和蒜片炒香，放尖椒（和辣椒）转大火翻炒 1 分钟，炒到颜色发亮、表皮微微起皱。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the spring onion and garlic until fragrant; add the green chillies, plus the extra chilli if using, and stir-fry over high heat for a minute, until glossy and lightly blistered.

steps.zh: 下干豆腐，沿锅边淋入生抽，加 3 汤匙水，翻炒 2 分钟，让豆腐吸饱汤汁；尝一下，加盐调味即可。
steps.en: Add the tofu skin, splash the soy sauce around the side of the wok, add 3 tbsp water and toss for 2 minutes, until the tofu has soaked up the liquid; taste and season with salt.

summary.zh: 西兰花翠绿脆嫩，虾仁滑嫩弹牙，薄薄一层亮芡，清清爽爽。
summary.en: Bright, crisp broccoli and tender, springy prawns in a thin, glossy sauce.

steps.zh: 虾仁挑去虾线，加一小撮盐抓一抓，冲洗干净，用厨房纸吸干；再加一小撮盐、白胡椒、料酒和 1 茶匙淀粉抓匀，腌 5 分钟。
steps.en: Devein the prawns if needed, rub them with a pinch of salt, rinse and pat dry; toss with another pinch of salt, the white pepper, the Shaoxing wine and 1 tsp of the cornflour and leave for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 西兰花切小朵，粗梗削去硬皮后切片；蒜切末；剩下的 1 茶匙淀粉加 3 汤匙水调成水淀粉。
steps.en: Cut the broccoli into small florets, peeling and slicing the thick stem; mince the garlic. Mix the remaining 1 tsp cornflour with 3 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 水烧开，加一小撮盐和几滴油，下西兰花焯 1 分钟，捞出沥干。
steps.en: Blanch the broccoli for a minute in boiling water with a pinch of salt and a few drops of oil, then drain well.

steps.zh: 锅烧热放 1 汤匙油，中火下虾仁滑炒 1–2 分钟，炒到变红卷起、刚好不透明，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the wok and stir-fry the prawns over medium heat for 1–2 minutes, until pink, curled and just opaque; take them out.

steps.zh: 锅里放剩下的油，下蒜末炒香，放西兰花大火翻炒 30 秒，倒回虾仁，加盐，淋入水淀粉翻炒到汁变亮、裹匀即可。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and fry the garlic until fragrant, then add the broccoli and toss over high heat for 30 seconds. Return the prawns, season with salt, pour in the cornflour mixture and toss until glossy and coated.

summary.zh: 苦瓜微苦回甘，裹上香软的鸡蛋，越吃越有味道。
summary.en: Pleasantly bitter melon mellowed by fluffy scrambled egg — a home-style classic that grows on you.

steps.zh: 苦瓜洗净，对半剖开，用勺子把瓜瓤和白色内膜刮干净（白膜最苦），再斜切成薄片。
steps.en: Wash the bitter melon, halve it lengthways and scrape out the seeds and all the white pith with a spoon (the pith is the most bitter part), then slice it thinly on the diagonal.

steps.zh: 苦瓜片加 ½ 茶匙盐抓匀，腌 5 分钟，挤干渗出的水分，苦味会淡一些；趁这时把鸡蛋加一小撮盐打散。
steps.en: Toss the slices with ½ tsp salt and leave for 5 minutes, then squeeze out the juice they release, which takes some of the bitterness with it; meanwhile beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 汤匙油烧热，倒入蛋液炒到刚凝固，盛出。
steps.en: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok and scramble the eggs until just set; take them out.

steps.zh: 补上剩下的油，大火下苦瓜片翻炒 2 分钟，炒到翠绿变软；怕苦可以加一小撮糖。
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the bitter melon over high heat for 2 minutes, until bright green and tender; a pinch of sugar takes the edge off the bitterness.

steps.zh: 倒回鸡蛋翻匀。苦瓜腌过已经有咸味，尝过再决定要不要补盐。
steps.en: Return the eggs and toss; the salted melon is already seasoned, so taste before adding any more salt.

summary.zh: 羊肉炖得软烂入味，茄子吸饱了浓浓的肉汤，软糯鲜香，特别下饭。
summary.en: Tender lamb simmered in a savoury soy broth, with chunks of eggplant that turn silky as they soak up the juices.

note.zh: 羊肩肉或羊腿肉，切 3 厘米块
note.en: shoulder or leg; in 3 cm pieces

steps.zh: 羊肉切 3 厘米块，姜切片，葱切段。羊肉冷水下锅，加 2 片姜和 1 汤匙料酒，大火煮开后撇去浮沫，再煮 2 分钟，捞出用热水冲洗干净、沥干。
steps.en: Cut the lamb into 3 cm pieces, slice the ginger and cut the spring onions into lengths. Put the lamb in a pot of cold water with 2 slices of the ginger and 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil over high heat and skim off the foam; boil 2 minutes more, then rinse the lamb in hot water and drain.

steps.zh: 锅洗净烧热，放油，中火下剩下的姜片、葱段和八角（和花椒）炒香，放入羊肉翻炒 3–4 分钟，到表面微黄、出油。淋入剩下的料酒，再加生抽和老抽翻炒均匀上色。
steps.en: Wipe out the pot, heat the oil over medium heat and fry the rest of the ginger with the spring onion and star anise (and the Sichuan peppercorns) until fragrant. Add the lamb and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, until lightly browned and the fat starts to run, then pour in the rest of the wine, add the soy sauce and dark soy and toss until the lamb is evenly coloured.

steps.zh: 倒入热水，没过羊肉约 2 厘米，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 30–35 分钟，到羊肉快要软烂。趁这时把茄子切滚刀块，番茄切块。
steps.en: Pour in the hot water to about 2 cm above the lamb, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 30–35 minutes, until the lamb is nearly tender. Meanwhile cut the eggplants into chunks and the tomato into wedges.

steps.zh: 放入茄子和番茄，轻轻压进汤里，盖盖再炖 10–15 分钟，到茄子软透但还保持成块、羊肉用筷子能轻松插透。茄子很吸汤，汤快干了就加一点热水。
steps.en: Add the eggplant and tomato, pressing them down into the liquid, then cover and simmer for 10–15 minutes more, until the eggplant is soft right through but still holds its shape and a chopstick slides easily into the lamb. Eggplant soaks up a lot of liquid, so add a splash of hot water if the pot starts to run dry.

steps.zh: 开盖中火收汁到汤汁浓稠，尝一下加盐调味，撒上香菜段出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over medium heat until the sauce thickens; taste, season with salt and scatter with chopped coriander.

summary.zh: 东北家常炖菜：豆角吸饱了酱香，土豆炖得软糯起沙，一锅特别下饭。
summary.en: A north-eastern favourite — green beans and potatoes simmered in savoury soybean paste until the potatoes turn soft and fluffy.

note.zh: 东北油豆角最地道；四季豆也行
note.en: wide flat beans are closest; any green beans will do
north-eastern style if you can get it

steps.zh: 豆角掐去两头、撕掉老筋，掰成 5 厘米左右的段，洗净沥干。土豆去皮切滚刀块，泡在清水里防止变色。五花肉切薄片，姜切片，葱切段，蒜一半切片、一半切末。
steps.en: Top and tail the beans, pull off any strings and snap them into lengths of about 5 cm; wash and drain. Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and keep them in cold water so they don't brown. Slice the pork belly thinly, slice the ginger, cut the spring onions into lengths, and slice half the garlic and mince the rest.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下五花肉片煸 3–4 分钟，到出油、微微焦黄（不放五花肉就直接热油）。下姜片、葱段和蒜片炒香，再加黄豆酱小火炒 30 秒，炒出酱香。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the pork belly for 3–4 minutes, until the fat runs and it starts to brown (without the pork, just heat the oil). Add the ginger, spring onion and sliced garlic and fry until fragrant, then stir in the soybean paste and fry it over low heat for 30 seconds, until it smells toasty.

steps.zh: 下豆角转大火翻炒 3–4 分钟，到颜色变深、表面油亮，再加生抽和沥干的土豆块翻匀。
steps.en: Add the beans, turn up the heat and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, until they turn a deeper green and look glossy; add the soy sauce and the drained potatoes and toss together.

steps.zh: 倒入热水，差不多没过食材，烧开后转中小火盖盖炖 15–20 分钟，中途翻动一两次防止粘锅，到土豆用筷子能轻松戳透。豆角一定要炖到完全熟透：颜色变暗、软而不脆，没有生豆味，咬起来也不再咯吱作响；没熟透的豆角吃了容易闹肚子。
steps.en: Pour in the hot water, just enough to cover, bring to the boil, then put the lid on and simmer over medium-low heat for 15–20 minutes, stirring once or twice so nothing sticks, until a chopstick slides easily into the potatoes. The beans must be cooked right through — dull green, soft rather than crisp, with no raw taste and no squeak when you bite one; undercooked beans can upset your stomach.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁到汤汁浓稠，尝一下再加盐（大酱和生抽都有咸味），撒入蒜末翻匀即可出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and boil over high heat until the sauce thickens; taste before adding any salt, as the paste and soy sauce are already salty, then stir in the minced garlic and serve.

summary.zh: 土豆、茄子、豆角、玉米、番茄和白菜一锅炖，大酱炖得咸香浓郁，东北人家的大锅菜。
summary.en: A big north-eastern pot of potato, eggplant, green beans, corn, tomato and cabbage, simmered together in savoury soybean paste.

note.en: north-eastern style if you can get it

steps.zh: 土豆去皮切滚刀块，泡在清水里；茄子切滚刀块；豆角掐头去尾、撕掉老筋，掰成 5 厘米段。番茄切块，玉米切 3 厘米段，白菜切大块（菜帮和菜叶分开），青椒去籽掰成小块。五花肉切薄片，姜切片，葱切段，蒜拍扁。
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and keep them in cold water; cut the eggplant into chunks; top, tail and string the beans and snap them into 5 cm lengths. Cut the tomato into wedges and the corn into 3 cm rounds, cut the cabbage into large pieces, keeping the stems apart from the leaves, and seed the pepper and tear it into pieces. Slice the pork belly thinly, slice the ginger, cut the spring onions into lengths and crush the garlic.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下五花肉片煸 3–4 分钟，到出油、微微焦黄（不放肉就直接热油；用排骨的话先焯水洗净再下锅）。下葱段、姜片、蒜和八角炒香，加黄豆酱小火炒 30 秒，炒出酱香。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large wok over medium heat and fry the pork belly for 3–4 minutes, until the fat runs and it starts to brown (without the meat, just heat the oil; ribs need blanching and rinsing first). Add the spring onion, ginger, garlic and star anise and fry until fragrant, then stir in the soybean paste and fry it over low heat for 30 seconds, until it smells toasty.

steps.zh: 下豆角转大火翻炒 3 分钟到颜色变深，再加生抽、土豆和玉米翻匀。倒入热水，烧开后转中小火盖盖炖 10 分钟（用排骨的话炖 30 分钟）。
steps.en: Add the beans, turn up the heat and stir-fry for 3 minutes until they turn a deeper green, then add the soy sauce, potatoes and corn and toss. Pour in the hot water, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes (30 minutes if you are using ribs).

steps.zh: 放入茄子和番茄，轻轻翻匀，盖盖再炖 8–10 分钟，到茄子变软、番茄炖出汁。
steps.en: Add the eggplant and tomato, turn them through gently, then cover and simmer for 8–10 minutes more, until the eggplant is soft and the tomato has broken down into the sauce.

steps.zh: 先放白菜帮炖 2 分钟，再放菜叶和青椒炖 3 分钟，到白菜变软。出锅前确认豆角软透、完全没有生味，咬起来不再咯吱作响——没熟透的豆角吃了容易闹肚子；肉也要熟透。尝一下再加盐，大酱本身已经很咸。
steps.en: Add the cabbage stems and simmer for 2 minutes, then the leaves and pepper for 3 minutes, until the cabbage is soft. Before serving, check that the beans are soft right through with no raw taste or squeak — undercooked beans can upset your stomach — and that the meat is cooked through. Taste before adding salt, as the paste is already salty.

summary.zh: 东北家炖鱼：整条鱼煎得两面金黄，再和豆腐一起用大酱炖透，鱼肉鲜嫩，豆腐吸饱了汤汁。
summary.en: Home-style north-eastern fish — fried golden, then simmered whole with tofu in a rich soybean-paste broth.

note.zh: 约 700–900 克；鲤鱼、鲷鱼等都行，也可以用两条鲫鱼
note.en: about 700–900 g, such as carp, snapper or tarakihi, or two crucian carp
north-eastern style if you can get it

steps.zh: 鱼去鳞去内脏，处理干净（鲤鱼要撕掉肚子里的黑膜），用厨房纸把里外擦干，两面各斜划 3–4 刀，抹上 1 汤匙料酒腌 10 分钟。豆腐切 2 厘米厚的块；姜切片，蒜拍扁，葱切段，葱白和葱绿分开放，香菜切段。
steps.en: Scale and gut the fish (for carp, peel away the black lining inside the belly), pat it dry inside and out with kitchen paper, cut 3–4 diagonal slashes on each side and rub with 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine; leave for 10 minutes. Cut the tofu into 2 cm thick pieces; slice the ginger, crush the garlic, cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart, and chop the coriander.

steps.zh: 下锅前再把鱼擦干，表面越干越不容易溅油、粘锅。锅烧热，用一片姜擦一遍锅底，放油烧热后，手离远一点，把鱼从靠近自己的一侧轻轻滑进锅里，中火煎 3–4 分钟，底面金黄定型前别动它，再小心翻面煎 3 分钟。
steps.en: Dry the fish again just before cooking — the drier it is, the less the oil spits and the less it sticks. Heat the wok, rub it with a slice of ginger, add the oil and, once hot, slide the fish in gently, laying it away from you; fry over medium heat for 3–4 minutes without moving it, until golden and set, then turn it carefully and fry the other side for 3 minutes.

steps.zh: 鱼推到一边，下姜片、蒜、葱白和八角炒香，加黄豆酱小火炒 30 秒出酱香，沿锅边淋入剩下的料酒和醋，再加生抽和糖。
steps.en: Push the fish to one side and fry the ginger, garlic, white spring onion and star anise until fragrant; stir in the soybean paste for 30 seconds over low heat, pour the rest of the wine and the vinegar down the side of the wok, then add the soy sauce and sugar.

steps.zh: 倒入开水到鱼身的大半，把豆腐放在鱼的四周，烧开后转中小火盖盖炖 15–20 分钟，不用翻鱼，中途舀汤汁淋在鱼身上几次；鱼肉最厚处能用筷子轻松插透就熟了。
steps.en: Pour in boiling water to come most of the way up the fish and tuck the tofu in around it; bring to the boil, then cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 15–20 minutes, spooning the sauce over the fish a few times rather than turning it. It is done when a chopstick slides easily into the thickest part.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁到汤汁稍稠，尝一下再决定要不要加盐，撒上葱绿和香菜出锅。
steps.en: Uncover and boil hard until the sauce has thickened a little; taste before adding any salt, then scatter with the green spring onion and the coriander.

summary.zh: 东北名菜：带骨鸡块和泡发的干蘑菇一起小火慢炖，鸡肉软嫩，蘑菇吸饱了浓香的鸡汤。
summary.en: A north-eastern classic — chicken on the bone simmered slowly with dried mushrooms until tender, in a deep, savoury broth.

note.zh: 约 1.2 千克，带骨斩成 3–4 厘米的块；也可以用 1 千克带骨鸡腿或琵琶腿
note.en: about 1.2 kg, chopped on the bone into 3–4 cm pieces; or 1 kg bone-in thighs or drumsticks

note.zh: 干香菇；东北做法多用榛蘑
note.en: dried; north-eastern cooks use dried hazel mushrooms

steps.zh: 干香菇冲洗一下，用约 500 毫升温水泡 30 分钟至软，捞出挤干，剪去硬蒂，大的切半；泡蘑菇的水静置一会儿，倒出上面的清水留用，碗底的沙不要。放粉条的话，同时用温水泡软。
steps.en: Rinse the dried mushrooms and soak them in about 500 ml warm water for 30 minutes until soft; lift them out, squeeze them, snip off the tough stems and halve any large caps. Let the soaking water settle, then pour off the clear water to use and leave the grit behind. If you are adding noodles, soak them in warm water at the same time.

steps.zh: 泡蘑菇的时候，把鸡斩成 3–4 厘米的块（没有大刀可以请肉店代斩），洗净后用厨房纸吸干；姜切片，葱切段。
steps.en: While they soak, chop the chicken through the bone into 3–4 cm pieces (a butcher can do this for you), rinse and pat dry with kitchen paper; slice the ginger and cut the spring onions into lengths.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下鸡块煸炒 5–6 分钟，到鸡肉变色、鸡皮微黄出油，加姜片、葱段和八角炒香。沿锅边淋入料酒，加生抽、老抽和冰糖，翻炒 1–2 分钟到冰糖融化、鸡块上色。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the chicken for 5–6 minutes, until it has changed colour and the skin is lightly golden and giving up its fat; add the ginger, spring onion and star anise and fry until fragrant. Splash the Shaoxing wine around the side of the wok, add the soy sauce, dark soy and rock sugar and toss for 1–2 minutes, until the sugar has melted and the chicken is coloured.

steps.zh: 放入蘑菇翻炒 1 分钟，倒入泡蘑菇的清水，再加热水到刚好没过鸡块（一共约 1 升），烧开后转小火盖盖炖 30 分钟，中途翻动一两次。
steps.en: Add the mushrooms and toss for a minute, then pour in the clear soaking water and enough hot water to just cover the chicken, about 1 litre in all; bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring once or twice.

steps.zh: 放入泡软的粉条推散（不放粉条就直接继续炖），盖盖再炖 10 分钟，到粉条透明软滑、鸡肉软烂熟透，靠近骨头的地方没有血色。
steps.en: Stir in the drained noodles, if using, and simmer covered for 10 minutes more, until the noodles are clear and soft and the chicken is tender and cooked through, with no pink near the bone.

steps.zh: 开盖中火收汁到汤汁稍稠，尝一下加盐调味。粉条会一直吸汤，汤汁可以多留一些。
steps.en: Uncover and reduce over medium heat until the broth thickens slightly, then taste and season with salt. The noodles keep soaking up liquid, so leave it a little soupier than you think.

summary.zh: 清炖做法：牛腩小火慢炖到软烂，白萝卜吸饱了牛肉汤，清甜软糯，汤清味鲜。
summary.en: Brisket simmered slowly in a clear broth until tender, with daikon that turns sweet and silky as it soaks up the beefy stock.

steps.zh: 牛腩切 4 厘米块，冷水下锅，加 2 片姜和 1 汤匙料酒，大火煮开后撇去浮沫，再煮 2–3 分钟，捞出用热水冲洗干净。
steps.en: Cut the brisket into 4 cm pieces and put them in a pot of cold water with 2 slices of the ginger and 1 tbsp of the Shaoxing wine; bring to the boil over high heat, skim off the foam and boil 2–3 minutes more, then rinse the beef in hot water.

steps.zh: 牛腩放回洗净的锅里，加剩下的姜片、葱（打个结）、八角和剩下的料酒，倒入开水没过牛肉 5 厘米左右，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 60–80 分钟，到筷子能轻松插透牛肉；中途要加水只加开水。用高压锅更快，上汽后压 25–35 分钟就够了。
steps.en: Return the beef to the rinsed pot with the rest of the ginger, the spring onions tied in a knot, the star anise and the rest of the wine, and pour in boiling water to about 5 cm above the meat. Bring back to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 60–80 minutes, until a chopstick slides easily through the beef; if it needs topping up, use boiling water only. A pressure cooker is quicker — 25–35 minutes at pressure is enough.

steps.zh: 炖牛肉的时候，把白萝卜去皮切滚刀块。牛肉炖软后，捞出葱结和八角，撇去汤面的浮油。
steps.en: While the beef simmers, peel the daikon and cut it into chunks. Once the beef is tender, lift out the spring onions and star anise and skim the fat off the surface.

steps.zh: 放入萝卜块，再炖 20–25 分钟，到萝卜变得半透明、筷子一戳就透。
steps.en: Add the daikon and simmer for 20–25 minutes more, until it is translucent and soft enough for a chopstick to go straight through.

steps.zh: 加盐和白胡椒粉调味，撒上香菜段，连汤带肉盛出。
steps.en: Season with salt and white pepper, scatter with chopped coriander and serve the beef and daikon with plenty of their broth.

summary.zh: 白菜炖得软甜，豆腐吸饱了清鲜的汤汁，清淡家常，二十多分钟就能上桌。
summary.en: Sweet, tender Chinese cabbage and tofu simmered in a light, savoury broth — on the table in about 25 minutes.

note.en: about a quarter of a head

steps.zh: 白菜帮斜刀切片，菜叶切大块，分开放；豆腐切 1.5 厘米厚的片；姜切丝，葱切葱花，葱白和葱绿分开放。用粉丝的话，先用温水泡 10 分钟到变软；虾皮用清水冲一下，沥干。
steps.en: Slice the cabbage stems on the diagonal and cut the leaves into large pieces, keeping them apart; cut the tofu into 1.5 cm slices. Shred the ginger and chop the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts apart. If using the noodles, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes until soft; rinse the dried shrimp and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下姜丝、葱白和虾皮炒香，放白菜帮转大火翻炒 2 分钟，到边缘变软。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium heat and fry the ginger, white spring onion and dried shrimp until fragrant; add the cabbage stems, turn up the heat and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until they start to soften at the edges.

steps.zh: 加生抽，倒入热水烧开，放入豆腐片轻轻推匀，转中小火盖盖炖 5 分钟。
steps.en: Add the soy sauce and the hot water and bring to the boil; slide in the tofu, nudge it gently into the broth, then cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 放入菜叶和沥干的粉丝，再炖 3–4 分钟，到白菜软透、粉丝变透明，豆腐吸足汤汁。
steps.en: Add the cabbage leaves and the drained noodles and simmer for 3–4 minutes more, until the cabbage is soft, the noodles are clear and the tofu has soaked up the broth.

steps.zh: 尝一下再加盐（虾皮和生抽都有咸味），撒一点白胡椒粉和葱绿即可。
steps.en: Taste before adding salt, as the shrimp and soy sauce are already salty, then finish with a pinch of white pepper and the green spring onion.

summary.zh: 又叫金汤肥牛：黄灯笼辣椒酱煮出金黄酸辣的汤，肥牛片一烫就熟，配上金针菇，汤汁拌饭一绝。
summary.en: Also called golden-soup beef — hot-pot beef and enoki poached in a sour, gently hot broth turned gold by yellow lantern chilli sauce. Spoon the soup over rice.

note.zh: 火锅肥牛卷，冻的稍微解冻
note.en: hot-pot beef rolls; thaw frozen ones a little
soaked in warm water until soft

note.zh: 小米辣，切圈；想更辣就多放
note.en: bird's eye; sliced; more for extra heat
white vinegar; added at the end

steps.zh: 金针菇切掉根部、撕成小束洗净；粉丝（可不放）用温水泡软；蒜切末，野山椒和小米辣切碎，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Trim the root end off the enoki, pull it into small bunches and rinse; soak the glass noodles, if using, in warm water until soft. Mince the garlic, chop the pickled and fresh chillies and slice the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里烧开水，放入肥牛片，烫到刚变色（约 10 秒）就捞出沥干，这锅水倒掉。
steps.en: Bring a pot of water to the boil, drop in the beef and lift it out as soon as it changes colour, about 10 seconds; drain, and pour the water away.

steps.zh: 锅擦干，放油中小火炒香蒜末、野山椒和小米辣，加黄灯笼辣椒酱再炒 30 秒。
steps.en: Dry the pot, heat the oil over medium-low heat and fry the garlic and chillies until fragrant, then add the yellow lantern chilli sauce and fry for 30 seconds more.

steps.zh: 倒入 500 毫升水（或高汤），加糖和一点盐，大火烧开，下金针菇和粉丝煮 2–3 分钟，捞出铺在大碗底。
steps.en: Pour in 500 ml water (or stock), add the sugar and a little salt and bring to the boil. Cook the enoki and noodles for 2–3 minutes, then lift them into a deep serving bowl.

steps.zh: 汤再次烧开，放回肥牛片煮 10–20 秒到熟透、不见粉红，关火加白醋，尝一下再补盐，连汤倒进碗里，撒葱花。
steps.en: Bring the soup back to the boil and return the beef for 10–20 seconds, until cooked with no pink left. Turn off the heat, stir in the vinegar, taste and add salt if needed, then pour beef and soup over the enoki and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 整只肘子焯水后裹上冰糖糖色，小火慢炖两小时，皮糯肉烂，筷子一拨就离骨，请客的硬菜。
summary.en: A whole pork hock glazed in rock-sugar caramel and braised slowly for two hours, until the skin is sticky and the meat falls from the bone — a dish for company.

note.en: front hock; about 1 kg; skin on

steps.zh: 肘子表皮上残留的毛用火燎一下再刮洗干净（也可以请店家处理好）。冷水下锅，加 2 汤匙料酒和两片姜，烧开后煮 5 分钟，撇去浮沫，捞出用温水洗净，用厨房纸彻底擦干。
steps.en: Singe off any stray hairs over a flame and scrape the skin clean, or have the butcher do it. Put the hock in a pot of cold water with 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine and two slices of ginger, bring to the boil and boil for 5 minutes, skimming. Lift it out, rinse in warm water and pat completely dry.

steps.zh: 大锅里放油，小火放冰糖慢慢炒化，炒到枣红色、冒小泡（别炒过头发苦），放入肘子，用夹子翻动，让外皮均匀裹上糖色。肘子一定要擦干，不然热糖会溅出来。
steps.en: In a large pot, melt the rock sugar in the oil over low heat, stirring until it turns deep red-brown and bubbles; stop before it burns. Add the hock and turn it with tongs until the skin is coated all over. The hock must be dry, or the hot sugar will spit.

steps.zh: 加姜片、葱段、八角、桂皮、香叶和干辣椒，倒入剩下的料酒、生抽和老抽，加热水没过肘子，大火烧开。
steps.en: Add the ginger, spring onion, star anise, cinnamon, bay leaves and dried chillies, then the rest of the wine, the soy sauce and dark soy. Pour in hot water to cover and bring to the boil.

steps.zh: 转小火盖盖炖 2 小时，中途翻面一两次，汤少了就加热水，炖到筷子能轻松戳透外皮、肉开始离骨。用高压锅的话，上汽后压 40 分钟。
steps.en: Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours, turning it once or twice and topping up with hot water if needed, until a chopstick slides easily through the skin and the meat starts to come away from the bone. In a pressure cooker, 40 minutes at pressure.

steps.zh: 肘子盛到深盘里，捞出香料，汤汁开大火收到浓稠发亮，尝一下再加盐，浇在肘子上。
steps.en: Lift the hock onto a deep plate and fish out the spices. Boil the liquid hard until thick and glossy, taste and add salt if needed, then pour it over the hock.

name.en: Baby napa cabbage in superior broth

summary.zh: 蒜子煎香，和皮蛋、火腿一起煮出浓白的上汤，浇在娃娃菜上，清甜鲜美，饭店人气菜在家也好做。
summary.en: Golden garlic cloves, century egg and ham simmered into a rich, milky broth and poured over tender baby napa cabbage — a restaurant favourite that's easy at home.

note.zh: 鸡汤或高汤；也可用水加少许浓汤宝
note.en: chicken stock, or water with a little stock cube

steps.zh: 娃娃菜纵向切成四瓣，洗净沥干；皮蛋剥壳切小丁，午餐肉（或火腿）切小丁，枸杞用清水泡软。
steps.en: Quarter the cabbages lengthwise, rinse and drain. Peel and dice the century egg, dice the luncheon meat or ham and soak the goji berries in water.

steps.zh: 水烧开，放入娃娃菜焯 1–2 分钟到菜帮变软，捞出沥干，码在深盘里。
steps.en: Blanch the cabbage in boiling water for 1–2 minutes, until the stems are tender, then drain and arrange in a deep dish.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中小火把整瓣蒜煎到表面金黄，下午餐肉丁和一半皮蛋丁炒香。
steps.en: Heat the oil over medium-low heat and fry the whole garlic cloves until golden all over, then add the luncheon meat and half the century egg and stir until fragrant.

steps.zh: 倒入高汤，大火烧开后煮 3–4 分钟，到汤色变浓发白，加入剩下的皮蛋丁和枸杞，撒白胡椒。高汤本身有咸味，先尝再加盐。
steps.en: Pour in the stock, bring to the boil and boil for 3–4 minutes, until it turns rich and milky. Add the rest of the century egg and the goji berries and season with white pepper, tasting before you add salt — the stock is already salty.

steps.zh: 把滚烫的汤连同配料浇在娃娃菜上，马上上桌。
steps.en: Pour the boiling broth and everything in it over the cabbage and serve at once.

summary.zh: 北方过年少不了的炸丸子：肉馅打上劲，炸两遍，外酥里嫩，趁热蘸椒盐吃，也能留着烩菜、煮汤。
summary.en: The northern New Year favourite — pork mince beaten until springy and fried twice, crisp outside and juicy within. Eat them hot with pepper salt, or save some for soups and braises.

steps.zh: 肉馅里加葱姜末、盐、生抽、五香粉和白胡椒，顺着一个方向搅拌；60 毫升水分三四次加入，每次都搅到水被肉吃进去，一直搅到肉馅发黏、上劲。
steps.en: Mix the spring onion, ginger, salt, soy sauce, five-spice and white pepper into the pork, stirring in one direction. Add the 60 ml water in three or four goes, stirring until each is absorbed, and keep going until the mixture is sticky and springy.

steps.zh: 打入鸡蛋，加淀粉和面粉（可不放）继续搅匀，搅到肉馅能挂在筷子上不掉。
steps.en: Beat in the egg, then the cornflour and the flour, if using, and stir until the mixture clings to the chopsticks.

steps.zh: 锅里倒油约 4 厘米深，中火烧到约 150°C：插一根干的木筷子进去，周围冒出细密的小泡。手上抹点油，抓一把肉馅从虎口挤出核桃大小的丸子，用勺子刮下，贴着油面轻轻放进去。分批炸 4–5 分钟，到丸子浮起、定型、呈浅黄色，捞出。锅边不要有水，炸的时候别离开灶台。
steps.en: Heat oil about 4 cm deep in the wok over medium heat to about 150°C — fine bubbles should rise around a dry wooden chopstick. With oiled hands, squeeze the mixture up between thumb and forefinger into walnut-sized balls, scoop each off with a spoon and lower it gently into the oil. Fry in batches for 4–5 minutes, until they float, hold their shape and turn pale gold, then lift out. Keep water away from the oil and stay at the stove while frying.

steps.zh: 把油烧到约 180°C（丢一点肉馅进去马上浮起、剧烈冒泡），丸子全部倒回去复炸 1–2 分钟到金黄酥脆，捞出沥油。掰开一个看看，中间要熟透、不见粉红。
steps.en: Heat the oil to about 180°C — a scrap of the mixture should float up and sizzle hard at once — then refry all the meatballs for 1–2 minutes until deep golden and crisp, and drain. Break one open to check that it is cooked through, with no pink in the middle.

steps.zh: 花椒和一小撮盐放进干锅，小火焙到花椒出香味，压碎就是椒盐。丸子趁热蘸椒盐吃。用过的油放凉后再处理。
steps.en: For the dip, toast the Sichuan peppercorns with a pinch of salt in a dry pan over low heat until fragrant, then crush them. Eat the meatballs hot, dipped in the pepper salt. Let the oil cool completely before you deal with it.

summary.zh: 甜玉米粒配胡萝卜丁和青豆，出锅撒上焙香的松仁，黄红绿三色看着就喜庆，孩子最爱。
summary.en: Sweetcorn with diced carrot and peas, finished with toasted pine nuts — sweet, bright and a children's favourite.

note.zh: 冷冻或罐头的；也可以用 2 根玉米剥粒
note.en: frozen or tinned; or cut from 2 cobs

steps.zh: 松仁放进冷的干锅，小火不停翻炒 3–4 分钟到微微金黄、出香味，马上盛出放凉。松仁很容易炒焦，别走开。
steps.en: Put the pine nuts in a cold, dry wok and stir over low heat for 3–4 minutes until pale gold and fragrant, then tip them out at once to cool. They burn quickly, so stay with them.

steps.zh: 胡萝卜切小丁。水烧开，玉米粒、胡萝卜丁和青豆一起焯 1–2 分钟，捞出沥干；罐头玉米倒掉汁水就行，不用焯。
steps.en: Dice the carrot. Blanch the corn, carrot and peas together in boiling water for 1–2 minutes and drain well; tinned corn just needs draining.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下玉米、胡萝卜和青豆翻炒 2 分钟，加糖和盐炒匀；想要亮汁就淋入水淀粉翻匀。
steps.en: Heat the oil over medium heat and stir-fry the corn, carrot and peas for 2 minutes, then season with the sugar and salt. For a glossy finish, stir in the cornflour slurry.

steps.zh: 关火，倒入大部分松仁拌匀盛盘，剩下的撒在表面，吃起来更香脆。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, toss in most of the pine nuts and serve with the rest scattered on top, so they stay crunchy.

summary.zh: 用现成的冷冻蛋挞皮，调好蛋奶液送进烤箱，二十来分钟就烤出层层酥皮和焦糖斑点。
summary.en: Ready-made frozen tart shells filled with a simple custard and baked for about twenty minutes, until flaky and spotted with caramel.

steps.zh: 蛋挞皮从冷冻室取出，摆在烤盘上放 10 分钟稍微回软。烤箱预热到 220°C（热风模式 200°C）。
steps.en: Take the tart shells out of the freezer and set them on a baking tray for 10 minutes to soften slightly. Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).

steps.zh: 牛奶、淡奶油和糖放进碗里，搅拌 1–2 分钟到糖完全化开。
steps.en: Stir the milk, cream and sugar together for 1–2 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.zh: 蛋黄打散，倒入奶液和面粉（可不放）搅匀，用筛网过滤一两遍，烤出来更细滑。蛋白留着可以炒菜或做汤。
steps.en: Beat the yolks, whisk in the milk mixture and the flour, if using, then pour through a sieve once or twice for a silkier custard. Keep the whites for a stir-fry or a soup.

steps.zh: 蛋液倒进蛋挞皮约八分满，放进烤箱中层烤 20–25 分钟，到酥皮金黄、表面出现焦糖色斑点，轻轻晃动时中心已经凝固。
steps.en: Fill the shells about 80 % full and bake on the middle shelf for 20–25 minutes, until the pastry is golden, the tops are spotted with caramel and the centres are set with only a slight wobble.

steps.zh: 出炉后稍微放凉再吃，刚出炉的蛋液非常烫。
steps.en: Let them cool a little before eating — the custard is very hot straight from the oven.

summary.zh: 甜中带一点辣的奥尔良风味腌料抓匀腌好，进烤箱烤到外皮焦香、肉嫩多汁，在家就能做出快餐店的味道。
summary.en: Wings rubbed with the sweet, gently spiced Orleans-style marinade of Chinese fast-food chains and roasted until the skin is caramelised and the meat juicy.

steps.zh: 鸡翅洗净，用厨房纸擦干，两面各斜划两刀，方便入味。
steps.en: Rinse the wings, pat them dry and cut two diagonal slashes on each side so the marinade can soak in.

steps.zh: 蒜切末，和红椒粉、1 汤匙蜂蜜、生抽、料酒、黑胡椒、辣椒粉（可不放）和盐调匀，倒在鸡翅上抓匀，盖好放冰箱腌至少 30 分钟，有时间腌一夜更入味。用现成的奥尔良腌料的话，按包装上的用量加少许水抓匀，代替这些调料。
steps.en: Mince the garlic and mix it with the paprika, 1 tbsp of the honey, the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, pepper, chilli flakes, if using, and salt. Massage it into the wings, cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, or overnight for more flavour. With a ready-made Orleans marinade mix, use the amount on the packet and a splash of water instead of these seasonings.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。烤盘铺锡纸或烘焙纸，鸡翅皮朝上摆开，烤 15 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a tray with foil or baking paper, lay the wings on it skin side up and roast for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 剩下的 1 汤匙蜂蜜加 1 汤匙水调匀，刷在鸡翅两面，翻面烤 5 分钟，再翻回来刷一次，烤 5 分钟到表面红亮、边缘微焦。在最厚处切开检查，没有粉色、流出的汁是清的才算熟。
steps.en: Mix the remaining honey with 1 tbsp water and brush it over both sides. Turn the wings and roast for 5 minutes, then turn them back, brush again and roast for 5 minutes more, until glossy and charred at the edges. Cut into the thickest part to check — no pink and clear juices mean they are done.

summary.zh: 梅花肉用叉烧酱腌透，进烤箱边烤边刷蜜汁，肥瘦相间、甜香油亮，切片配米饭最好。
summary.en: Marbled pork shoulder marinated in char siu sauce and roasted with honey bastes until sticky, glossy and charred at the edges. Slice it over rice.

note.zh: 梅花肉（猪颈背肉）最好，切成约 3 厘米厚的长条
note.en: pork shoulder (collar) is best; in strips about 3 cm thick

steps.zh: 梅花肉切成约 3 厘米厚的长条，用叉子在表面多戳些小孔。
steps.en: Cut the pork into long strips about 3 cm thick and prick them all over with a fork.

steps.zh: 叉烧酱、1 汤匙蜂蜜、生抽、料酒和蒜末调匀，倒在肉上抓匀，盖好放冰箱腌至少 1 小时，有时间腌一夜更入味。
steps.en: Mix the char siu sauce with 1 tbsp of the honey, the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine and minced garlic. Massage it into the pork, cover and marinate in the fridge for at least an hour — overnight is better still.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。烤盘铺锡纸，倒入少许清水防止滴下的油冒烟，架上烤网，把肉条摆在烤网上，腌汁留着。烤 20 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a roasting tin with foil and pour in a little water so the drips don't smoke, then set a rack over it and lay the pork on the rack, keeping the marinade. Roast for 20 minutes.

steps.zh: 剩下的腌汁加 1 汤匙蜂蜜调匀，刷满肉条两面，翻面烤 10 分钟；再刷一次，烤 8–10 分钟到表面焦糖化、边缘微焦。切开最厚的一条，中心不见粉红、流出的汁是清的才算熟。
steps.en: Stir the remaining honey into the leftover marinade and brush it all over the pork. Turn and roast for 10 minutes, then brush again and roast for 8–10 minutes more, until caramelised and charred at the edges. Cut into the thickest strip — no pink in the centre and clear juices mean it's done.

steps.zh: 取出静置 5 分钟再切片。
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.

summary.zh: 整个红薯送进烤箱慢慢烤，烤到流出糖汁、皮肉分离，又甜又糯，什么都不用加。
summary.en: Whole kumara baked slowly until the sugars ooze out and the flesh is soft and sweet — it needs nothing else.

note.zh: 中等大小、粗细均匀，共约 500 克；红心的最甜
note.en: medium and evenly shaped, about 500 g in all; orange-fleshed ones are sweetest

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 210°C。红薯刷洗干净、擦干，不用去皮，用叉子在表面戳几个小孔。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 210°C. Scrub the kumara, dry them and leave the skin on, then prick each a few times with a fork.

steps.zh: 烤盘铺锡纸（烤的时候会流糖汁，方便清理），摆上红薯，放中层烤 50–60 分钟，中途翻一次面。
steps.en: Lay them on a foil-lined tray — the syrupy juices drip and burn on — and roast on the middle shelf for 50–60 minutes, turning once.

steps.zh: 用筷子能轻松插透、表皮微微起皱流糖就烤好了；细的熟得快，早点检查。小心烫手，掰开趁热吃。
steps.en: They're done when a chopstick slides through easily and the skin is wrinkled and oozing syrup; check thinner ones early. Mind your fingers — break them open and eat hot.

summary.zh: 金针菇铺在锡纸上，浇上蒜蓉酱汁包好进烤箱，十五分钟出炉，汤汁鲜香微辣，特别下饭。
summary.en: Enoki baked in a foil parcel with a garlicky soy sauce and a little chilli — fifteen minutes in the oven, and the juices are made for rice.

note.en: root end trimmed; pulled into small bunches

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。金针菇切掉根部、撕成小束，洗净沥干；蒜切末，小米辣切圈，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Trim the root end off the enoki, pull it into small bunches, rinse and drain. Mince the garlic and slice the chillies and the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，小火把一半蒜末炒到微黄，关火倒入另一半生蒜末，再加生抽、蚝油（可不放）、糖和 2 汤匙水拌匀成蒜蓉汁。
steps.en: Fry half the garlic gently in the oil until pale gold, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the raw garlic, the soy sauce, oyster sauce, if using, the sugar and 2 tbsp water.

steps.zh: 取一大张锡纸，四边折起成小盒，铺上金针菇，浇上蒜蓉汁，撒小米辣，再盖一张锡纸，把四边捏紧封好。
steps.en: Fold up the edges of a large sheet of foil to make a tray, pile in the enoki, spoon over the garlic sauce and scatter with chilli. Cover with a second sheet and crimp the edges to seal.

steps.zh: 放在烤盘上进烤箱中层烤 15 分钟。小心打开锡纸，别被热气烫到，撒上葱花即可。
steps.en: Bake on a tray on the middle shelf for 15 minutes. Open the parcel carefully — the steam is hot — and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 整根茄子烤到软烂，划开铺满蒜蓉再烤几分钟，撒上葱花，就是夜市烧烤摊的味道。
summary.en: Whole eggplants roasted until silky, split open, piled with garlic sauce and roasted again — the night-market barbecue favourite, from your oven.

note.zh: 长茄子；圆茄子用 1 个
note.en: long ones; or 1 large globe eggplant
chopped; or a pinch of chilli flakes

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 220°C。茄子洗净擦干，表面刷一层薄油，用叉子戳几个小孔防止烤的时候爆开，放在铺了锡纸的烤盘上。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 220°C. Wash and dry the eggplants, brush them with a thin coat of the oil and prick them a few times with a fork so they don't burst, then lay them on a foil-lined tray.

steps.zh: 烤 25–30 分钟，中途翻一次面，烤到茄子整个塌软、用筷子一戳就透。
steps.en: Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until they have collapsed and a chopstick slides in easily.

steps.zh: 烤茄子的同时，锅里放剩下的油，小火把大半蒜末炒到微黄，关火加入剩下的生蒜末、生抽、蚝油（可不放）、糖和 1 汤匙水拌匀。葱切葱花，辣椒切碎。
