steps.en: Meanwhile, gently fry most of the garlic in the rest of the oil until pale gold, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the remaining raw garlic, the soy sauce, oyster sauce, if using, the sugar and 1 tbsp water. Slice the spring onion and chop the chilli.

steps.zh: 茄子纵向划开（底部别切断），用筷子把茄肉划散，铺上蒜蓉汁，撒上辣椒和孜然（可不放），再烤 5 分钟，出炉撒葱花。
steps.en: Split the eggplants lengthwise without cutting through the base, loosen the flesh with chopsticks and spoon in the garlic sauce. Scatter with the chilli and the cumin, if using, roast for 5 minutes more and finish with spring onion.

summary.zh: 鸡腿肉、洋葱和彩椒用番茄酱炒饭，铺满马苏里拉芝士进烤箱，焗到金黄起泡、一挑就拉丝。
summary.en: Rice fried with chicken thigh, onion and capsicum in a tomato sauce, then blanketed with mozzarella and baked until golden, bubbling and stretchy.

note.zh: 煮好的米饭，隔夜饭也行

steps.zh: 烤箱预热到 200°C。鸡腿肉切小丁，加一小撮盐和黑胡椒抓匀；洋葱和彩椒切丁，米饭抓散。
steps.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dice the chicken and season it with a pinch of salt and pepper; dice the onion and capsicum and break up the rice.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火把鸡丁炒到变白、熟透，下洋葱炒软，再加彩椒和玉米粒炒 1 分钟。
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and stir-fry the chicken until white and cooked through, then add the onion and cook until soft. Add the capsicum and corn and stir-fry for a minute.

steps.zh: 加番茄酱炒匀，倒入米饭，翻炒到每粒米都裹上酱汁、整体热透，尝一下再加盐。
steps.en: Stir in the ketchup, then add the rice and toss until every grain is coated and hot right through. Taste and add salt.

steps.zh: 炒饭装进烤碗压平，铺满芝士碎，送入烤箱中上层烤 10–12 分钟，到芝士融化、表面金黄起泡。烤碗很烫，戴手套取出。
steps.en: Pack the rice into a baking dish, cover it with the cheese and bake on the upper-middle shelf for 10–12 minutes, until the cheese has melted and turned golden and bubbly. The dish will be very hot — use oven gloves.

summary.zh: 番茄炒出沙，煮成浓浓的酸甜汤底，肥牛片和金针菇下锅一烫就好，汤汁泡饭最香。
summary.en: Tomatoes cooked down into a thick sweet-and-sour broth, with hot-pot beef and enoki poached in it in seconds — best with the soup spooned over rice.

note.zh: 火锅肥牛卷，冻的稍微解冻
note.en: hot-pot beef rolls; thaw frozen ones a little

steps.zh: 番茄顶部划十字，放进开水里烫 1 分钟，捞出剥皮，切小块；金针菇去根撕散，蒜切末，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Score a cross in the top of each tomato, dip them in boiling water for a minute, then peel and dice them. Trim and separate the enoki, mince the garlic and slice the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里烧开水，放入肥牛片，烫到刚变色就捞出沥干，这锅水倒掉。
steps.en: Drop the beef into a pot of boiling water and lift it out as soon as it changes colour; drain, and pour the water away.

steps.zh: 锅擦干，放油中火炒香蒜末，下番茄翻炒 4–5 分钟，边炒边用铲子压，炒到出沙出汁，再加番茄酱和糖炒匀。
steps.en: Dry the pot, heat the oil over medium heat and fry the garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 4–5 minutes, pressing them with the spatula until they collapse into a thick sauce, then stir in the ketchup and sugar.

steps.zh: 倒入 500 毫升热水，烧开后转小火煮 5 分钟，下金针菇煮 2 分钟，加盐调味。
steps.en: Pour in 500 ml hot water, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the enoki for 2 minutes and season with salt.

steps.zh: 放回肥牛片，煮 10–20 秒到熟透、不见粉红就关火，连汤盛出，撒葱花。
steps.en: Return the beef for 10–20 seconds, until cooked with no pink left, then turn off the heat. Serve with all the soup, scattered with spring onion.

name.en: Ants climbing a tree (glass noodles with pork)

summary.zh: 粉丝吸饱豆瓣肉末的汤汁，肉末挂在粉丝上像蚂蚁爬树，咸香微辣，便宜又下饭。
summary.en: Glass noodles soak up a spicy bean-paste sauce full of pork mince, which clings to the strands like ants on branches — cheap, quick and great with rice.

note.en: about 100 g; soaked in warm water until soft

steps.zh: 粉丝用温水泡 10 分钟到软，捞出用剪刀剪几刀、沥干；蒜和姜切末，葱切葱花。
steps.en: Soak the glass noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until soft, snip them a few times with scissors and drain. Mince the garlic and ginger and slice the spring onion.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，中火下肉末炒散，炒到变色、微微出油，加料酒炒匀。
steps.en: Heat the oil in the wok over medium heat and stir-fry the pork, breaking it up, until it changes colour and starts to sizzle in its own fat; add the Shaoxing wine.

steps.zh: 下豆瓣酱、蒜末和姜末，转小火炒出红油和香味。
steps.en: Add the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger and fry over low heat until the oil turns red and fragrant.

steps.zh: 倒入 200 毫升水（或高汤），加生抽和老抽（上色，可不放）烧开，放入粉丝翻匀，中火煮 2–3 分钟，到粉丝把汤汁吸干。豆瓣酱已经很咸，尝过再决定要不要加盐。
steps.en: Pour in 200 ml water (or stock), add the soy sauce and the dark soy for colour, if using, and bring to the boil. Toss in the noodles and cook over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, until they have soaked up the liquid. The bean paste is salty, so taste before adding any salt.

steps.zh: 撒上葱花翻匀出锅。
steps.en: Toss through the spring onion and serve.

summary.zh: 银耳小火慢炖到出胶，再放雪梨和冰糖煮软，清甜顺滑，热着喝、冰着喝都好。
summary.en: White fungus simmered slowly until silky, then pear and rock sugar until soft — gently sweet, good warm or chilled.

note.en: a juicy pear such as nashi

steps.zh: 银耳用冷水泡 30 分钟到完全泡开，剪掉底部发黄的硬根，撕成小朵——撕得越碎，越容易炖出胶。
steps.en: Soak the white fungus in cold water for 30 minutes until fully swollen. Cut away the hard yellow base and tear it into small pieces — the smaller, the silkier the soup.

steps.zh: 银耳放进锅里，加 1.2 升水，大火烧开后转小火，盖上盖子留一条缝，炖 40 分钟，到汤开始变稠。
steps.en: Put the white fungus in a pot with 1.2 litres of water and bring to the boil, then cover with the lid ajar and simmer for 40 minutes, until the soup starts to thicken.

steps.zh: 雪梨去皮去核，切成小块，和冰糖一起放进锅里，再小火煮 20 分钟，到梨块变软、汤汁浓稠。
steps.en: Peel and core the pears, cut them into small chunks and add them with the rock sugar; simmer for another 20 minutes, until the pear is soft and the soup is thick.

steps.zh: 出锅前 5 分钟放枸杞（可不放）。尝一下甜度，趁热喝，或放凉后冷藏，冰着喝也好。
steps.en: Add the goji berries, if using, 5 minutes before the end. Taste for sweetness and serve warm, or let it cool and chill it.

tweaks.zh: 用高压锅更快：泡好的银耳加水压 20 分钟，再放梨和冰糖开盖煮 10 分钟。
tweaks.en: Quicker in a pressure cooker — cook the soaked fungus with the water for 20 minutes, then simmer uncovered with the pear and sugar for 10.

how.zh: 炖好放凉后冷藏，可放 2–3 天；吃的时候加热，或冰着吃。
how.en: Cooled and kept in the fridge it lasts 2–3 days; reheat it, or eat it chilled.

name.en: Red date, longan and goji soup

summary.zh: 红枣、桂圆和枸杞小火煮二十来分钟，果干自带的甜就够了，不用加糖，暖暖的一碗。
summary.en: Red dates, dried longan and goji berries simmered for about twenty minutes — sweet enough from the dried fruit alone, warm and simple.

steps.zh: 红枣洗净，用刀划几道口子，更容易煮出味道；桂圆肉和枸杞冲洗一下。
steps.en: Rinse the red dates and cut a few slits in each so they give up their flavour; rinse the longan and goji berries.

steps.zh: 红枣和桂圆放进锅里，加 1 升水，烧开后转小火煮 20 分钟。
steps.en: Put the dates and longan in a pot with 1 litre of water, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.zh: 放枸杞再煮 5 分钟。尝一下，想更甜可以加点红糖，煮化就好。
steps.en: Add the goji berries and simmer for 5 minutes more. Taste, and stir in a little brown sugar if you like it sweeter.

steps.zh: 连汤带料盛出。红枣有核，吃的时候小心。
steps.en: Serve the soup with the fruit. The dates have stones, so eat with care.

name.en: White fungus, lotus seed and lily bulb soup

summary.zh: 银耳炖到软糯出胶，莲子粉糯、百合清甜，冰糖调味，一碗稠稠的甜羹。
summary.en: White fungus simmered to a silky thickness with tender lotus seeds and lily bulb, lightly sweetened with rock sugar.

note.zh: 干百合；鲜百合用 1 个

steps.zh: 银耳用冷水泡 30 分钟，剪掉硬根，撕成小朵；莲子和干百合分别用清水泡 1 小时。莲子如果还带绿芯，要挑掉，不然会苦。
steps.en: Soak the white fungus in cold water for 30 minutes, cut away the hard base and tear it into small pieces. Soak the lotus seeds and dried lily bulb separately for 1 hour; pick out any green cores left in the lotus seeds, which taste bitter.

steps.zh: 银耳加 1.2 升水烧开，转小火，盖上盖子留一条缝，炖 30 分钟。
steps.en: Bring the white fungus to the boil in 1.2 litres of water, then cover with the lid ajar and simmer for 30 minutes.

steps.zh: 放莲子再炖 30 分钟，到莲子软糯；加百合和冰糖，再煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Add the lotus seeds and simmer for another 30 minutes, until tender; add the lily bulb and rock sugar and simmer for 10 minutes more.

steps.zh: 尝一下甜度，枸杞在最后 5 分钟放（可不放）。热着吃、冷藏后吃都好。
steps.en: Taste for sweetness, adding the goji berries for the last 5 minutes if you like. Serve warm, or chilled.

how.zh: 炖好放凉后冷藏，可放 2–3 天；吃的时候加热，或冰着吃。
how.en: Cooled and kept in the fridge it lasts 2–3 days; reheat it, or eat it chilled.

name.en: Red bean soup with tangerine peel

summary.zh: 红豆泡好后加一小块陈皮慢慢煮到起沙，红糖调甜，绵密里带一点果皮香，广式糖水铺的老味道。
summary.en: Soaked adzuki beans simmered with a piece of dried tangerine peel until they collapse into a creamy soup, sweetened with brown sugar — a Cantonese dessert-shop classic.

steps.zh: 红豆洗净，用清水泡 2 小时以上，泡一夜更好；陈皮用温水泡软，刮掉里面的白瓤，切成细丝。
steps.en: Rinse the beans and soak them in water for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Soften the tangerine peel in warm water, scrape off the white pith and cut it into thin strips.

steps.zh: 红豆和陈皮丝放进锅里，加 1.5 升水，大火烧开后转小火，盖上盖子留一条缝煮 1 小时，中间搅几次，水少了就加点开水。
steps.en: Put the beans and peel in a pot with 1.5 litres of water, bring to the boil, then cover with the lid ajar and simmer for 1 hour, stirring now and then and topping up with boiling water if it runs low.

steps.zh: 煮到红豆一压就烂，打开盖子再煮 15 分钟，一边搅一边用勺子压碎一部分红豆，让汤变得浓稠起沙。
steps.en: Once the beans crush easily, uncover and simmer for 15 minutes more, stirring and mashing some of the beans against the side of the pot until the soup turns thick and creamy.

steps.zh: 加红糖煮化，尝一下甜度。趁热吃，放凉后会更稠。
steps.en: Stir in the brown sugar until dissolved and taste for sweetness. Serve hot; it thickens as it cools.

tweaks.zh: 用高压锅不用泡豆：红豆、陈皮加水压 30 分钟，再开盖加红糖煮稠。
tweaks.en: In a pressure cooker there's no need to soak — cook the beans and peel with the water for 30 minutes, then simmer uncovered with the sugar until thick.

how.zh: 一次煮一锅，放凉后分装冷藏，可放 3 天；吃的时候加热，或冰着吃。
how.en: Cook a pot, cool it and keep it in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat it, or eat it chilled.

summary.zh: 绿豆煮到开花，放冰糖，夏天放凉了喝最舒服；盖着盖子煮，汤色更绿。
summary.en: Mung beans simmered until they burst, sweetened with rock sugar — best cooled on a summer day. Keep the lid on for a greener soup.

steps.zh: 绿豆淘洗干净，挑出坏豆和小石子。
steps.en: Rinse the mung beans and pick out any broken beans or grit.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1.5 升水烧开，下绿豆，盖上盖子大火煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Bring 1.5 litres of water to the boil, add the beans, cover and boil hard for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 转小火再煮 30 分钟，到绿豆开花，加冰糖煮化。
steps.en: Turn the heat down and simmer for 30 minutes more, until the beans burst, then stir in the rock sugar until it dissolves.

steps.zh: 只喝汤的舀清汤，喜欢沙的连豆一起吃；放凉后冷藏，冰着喝更爽口。
steps.en: Ladle off the clear soup on its own, or eat it with the beans; it's lovely cold from the fridge.

how.zh: 煮好放凉后冷藏，可放 2 天，盛出来就能喝；夏天冰着最舒服。
how.en: Cooled and kept in the fridge it lasts 2 days, ready to pour; best chilled in summer.

name.en: Sweet rice balls in jiuniang with osmanthus

summary.zh: 糯米粉搓成小圆子，和酒酿一起煮，淋一圈蛋花，撒点桂花，一刻钟就有一碗香甜的小圆子。
summary.en: Tiny glutinous rice balls cooked in sweet fermented rice, swirled with egg and finished with osmanthus — a sweet bowl in about a quarter of an hour.

note.zh: 约 70 毫升和面，其余煮
note.en: about 70 ml for the dough; the rest for cooking

steps.zh: 糯米粉里一点点加约 70 毫升温水，揉成不粘手的软面团，搓成细长条，切成黄豆大的小剂子，再搓圆（也可以直接买现成的小圆子）。
steps.en: Work about 70 ml of warm water a little at a time into the glutinous rice flour to make a soft dough that doesn't stick. Roll it into thin ropes, cut into pea-sized pieces and roll each into a ball — or use ready-made ones.

steps.zh: 锅里放约 600 毫升水烧开，下小圆子，煮到全部浮起后再煮 1 分钟。
steps.en: Bring about 600 ml of water to the boil, add the rice balls and cook until they all float, then 1 minute more.

steps.zh: 加酒酿煮开，转小火；鸡蛋打散，转着圈淋进锅里，等蛋花凝固（可不加蛋）。
steps.en: Stir in the jiuniang and bring back to the boil, then lower the heat. Beat the egg, if using, and pour it in a thin circle; leave it to set into ribbons.

steps.zh: 尝一下，不够甜加点糖；关火，撒上干桂花。酒酿煮过酒味很淡，但仍有少量酒精。
steps.en: Taste and add sugar if needed; turn off the heat and scatter over the osmanthus. Cooking softens the jiuniang's alcohol but doesn't remove it all.

summary.zh: 速冻黑芝麻汤圆煮到浮起就好，十分钟上桌；用姜和红糖煮汤底更暖更香。
summary.en: Frozen black sesame tangyuan, simmered until they float — on the table in ten minutes, and warmer still in a ginger and brown sugar broth.

steps.zh: 锅里放 800 毫升水烧开。想做姜糖水的，放姜片和红糖一起煮 5 分钟。
steps.en: Bring 800 ml of water to the boil. For a ginger broth, simmer the ginger slices and brown sugar in it for 5 minutes.

steps.zh: 下汤圆，用勺背轻轻推一推，防止粘锅底，中火煮到汤圆全部浮起来。
steps.en: Add the tangyuan and nudge them gently with the back of a spoon so they don't stick to the bottom; cook over medium heat until they all float.

steps.zh: 加小半碗冷水，再煮开一次，汤圆鼓起来、表皮变软就熟了。芝麻馅很烫，稍凉再吃。
steps.en: Add a splash of cold water and bring back to the boil; once the tangyuan puff up and the skins are soft, they're done. The filling is very hot, so let them cool a little.

summary.zh: 小西米煮到透明，冲掉黏液，泡进椰浆和牛奶里，温着喝顺滑，冰过更好吃。
summary.en: Small sago pearls cooked until clear, rinsed and steeped in coconut milk and milk — smooth served warm, even better chilled.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1 升水烧开，下西米，一边下一边搅，中火煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Bring 1 litre of water to the boil and pour in the sago, stirring as it goes in; cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 关火，盖上盖子焖 10 分钟，到西米只剩中间一点白芯，再开火煮 2–3 分钟，到完全透明。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, cover and leave for 10 minutes, until only a tiny white dot is left in each pearl, then boil for 2–3 minutes more until clear.

steps.zh: 西米倒进滤网，用凉水冲掉表面的黏液，沥干。
steps.en: Tip the sago into a sieve, rinse off the starch under cold water and drain.

steps.zh: 椰浆、牛奶和糖倒进锅里，小火加热到糖化开，别煮沸；关火放入西米。温着喝，或冷藏 1 小时冰着喝。
steps.en: Warm the coconut milk, milk and sugar over low heat until the sugar dissolves, without letting it boil; take off the heat and stir in the sago. Serve warm, or chill for an hour.

summary.zh: 热牛奶冲进新鲜姜汁里，静置几分钟就凝成嫩嫩的奶冻，姜香里带点微辣，广东的老派甜品。
summary.en: Hot sweetened milk poured over fresh ginger juice sets into a silky curd within minutes — gingery with a gentle heat, a classic Cantonese dessert.

note.en: about 60 g mature ginger; for the juice

steps.zh: 老姜去皮，磨成泥，用纱布或勺子挤出姜汁，每碗准备 1 汤匙，分别倒进两个碗里。
steps.en: Peel and finely grate the ginger, then squeeze out the juice through muslin or with a spoon; put 1 tablespoon of juice into each of two bowls.

steps.zh: 牛奶和糖放进锅里，小火加热，边加热边搅，到糖化开、锅边冒小泡（约 70–75°C）就关火，不要煮沸。
steps.en: Warm the milk and sugar over low heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves and small bubbles form at the edge (about 70–75°C); take it off the heat before it boils.

steps.zh: 等 1 分钟，从十几厘米高处把牛奶快速冲进姜汁碗里，冲完就别再动碗。
steps.en: Wait a minute, then pour the milk quickly into the ginger juice from about 15 cm above the bowl; don't move the bowls afterwards.

steps.zh: 盖上盖子静置 5–10 分钟，表面凝固、用勺子一碰像嫩豆花就好了，趁热吃。
steps.en: Cover and leave for 5–10 minutes, until the surface has set like soft tofu when touched with a spoon. Eat warm.

tweaks.zh: 没凝固多半是牛奶太烫或太凉，或者姜不够老；下次换老姜，牛奶温度控制在 70–80°C。
tweaks.en: If it doesn't set, the milk was too hot or too cool, or the ginger too young — next time use mature ginger and keep the milk at 70–80°C.

summary.zh: 红薯切块，和老姜、红糖一起煮软，甜里带一点姜的暖意，广东人家常的饭后糖水。
summary.en: Chunks of kumara simmered with ginger and brown sugar until tender — sweet with a gentle warmth, an everyday Cantonese after-dinner sweet soup.

steps.zh: 红薯去皮，切成滚刀块，先泡在清水里防止变色；姜洗净拍扁。
steps.en: Peel the kumara and cut it into chunky wedges, keeping them in cold water so they don't darken; smash the ginger.

steps.zh: 锅里放 1.2 升水和姜，烧开后放红薯，转中小火煮 15 分钟。
steps.en: Bring 1.2 litres of water to the boil with the ginger, add the kumara and simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 用筷子能轻松戳透红薯时，加红糖再煮 5 分钟。
steps.en: When a chopstick slides easily into the kumara, add the brown sugar and simmer for 5 minutes more.

steps.zh: 尝一下甜度，连汤带红薯盛出，趁热吃。
steps.en: Taste for sweetness and serve hot, kumara and syrup together.

summary.zh: 鸡腿肉去皮切块，和香菇一起腌好上锅蒸，不用起油锅，肉嫩汁多，汤汁拌饭正好。
summary.en: Skinless chicken thigh and shiitake, marinated and steamed — no frying, tender and juicy, with a savoury juice for the rice.

note.zh: 鲜香菇，或泡发的干香菇

steps.zh: 鸡腿肉去皮，切成小块，用厨房纸吸干；香菇去蒂，切成厚片；姜切丝。
steps.en: Skin the chicken, cut it into bite-sized pieces and pat dry; stem the shiitake and slice thickly; cut the ginger into fine strips.

steps.zh: 鸡块加生抽、蚝油、料酒、糖、姜丝和淀粉抓匀，最后拌入香油，腌 15 分钟。
steps.en: Mix the chicken with the soy sauce, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, ginger and starch, then stir in the sesame oil; marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.zh: 香菇铺在盘底，鸡块平铺在上面，别堆得太厚，这样熟得均匀。
steps.en: Spread the shiitake over a plate and lay the chicken on top in a single layer, so it cooks evenly.

steps.zh: 水开后放进蒸锅，大火蒸 12–15 分钟，到最大的一块切开不再发粉。撒上葱花，连汤汁一起上桌。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water on high for 12–15 minutes, until the largest piece is no longer pink inside. Scatter with spring onion and serve with the juices.

summary.zh: 鸡胸肉小火煮嫩，撕成细丝，和黄瓜丝一起拌上蒜香酱汁，清爽开胃。
summary.en: Gently poached chicken breast torn into shreds and tossed with cucumber in a garlicky, tangy dressing — fresh and appetising.

steps.zh: 一锅水烧开，放入鸡胸肉、姜片和料酒，再开后转最小火煮 8 分钟，关火盖盖焖 5 分钟，到最厚的地方切开不再发粉。
steps.en: Bring a pan of water to the boil, add the chicken, ginger and Shaoxing wine, return to the boil, then poach on the lowest heat for 8 minutes; turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, until the thickest part is no longer pink when cut.

steps.zh: 鸡胸肉捞出泡进凉开水里降温，这样更嫩；凉了以后顺着纹理撕成细丝。
steps.en: Lift the chicken into cooled boiled water to cool, which keeps it tender, then tear it into fine shreds along the grain.

steps.zh: 黄瓜切细丝铺在盘底；蒜捣成泥，加生抽、醋、糖和香油调成汁，喜欢辣的加红油。
steps.en: Cut the cucumber into fine strips and spread them on a plate. Crush the garlic and mix it with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil; add chilli oil if you like heat.

steps.zh: 鸡丝放在黄瓜丝上，淋上调料汁，撒香菜和芝麻，吃之前拌匀。
steps.en: Pile the chicken on the cucumber, pour over the dressing and scatter with coriander and sesame seeds; toss before eating.

summary.zh: 嫩豆腐上铺虾仁，大火蒸八分钟，淋一圈豉油，又嫩又鲜，几乎不用油。
summary.en: Silken tofu topped with prawns, steamed for eight minutes and dressed with soy — soft, sweet and made with hardly any oil.

note.en: or seasoned soy sauce for fish

steps.zh: 嫩豆腐倒扣在盘里，切成厚片或小方块，倒掉渗出的水。
steps.en: Turn the silken tofu out onto a plate, cut it into thick slices or cubes and pour off any water.

steps.zh: 虾仁去虾线，加切碎的姜、料酒、一小撮盐、白胡椒和淀粉抓匀，铺在豆腐上。
steps.en: Devein the prawns and mix them with the chopped ginger, Shaoxing wine, a pinch of salt, the white pepper and the starch; arrange them on the tofu.

steps.zh: 水开后放进蒸锅，大火蒸 8 分钟，到虾仁变红卷起；倒掉盘里多余的水。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water on high for 8 minutes, until the prawns are pink and curled; pour off the excess water.

steps.zh: 生抽加 1 汤匙热水调匀，淋在豆腐周围，撒葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce with 1 tbsp hot water and pour it around the tofu; scatter with spring onion and add a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 番茄炒出沙熬成酸甜的汤底，滑进嫩鱼片，一锅有汤有肉，配米饭就是一顿。
summary.en: Tomatoes cooked down into a sweet-sour broth with silky slices of white fish — soup and protein in one pot, a meal with a bowl of rice.

note.zh: 龙利鱼或巴沙鱼，斜切薄片
note.en: basa, hoki or another white fish, thinly sliced

steps.zh: 鱼片用厨房纸吸干，加少许盐、白胡椒、料酒和淀粉抓匀，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Pat the fish dry and mix it with a little salt, the white pepper, Shaoxing wine and starch; leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 番茄顶上划十字，用开水烫一下去皮，切小块。
steps.en: Score a cross in the top of each tomato, dip them in boiling water, peel and cut into small pieces.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，下姜片炒香，放番茄中小火炒 3–4 分钟，到番茄软烂出汁；想要汤色更红的加番茄酱炒匀。
steps.en: Heat the oil, fry the ginger until fragrant, then cook the tomatoes over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until soft and juicy; stir in the tomato paste for a deeper colour.

steps.zh: 加 700 毫升水烧开，煮 3 分钟，加盐调味。
steps.en: Add 700 ml of water, bring to the boil, simmer for 3 minutes and season with salt.

steps.zh: 转小火，鱼片一片片放进去，先别搅动，1–2 分钟鱼片变白就关火，撒葱花或香菜。
steps.en: Lower the heat and slide in the fish a slice at a time without stirring; once it turns white, after 1–2 minutes, turn off the heat and scatter with spring onion or coriander.

summary.zh: 冬瓜煮到透明软糯，下虾仁一滚就好，汤清味鲜，十五分钟上桌。
summary.en: Winter melon simmered until translucent, with prawns added at the last moment — a clear, delicate soup in fifteen minutes.

steps.zh: 冬瓜切 5 毫米厚的片；虾仁去虾线，加料酒和少许白胡椒抓一下。
steps.en: Cut the winter melon into 5 mm slices. Devein the prawns and toss them with the Shaoxing wine and a little white pepper.

steps.zh: 锅里放 700 毫升水和姜片，喜欢更鲜的加一小把虾皮，烧开后放冬瓜，中火煮 8–10 分钟，到冬瓜变透明、筷子能轻松戳透。
steps.en: Bring 700 ml of water to the boil with the ginger (and the dried shrimp for more flavour), add the winter melon and simmer over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, until translucent and tender.

steps.zh: 放虾仁，煮 1–2 分钟到虾仁变红卷起，加盐和白胡椒调味。
steps.en: Add the prawns and cook for 1–2 minutes until pink and curled; season with salt and white pepper.

steps.zh: 关火，撒葱花，滴几滴香油。
steps.en: Turn off the heat, scatter with spring onion and add a few drops of sesame oil.

summary.zh: 茄子不过油，蒸软后撕成条，淋上蒜泥酱汁，软糯入味。
summary.en: Eggplant steamed instead of fried, torn into strips and dressed with raw garlic and soy — soft and full of flavour.

steps.zh: 茄子洗净，切成手指粗的长条，不用去皮；切好马上上锅，免得变黑。
steps.en: Wash the eggplant and cut it into finger-thick batons, skin on; steam them straight away so they don't darken.

steps.zh: 水开后大火蒸 10–12 分钟，到筷子能轻松戳透。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water on high for 10–12 minutes, until a chopstick slides through easily.

steps.zh: 蒸茄子的时候调汁：蒜捣成泥，加生抽、醋、糖、香油和 1 汤匙凉开水调匀；喜欢辣的加切碎的辣椒。
steps.en: While it steams, crush the garlic and mix it with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and 1 tbsp cooled boiled water for the dressing; add chopped chilli if you like heat.

steps.zh: 倒掉盘里蒸出的水，茄子稍凉后撕成粗条，淋上蒜汁，撒葱花或香菜。
steps.en: Pour off the liquid, let the eggplant cool a little and tear it into thick strips; spoon over the dressing and scatter with spring onion or coriander.

summary.zh: 魔芋丝焯水去掉碱味，和黄瓜丝一起拌蒜香酸汁，爽滑弹牙，夏天很开胃。
summary.en: Konjac noodles blanched to remove their alkaline taste, tossed with cucumber in a tangy dressing — springy, refreshing summer fare.

note.zh: 现成的魔芋丝或魔芋结

steps.zh: 魔芋丝倒出，用清水冲洗几遍，放进开水里煮 2–3 分钟去掉碱味，捞出过凉水，沥干。
steps.en: Rinse the konjac noodles well, boil them for 2–3 minutes to remove the alkaline taste, then cool under cold water and drain.

steps.zh: 黄瓜切细丝，胡萝卜也切细丝；蒜捣成泥，香菜切段。
steps.en: Cut the cucumber, and the carrot if using, into fine strips; crush the garlic and chop the coriander.

steps.zh: 蒜泥加生抽、醋、糖和香油调匀，喜欢辣的加红油；尝一下，不够咸加点盐。
steps.en: Mix the garlic with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil, adding chilli oil if you like heat; taste and add salt if needed.

steps.zh: 魔芋丝和蔬菜丝放进大碗，淋上调料汁拌匀，撒香菜和芝麻；冷藏 10 分钟更入味。
steps.en: Toss the konjac and vegetables with the dressing in a large bowl and scatter with coriander and sesame seeds; ten minutes in the fridge lets the flavours soak in.

summary.zh: 鸡胸肉片薄煎香，配生菜、番茄、黄瓜和牛油果，淋柠檬油醋汁，一盘就有肉有菜。
summary.en: Thin, golden chicken breast on lettuce, tomato, cucumber and avocado with a lemon dressing — protein and greens on one plate.

note.zh: 罗马生菜或混合沙拉叶

note.en: 1 tsp for the pan; the rest for the dressing

steps.zh: 鸡胸肉横着片成两片，用刀背拍松到厚薄均匀，抹少许盐、黑胡椒和香草碎，放 10 分钟。
steps.en: Halve the chicken horizontally and flatten it with the back of a knife to an even thickness; season with a little salt, pepper and the dried herbs and leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 平底锅烧热，刷 1 茶匙橄榄油，鸡胸肉中火每面煎 3–4 分钟，到中间不再发粉；出锅静置 5 分钟再切片。
steps.en: Heat a pan, brush it with 1 tsp of the olive oil and cook the chicken over medium heat for 3–4 minutes a side, until no longer pink in the middle; rest for 5 minutes, then slice.

steps.zh: 生菜洗净沥干，撕成小片；番茄、黄瓜切块，牛油果切片。想加鸡蛋的，水开后煮 8 分钟，过凉剥壳切开。
steps.en: Wash, dry and tear the lettuce; cut the tomato and cucumber into chunks and slice the avocado. For eggs, boil them for 8 minutes, cool, peel and halve.

steps.zh: 剩下的橄榄油加柠檬汁、蜂蜜、少许盐和黑胡椒，搅匀成油醋汁。
steps.en: Whisk the rest of the olive oil with the lemon juice, honey and a little salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 蔬菜装盘，铺上鸡胸肉片，喜欢的话加鸡蛋和玉米粒，吃之前淋上油醋汁。
steps.en: Arrange the vegetables on plates and top with the chicken, plus the eggs and corn if you like; dress just before eating.

summary.zh: 荞麦面煮好冰镇，蘸着日式面汁吃，配溏心蛋和黄瓜丝，爽口不腻。
summary.en: Chilled soba dipped in mentsuyu, the savoury Japanese noodle sauce, with a soft-boiled egg and cucumber — cool, clean and satisfying.

note.zh: 浓缩的，按瓶上比例兑水
note.en: concentrated; dilute as the bottle says
cooled boiled water for the dipping sauce

steps.zh: 鸡蛋放进开水煮 6–7 分钟，捞出泡冷水，剥壳切半，就是溏心蛋。
steps.en: Boil the eggs for 6–7 minutes for soft yolks, cool them in cold water, peel and halve.

steps.zh: 大锅水烧开，下荞麦面，按包装时间煮（一般 4–5 分钟），中途水滚起来时加一小碗冷水。
steps.en: Cook the soba in plenty of boiling water for the time on the packet, usually 4–5 minutes, adding a splash of cold water when it foams up.

steps.zh: 面捞出，在冷水下边冲边轻轻搓掉表面的淀粉，再泡一下冰水，沥干装盘。
steps.en: Drain, rinse under cold water while rubbing gently to wash off the starch, then dip in iced water and drain well.

steps.zh: 面汁按瓶上的比例兑凉开水，分到小碗里；葱切细葱花，黄瓜切丝，白萝卜磨泥。
steps.en: Dilute the mentsuyu with the cooled water as the bottle says and divide it between small bowls; finely slice the spring onion, cut the cucumber into strips and grate the daikon.

steps.zh: 面上撒海苔丝和芝麻，旁边放黄瓜丝和溏心蛋。葱花和萝卜泥放进蘸汁，夹一口面蘸着吃。
steps.en: Top the noodles with the nori and sesame seeds and serve the cucumber and egg alongside. Stir the spring onion and daikon into the sauce and dip each mouthful.

name.en: Quinoa bowl with egg and broccoli

summary.zh: 粒粒分明的藜麦配西兰花、溏心蛋和牛油果，淋柠檬汁，一碗有主食、有蛋、有菜。
summary.en: Fluffy quinoa with broccoli, a soft-boiled egg and avocado under a squeeze of lemon — grain, protein and greens in one bowl.

steps.zh: 藜麦放进细网筛，用清水搓洗几遍，冲掉表面带苦味的皂苷。
steps.en: Rinse the quinoa in a fine sieve, rubbing it under running water to wash off the bitter coating.

steps.zh: 藜麦加 300 毫升水和一小撮盐煮开，盖上盖子转小火煮 15 分钟，到水分收干、藜麦冒出白色的小尾巴；关火焖 5 分钟，用叉子拨松。
steps.en: Bring the quinoa to the boil with 300 ml of water and a pinch of salt, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed and the little white tails show; rest off the heat for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

steps.zh: 同时另一锅水烧开，西兰花焯 2 分钟捞出；鸡蛋放进开水煮 7 分钟是溏心，9 分钟全熟，过冷水剥壳切半。
steps.en: Meanwhile, blanch the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 2 minutes and lift it out; boil the eggs for 7 minutes for soft yolks or 9 for firm, then cool, peel and halve.

steps.zh: 橄榄油加柠檬汁、少许盐和黑胡椒搅匀。
steps.en: Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice, a little salt and black pepper.

steps.zh: 藜麦分到碗里，摆上西兰花、鸡蛋，喜欢的话加番茄、玉米粒和牛油果片，淋上酱汁。
steps.en: Divide the quinoa between bowls and top with the broccoli and eggs, plus tomato, corn and sliced avocado if you like; spoon over the dressing.

summary.zh: 牛腱子和香料、酱料一起小火卤透，再在卤汁里泡一夜，冷藏后切片就能吃，下饭、配粥、当早餐都合适。
summary.en: Beef shank simmered slowly with spices and soy, then left in its liquid overnight — sliced cold from the fridge for lunch, dinner or breakfast.

steps.zh: 牛腱子冷水泡 30 分钟泡出血水，冷水下锅，加一半料酒和两片姜，煮开后撇去浮沫，再煮 3 分钟，捞出用温水洗净。
steps.en: Soak the shank in cold water for 30 minutes, then put it in a pot of cold water with half the Shaoxing wine and two slices of ginger; bring to the boil, skim, boil for 3 minutes, then lift out and rinse in warm water.

steps.zh: 锅里放约 2 升水，加黄豆酱、生抽、老抽、剩下的料酒、冰糖、盐、姜、葱和所有香料，搅匀烧开。
steps.en: Bring about 2 litres of water to the boil with the soybean paste, both soy sauces, the rest of the wine, the rock sugar, salt, ginger, spring onions and all the spices.

steps.zh: 放入牛腱子，水要没过肉，转小火盖盖炖 2–2.5 小时，中途翻一两次，到筷子能轻松扎透。
steps.en: Add the shank, covered by the liquid, and simmer gently with the lid on for 2–2½ hours, turning once or twice, until a chopstick goes in easily.

steps.zh: 关火，让牛肉留在卤汁里自然放凉，再连汤放进冰箱泡一夜，这样更入味，凉了也好切。
steps.en: Turn off the heat and let the beef cool in its liquid, then refrigerate it overnight in the liquid; it takes on more flavour and slices neatly when cold.

steps.zh: 吃的时候取出一块，逆着纹理切薄片，淋一点卤汁；喜欢的话配蒜泥、香醋或辣椒油。
steps.en: To serve, take out a piece, slice it thinly across the grain and spoon over a little of the liquid; add crushed garlic, vinegar or chilli oil if you like.

tweaks.zh: 卤汁可以留着，烧开后冷冻，下次卤肉或卤蛋时再用。
tweaks.en: Keep the braising liquid — boiled and frozen, it starts the next batch of braised beef or eggs.

how.zh: 连卤汁冷藏可放 3–4 天，吃的时候切片，淋点卤汁就好。
how.en: Kept in its liquid in the fridge it lasts 3–4 days; slice it and spoon over a little of the liquid.

summary.zh: 熟透的西红柿切块撒白糖，放几分钟出沙出汁，酸甜冰凉，夏天的老味道。
summary.en: Ripe tomatoes cut into wedges and sprinkled with sugar until they release their juice — sweet, tart and cool, a summer classic.

steps.zh: 西红柿洗净，去掉蒂，切成月牙块或厚片，码在盘子里。
steps.en: Wash and core the tomatoes, cut them into wedges or thick slices and arrange them on a plate.

steps.zh: 均匀撒上白糖，放 5–10 分钟，等糖化开、西红柿出汁；冰箱里冷藏 20 分钟更好吃。
steps.en: Sprinkle evenly with the sugar and leave for 5–10 minutes, until it dissolves into the juices; 20 minutes in the fridge makes it even better.

tweaks.zh: 怕太甜就少放糖，西红柿越熟，需要的糖越少。
tweaks.en: Use less sugar if you like; the riper the tomatoes, the less they need.

name.en: Steamed fish head with chopped chillies

summary.zh: 湘菜经典：大鱼头铺满红亮的剁辣椒大火蒸熟，淋热油激香，鲜辣嫩滑，剩下的汤汁拌面一绝。
summary.en: A Hunan classic — a big fish head steamed under a blanket of chopped salted chillies and finished with sizzling oil; save the juices for the noodles.

note.zh: 约 1 千克的胖头鱼头，让鱼摊从中间劈开
note.en: about 1 kg, bighead carp; ask the fishmonger to split it
or seasoned soy sauce for fish
to toss in the juices at the end

steps.zh: 鱼头洗净，去掉鱼鳃和黑膜，从中间劈开、不切断，摊平放在盘里；抹上料酒和少许盐，腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Clean the fish head, removing the gills and any dark membrane, split it without cutting through and open it flat on a plate; rub with the wine and a little salt and leave for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 姜切几片垫在鱼头下面，其余切末；蒜切末，葱切葱花；倒掉腌出的水。
steps.en: Tuck a few slices of ginger under the fish and mince the rest; mince the garlic, chop the spring onion and pour off any liquid.

steps.zh: 剁辣椒拌上一半姜蒜末，厚厚地铺满鱼头。
steps.en: Mix the chopped chillies with half the ginger and garlic and spread them thickly over the fish.

steps.zh: 水开后大火蒸 12–15 分钟，到鱼眼发白凸出、鱼肉能轻松拨开。
steps.en: Steam over boiling water on high for 12–15 minutes, until the eyes turn white and the flesh flakes easily.

steps.zh: 撒上剩下的姜蒜末和葱花，喜欢的话淋点蒸鱼豉油；油烧到冒烟，浇在上面激香。
steps.en: Scatter over the rest of the ginger, garlic and the spring onion, add the soy sauce if you like, then heat the oil until smoking and pour it over so it sizzles.

steps.zh: 想吃拌面的，面条煮好拌进盘底的汤汁里。
steps.en: For the noodles, cook them and toss them in the juices left in the dish.

tweaks.zh: 怕太辣可以一半剁辣椒、一半黄灯笼辣椒酱，颜色红黄更好看。
tweaks.en: For less heat, use half chopped chillies and half yellow chilli sauce — milder, and red and gold on the plate.

summary.zh: 吐司夹上火腿、芝士、生菜和番茄，十分钟就好，快手早餐或一顿简单的午饭。
summary.en: Toast layered with ham, cheese, lettuce and tomato — ready in ten minutes, for a quick breakfast or an easy lunch.

steps.zh: 吐司放进烤面包机烤一下，或平底锅小火每面烘 1 分钟到微黄；不烤也可以。
steps.en: Toast the bread, or warm it in a dry pan for a minute a side until lightly golden — or leave it soft.

steps.zh: 番茄切薄片，生菜洗净擦干。
steps.en: Slice the tomato thinly; wash and dry the lettuce.

steps.zh: 两片吐司抹上薄薄一层黄油或蛋黄酱，依次铺生菜、火腿、芝士和番茄，撒点黑胡椒，盖上另一片吐司。
steps.en: Spread two slices thinly with butter or mayonnaise, layer the lettuce, ham, cheese and tomato, grind over a little pepper and top with the other slices.

steps.zh: 轻轻压一压，沿对角线切开就能吃；要带走的话用油纸包紧。
steps.en: Press down gently and cut on the diagonal; wrap tightly in baking paper to take away.

summary.zh: 煮鸡蛋压碎拌上蛋黄酱和黄瓜丁，满满夹进吐司，绵密清爽，早餐带着走也方便。
summary.en: Boiled eggs mashed with mayonnaise and diced cucumber, piled into soft bread — creamy and fresh, and easy to take with you.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋冷水下锅，水开后煮 9 分钟，捞出泡冷水，剥壳。
steps.en: Put the eggs in cold water, bring to the boil and cook for 9 minutes, then cool them in cold water and peel.

steps.zh: 黄瓜切小丁，用厨房纸吸干水分。
steps.en: Dice the cucumber finely and pat it dry.

steps.zh: 鸡蛋用叉子压碎，加蛋黄酱、黄瓜丁、少许盐和黑胡椒拌匀。
steps.en: Mash the eggs with a fork and mix in the mayonnaise, cucumber and a little salt and pepper.

steps.zh: 吐司上铺一片生菜，厚厚抹上鸡蛋沙拉，盖上另一片，切开即可。
steps.en: Lay a lettuce leaf on two slices of bread, spread the egg salad thickly, top with the other slices and cut in half.

summary.zh: 煎香的鸡胸肉条和生菜、番茄、黄瓜一起卷进卷饼皮，淋酸奶酱，拿着就能吃。
summary.en: Seared chicken breast strips rolled up in a tortilla with lettuce, tomato and cucumber and a yoghurt dressing — a meal you can hold.

note.zh: 无糖原味，也可以用蛋黄酱

steps.zh: 鸡胸肉片成两片，抹少许盐、黑胡椒和香草碎；平底锅刷橄榄油，中火每面煎 3–4 分钟到熟透，放 3 分钟后切条。
steps.en: Season the halved chicken with a little salt, pepper and the herbs; cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 3–4 minutes a side until cooked through, rest 3 minutes, then cut into strips.

steps.zh: 番茄、黄瓜切条，生菜洗净擦干；酸奶加一点柠檬汁、盐和黑胡椒调成酱。
steps.en: Cut the tomato and cucumber into strips and dry the lettuce; stir a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper into the yoghurt.

steps.zh: 卷饼皮放进干锅每面热 20 秒，变软更好卷。
steps.en: Warm each tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side so it rolls without cracking.

steps.zh: 饼皮中间铺生菜、蔬菜条、玉米粒和鸡肉，淋酱，先折起底边，再从一侧卷紧；用油纸包住下半截，拿着吃。
steps.en: Lay the lettuce, vegetables, corn and chicken down the middle, add the dressing, fold up the bottom and roll tightly from one side; wrap the lower half in baking paper to eat in hand.

summary.zh: 卷饼皮里铺上火腿、芝士、生菜和胡萝卜丝、黄瓜丝，一卷就好，十分钟的快手早餐。
summary.en: A tortilla rolled around ham, cheese, lettuce and shredded carrot and cucumber — a ten-minute breakfast.

steps.zh: 胡萝卜、黄瓜切细丝，生菜洗净擦干。
steps.en: Cut the carrot and cucumber into fine strips; wash and dry the lettuce.

steps.zh: 卷饼皮放进干锅每面热 20 秒，变软更好卷。
steps.en: Warm each tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side so it rolls without cracking.

steps.zh: 饼皮上薄薄抹一层蛋黄酱，铺生菜、火腿、芝士和蔬菜丝，撒点黑胡椒。
steps.en: Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise, then lay on the lettuce, ham, cheese and vegetables and grind over a little pepper.

steps.zh: 先折起底边，再从一侧卷紧，斜着切开；带走的话用油纸包住。
steps.en: Fold up the bottom, roll tightly from one side and cut on the diagonal; wrap in baking paper to take away.

summary.zh: 川味凉菜：鸡腿小火浸熟、冰水一激，皮爽肉嫩，淋上麻辣红油汁和花生碎，可以提前做好冷藏。
summary.en: A Sichuan cold dish — chicken legs gently poached and chilled in iced water, then dressed with numbing chilli oil and crushed peanuts. Make it ahead and keep it chilled.

steps.zh: 一锅水烧开，放姜片、葱段和料酒，下鸡腿，再开后转最小火盖盖浸 15 分钟，关火再焖 10 分钟，到最厚处扎下去不再流红水。
steps.en: Bring a pot of water to the boil with the ginger, spring onion and wine, add the chicken, return to the boil, then poach covered on the lowest heat for 15 minutes; turn off the heat and leave 10 minutes more, until the juices run clear at the thickest part.

steps.zh: 鸡腿捞出马上泡进冰水里 10 分钟，皮会变得爽脆。
steps.en: Lift the chicken straight into iced water for 10 minutes, which firms up the skin.

steps.zh: 蒜捣成泥，加红油、生抽、醋、糖、花椒粉和 2 汤匙煮鸡的汤调成汁。
steps.en: Crush the garlic and mix it with the chilli oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, ground Sichuan pepper and 2 tbsp of the poaching liquid.

steps.zh: 鸡腿去骨（也可不去），斩成小块摆盘，淋上调料汁，撒芝麻、花生碎和香菜。
steps.en: Bone the chicken if you like, chop it into pieces and arrange on a plate; pour over the sauce and scatter with sesame seeds, peanuts and coriander.

how.zh: 浸熟冰镇后的鸡腿冷藏可放 2 天，吃的时候斩块淋汁；调料汁现调最香。
how.en: Poached and chilled, the chicken keeps 2 days in the fridge; chop it and dress it to serve, with the sauce freshly mixed.

name.en: Steamed pork belly with preserved greens

summary.zh: 客家名菜：五花肉煮过、上色、切片，铺在梅干菜上蒸到软糯，倒扣在盘里，肥而不腻，可以提前蒸好。
summary.en: A Hakka favourite — pork belly boiled, browned and sliced, then steamed over preserved mustard greens until meltingly soft and turned out onto a plate. It reheats beautifully.

note.en: one piece with the skin on
soaked until soft and rinsed well

steps.zh: 梅干菜泡软，多洗几遍去掉沙子，挤干切碎。
steps.en: Soak the preserved greens until soft, rinse several times to remove any grit, squeeze dry and chop.

steps.zh: 五花肉整块冷水下锅，加姜片、葱段和一半料酒，煮 20 分钟到筷子能扎透，捞出擦干，趁热在肉皮上抹一层老抽。
steps.en: Put the pork in cold water with the ginger, spring onion and half the wine, boil for 20 minutes until a chopstick goes through, lift out, pat dry and brush the skin with some of the dark soy while hot.

steps.zh: 锅里放油，肉皮朝下中小火煎到起皱上色（小心溅油，可以盖锅盖），捞出放凉。
steps.en: Fry the pork skin side down in the oil over medium-low heat until blistered and browned — cover against spatters — then let it cool.

steps.zh: 肉切 5 毫米厚的大片，用剩下的老抽、生抽、料酒和冰糖拌匀，肉皮朝下整齐码在碗里。
steps.en: Cut the pork into 5 mm slices, toss with the rest of the soy sauces, wine and rock sugar, and lay them skin side down in a heatproof bowl.

steps.zh: 锅里放少许油，下梅干菜和剩下的酱汁炒香，铺在肉上压实。
steps.en: Stir-fry the greens in a little oil with the leftover sauce until fragrant and press them firmly over the pork.

steps.zh: 水开后中火蒸 1.5–2 小时，到肉软糯。滗出汤汁，碗上扣一个盘子翻过来；汤汁可以加点淀粉水勾薄芡，淋在肉上。
steps.en: Steam over medium heat for 1½–2 hours until meltingly tender. Pour off the juices, put a plate over the bowl and turn it out; thicken the juices with a little starch slurry if you like and pour them over.

how.zh: 蒸好后连碗冷藏可放 3 天，吃的时候再蒸 20 分钟热透，扣出来就能上桌。
how.en: Steamed and kept in its bowl in the fridge, it lasts 3 days; steam it again for 20 minutes until hot through and turn it out.

summary.zh: 排骨焯水后炒糖色，加酱油和香料小火焖到软烂，收汁后红亮入味，最下饭的家常菜之一。
summary.en: Pork ribs blanched, caramelised and simmered with soy and spices until tender, then reduced to a glossy glaze — a rice-loving home classic.

note.en: spare ribs; cut into short lengths

steps.zh: 排骨冷水下锅，加一半料酒，煮开后撇去浮沫，再煮 2 分钟，捞出用温水洗净沥干。
steps.en: Put the ribs in cold water with half the wine, bring to the boil, skim and boil 2 minutes more, then rinse in warm water and drain.

steps.zh: 锅里放油和冰糖，小火慢慢炒到糖化开、变成枣红色冒小泡。
steps.en: Melt the rock sugar in the oil over low heat, stirring, until it turns a deep amber and bubbles.

steps.zh: 马上倒入排骨翻炒上色，加姜片、葱段、八角、香叶和干辣椒炒香，沿锅边淋入剩下的料酒、生抽和老抽。
steps.en: Add the ribs at once and toss to coat, then the ginger, spring onion, star anise, bay leaves and chillies; pour the rest of the wine and both soy sauces around the edge of the wok.

steps.zh: 加开水没过排骨，烧开后转小火盖盖焖 40 分钟，到排骨软烂。
steps.en: Add boiling water to cover, bring back to the boil and simmer covered on low for 40 minutes, until tender.

steps.zh: 开盖转大火收汁，不停翻动，汤汁浓稠挂在排骨上就好；尝一下，淡了再加点盐。
steps.en: Uncover and boil hard, turning the ribs, until the sauce is thick and clings to them; taste and add salt if needed.

name.en: Pounded charred chillies with century eggs

summary.zh: 湘菜下饭菜：青辣椒干锅煸到起虎皮，和蒜一起擂碎，拌上皮蛋，焦香鲜辣。
summary.en: A Hunan rice-killer — green chillies blistered in a dry pan, pounded with garlic and tossed with century eggs. Smoky, savoury and hot.

steps.zh: 青辣椒洗净擦干，整根放进不放油的锅里，中小火边压边翻，煸到表皮起焦斑、变软，约 6–8 分钟。
steps.en: Dry-fry the whole chillies in an unoiled pan over medium-low heat, pressing and turning, for 6–8 minutes until blistered and soft.

steps.zh: 辣椒去蒂，和蒜一起放进碗里（或擂钵），用擀面杖或勺子擂碎。
steps.en: Remove the stems and pound the chillies with the garlic in a bowl or mortar, using the end of a rolling pin or a spoon.

steps.zh: 皮蛋剥壳切小块，加进去一起擂几下，不用太碎。
steps.en: Peel the century eggs, cut them into pieces and pound them in briefly; leave them a little chunky.

steps.zh: 加生抽、少许盐和醋拌匀，喜欢的话淋几滴热油。
steps.en: Season with the soy sauce, a little salt and the vinegar; a few drops of hot oil if you like.

name.en: Winter melon and pork rib soup

summary.zh: 排骨小火炖出清甜的汤底，再放冬瓜炖到透明软糯，汤清味鲜，一年四季都合适。
summary.en: Pork ribs simmered into a clear, sweet broth, then winter melon cooked until translucent and soft — a gentle soup for any season.

steps.zh: 排骨冷水下锅，加料酒，煮开后撇去浮沫，再煮 2 分钟，捞出洗净。
steps.en: Put the ribs in cold water with the wine, bring to the boil, skim and boil 2 minutes more, then rinse.

steps.zh: 汤锅里放 1.5 升水、姜片和排骨，烧开后转小火盖盖炖 50 分钟。
steps.en: Bring 1.5 litres of water to the boil with the ginger and ribs, then simmer covered on low for 50 minutes.

steps.zh: 冬瓜切 2 厘米厚的块，放进锅里再炖 15–20 分钟，到冬瓜透明软烂。
steps.en: Cut the winter melon into 2 cm chunks, add them and simmer 15–20 minutes more, until translucent and tender.

steps.zh: 加盐和白胡椒调味，喜欢的话放枸杞煮 1 分钟，撒葱花。
steps.en: Season with salt and white pepper, add the goji berries for a minute if using, and scatter with spring onion.

summary.zh: 海带丝焯水后过凉，拌上蒜泥和醋，脆爽酸香，十几分钟的开胃小菜。
summary.en: Kelp strips blanched, cooled and tossed with garlic and vinegar — crunchy and tangy, a starter in a quarter of an hour.

note.zh: 鲜海带丝或泡发的干海带

steps.zh: 海带丝多洗几遍，剪成方便入口的长度；水开后焯 2–3 分钟，捞出泡凉水，沥干。
steps.en: Rinse the kelp well and cut it into easy lengths; blanch in boiling water for 2–3 minutes, then cool in cold water and drain.

steps.zh: 蒜捣成泥，辣椒切圈，香菜切段。
steps.en: Crush the garlic, slice the chilli and chop the coriander.

steps.zh: 海带丝加蒜泥、辣椒、醋、生抽、糖和香油拌匀，喜欢辣的加红油，尝一下咸淡。
steps.en: Toss the kelp with the garlic, chilli, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil, adding chilli oil if you like heat; taste for salt.

steps.zh: 撒香菜和芝麻，冷藏 10 分钟更入味。
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and sesame seeds; ten minutes in the fridge lets the flavours soak in.

summary.zh: 薄面皮包上韭菜鸡蛋馅，平底锅煎到两面金黄，外脆里鲜，北方人家常的早饭。
summary.en: Thin dough folded around chives and scrambled egg and pan-fried golden on both sides — crisp outside, juicy within, a northern Chinese breakfast staple.

steps.zh: 面粉里慢慢加温水，揉成光滑的软面团，盖上醒 30 分钟。
steps.en: Work the warm water gradually into the flour to make a smooth, soft dough; cover and rest for 30 minutes.

steps.zh: 醒面的时候做馅：鸡蛋加少许盐炒成小块，放凉；粉丝泡软切碎；韭菜洗净晾干、切碎。
steps.en: Meanwhile, scramble the eggs with a little salt into small pieces and let them cool; soak and chop the glass noodles; wash, dry and finely chop the chives.

steps.zh: 韭菜先拌香油锁住水分，再加鸡蛋、粉丝、虾皮和盐拌匀；馅要在包之前才放盐，免得出水。
steps.en: Toss the chives with the sesame oil first to keep them from weeping, then mix in the eggs, noodles, dried shrimp and salt — salt only just before filling.

steps.zh: 面团分成 8 份，擀成薄圆片，一半铺馅，对折，边缘捏紧或用碗口压出花边。
steps.en: Divide the dough into 8, roll each into a thin round, spread filling over one half, fold over and pinch the edge tight, or trim it with the rim of a bowl.

steps.zh: 平底锅刷油，中小火每面煎 3–4 分钟，到两面金黄、饼皮鼓起；趁热吃。
steps.en: Fry in an oiled pan over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes a side until golden and puffed; eat hot.

name.en: Tomato and egg soup with flour drops

summary.zh: 面粉淋水搅成小面疙瘩，煮进酸甜的西红柿蛋花汤里，暖胃顶饱，二十分钟的早饭或夜宵。
summary.en: Flour stirred with drops of water into tiny dumplings and simmered in a sweet-sour tomato and egg soup — warming and filling, breakfast or a late supper in twenty minutes.

steps.zh: 面粉放进大碗，开着细细的水流一点点淋水，同时用筷子快速搅，搅成米粒大小的面疙瘩，碗底不留干粉。
steps.en: Put the flour in a large bowl and dribble in water from a thin stream while stirring fast with chopsticks, until it forms rice-sized lumps with no dry flour left.

steps.zh: 西红柿切小块；锅里放油，下西红柿中火炒 3 分钟到出汁变软。
steps.en: Dice the tomatoes; cook them in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until soft and juicy.

steps.zh: 加 800 毫升水烧开，一边搅一边把面疙瘩撒进去，转中小火煮 3–4 分钟，到疙瘩熟透、汤变稠。
steps.en: Add 800 ml of water and bring to the boil, then scatter in the dumplings while stirring and simmer over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until cooked and the soup thickens.

steps.zh: 放入菠菜，鸡蛋打散后转圈淋进锅里，等蛋花浮起，加盐，滴几滴香油，撒葱花。
steps.en: Add the spinach, then pour the beaten eggs in a thin circle; once the egg sets, season with salt, add a few drops of sesame oil and scatter with spring onion.
